resolvedText.QuestLoc_LiveDeadDrop_QuestLongDescripti: We need to send a message to a friend who has infiltrated a gang of Raiders. Your mission is to drop the message at a nearby Super-Duper Mart for him to pick up. Try not to get spotted. Or, you know, killed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LiveDeadDrop_QuestShortDescript: Deliver a message to a double agent.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LiveDeadDrop_Conversation_1_Tea: Oh, right. “The lemur sees all but says nothing.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LiveDeadDrop_Conversation_1_NPC: You're lucky I didn't shoot you just then...
*sigh* Just give me the message already.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LiveDeadDrop_Conversation_1_Tea: The message for you is: “All is well, keep up the good work!”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LiveDeadDrop_Conversation_1_NPC: That's it? Wow. Glad you didn't get killed for *that*!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheInfiltrationGame_QuestLongDe: Using information from our undercover agent, we've learned that Raiders are holding what could very well be secret weapon blueprints. We need a single Dweller to infiltrate their base and retrieve those documents ASAP.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheInfiltrationGame_Conversatio: My name is John Francis Miller Raider Boss Killer... But call me JF.
All right JF, I... Hey, wait a minute...
That's twice you've asked me today!
I did? Oh, never mind then. As you were.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheInfiltrationGame_QuestObject: Retrieve the “For Your Eyes Only” documents.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheInfiltrationGame_Conversatio: Seems I *do* need to start shooting people again.
Let me get those secret blueprints out of the way first.
That's a dirty napkin, not a blueprint, and you're a spy!
I need some money for the tea machine.
Ugh, I can't even... Here, be sure to bring the change back!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SecretWeaponTest_QuestLongDescr: Among the documents retrieved from the Raider base were plans for a new weapon. Our engineers have built it, but now we need to test the weapon out in the field to see how well it performs. Make sure no one sees you and lives to tell about it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SecretWeaponTest_QuestShortDesc: Test the weapon built from recovered blueprints.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SecretWeaponTest_QuestObjective: Test the Junk Jet on enemies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SecretWeaponTest_Conversation_1: I'm sorry, I can't do that.
Fine, we'll just take it then!
How about I kill you instead, and we forget the whole thing?
My orders are clear: no witnesses.
Well, you're in a bit of a pickle then, 'cause we all saw you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_QuestLongDescription: We found some worrying info in the documents retrieved from the Raider base. It appears they made camp in a nearby uranium mine to poison our water supply. We need to send someone to stop this... discreetly, of course.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_QuestShortDescription: Counter a plot to poison the Vault's water supply.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_QuestObjective_1: Stop Raiders from poisoning the water.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_1_Team_1: You won't get away with this!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: I... I just *literally* said you're too late. What's the matter with you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_1_Team_2: That's... actually an improvement, given our life expectancy.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: Well, in your case it'll be a lot quicker!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_1_Team_3: You'll be dead in a matter of seconds.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: Oh, sure, if you're going to cheat and use *weapons*...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_2_Team_1: Maybe we should just leave this Raider clan.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_: Well, let's not get hasty... We do have Mondays off.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_2_Team_2: He's not even protecting you from undercover saboteurs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_: I know, right? It's as if... Wait, what?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_2_Team_3: The boss doesn't care about your health.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Sabotage_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_: Well, he did give us these. They're only a month past their expiry date.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_QuestLongDescrip: We've received a transmission from Harkness, Rivet City's chief of security, about important information he wants to give us in person. Put on your best clothes and meet him at the abandoned Super-Duper Mart north of the Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_1_T: Harkness is a friend of our Vault. I suggest you leave now.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_1_N: And throw away all those Caps? I don't think so!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_1_T: You know a “handsome sum” won't actually make you handsome, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_1_N: It won't? We thought that was the whole point. Well, the heck with this then!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_2_N: You can have this weapon. I call it “Dart,” because it always hits the  bullseye.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_2_T: What if the Ghouls follow me back to the Vault?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_2_N: Use this weapon! I call it the “Dart.” Don't ask.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_2_T: So, how come a big shot like you got owned by a bunch of Ghouls?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DartofHarkness_Conversation_2_N: I'm not a big shot, just a guy doing his job. Here, this is for you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremePrejudice_QuestLongDescr: The information we got from Harkness is troubling: it reveals a rival Vault Overseer is behind all of the recent attacks against us. We need to send a single assassin to infiltrate the Vault and take out its leader... with extreme prejudice.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremePrejudice_QuestShortDesc: Take out a hostile Vault Overseer.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremePrejudice_Conversation_1: I have a very common face, it helps to infiltrate the enemy.
Well, I did make the cover of Spy Quarterly.
I saw that! It's an honor to meet you. And kill you.
I *wish* I was a spy, so I could just kill you all.
Ha! I bet you would, too!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremePrejudice_Conversation_2: Of course I do! He's...uh...he's right over there, look!
Don't kid... Mike's been dead for weeks.
Oh, right, he is. Heh. Good ol' Mike.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremePrejudice_Conversation_3: I left it in my other Vault Suit.
“All Dwellers must carry ID at all times.” We have to shoot you now.
What does that mean anyway, “extreme prejudice”?
You know, I'm not sure... Let me get back to you on that.
Does my fist count as ID?
Never heard of fist prints before, but I supp- Ooh, I get it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremePrejudice_Conversation_4: I'm on my way to see the Overseer. I can ask him if you want.
You'll live out the rest of your days here, i.e. a couple of minutes.
Is that some kind of threat?
Your... I mean, *our* Overseer is all-knowing. Surely he's telling the truth.
Steve, all-knowing? You're clearly *not* from here...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremePrejudice_Conversation_5: This dump? Have you actually looked at it? It stinks!
Why *our* Vault, out of all of them?
It's awesome! Your Overseer is  the best! A true genius, and immune to flattery, too.
Can't we just all get along?
Well you got me. Do you expect me to talk?
No, Secret Agent Person, I expect you to die.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllsFairinLoveandNuclearWar_Que: All's Fair in Love and Nuclear War
We've received word that a nearby Vault is holding a Singles Night for Valentine's Day, and they've invited us to participate!
Travel to a nearby Vault to find a potential mate.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllsFairinLoveandNuclearWar_Con: No, but being on a diet doesn't mean I can't check the menu!
Maybe those disruptive Dwellers should be asked to leave.
Great idea! You should go and tell them. Take this for courage.
Are there any Singles here at all?
I think there's one left, hiding in one of the Vault rooms.
You couldn't get that groove on if your life depended on it.
You can't call dibs on someone.
I can. I did. And now I'm calling dibs on killing you.
Pfft, there are many more singles over at Vault 332. Like, tons.
There are? All right boys, let's blow this joint. Here, take this to remember how I let you live.
Have you tried shooting yourself in the face first? Might improve your chances.
Well, shooting *you* in the face would certainly lift my spirits!
I probed the Wasteland searching for you, and here you are.
I was waiting for you all that time, and now you're here.
I'm sorry, this can't work. You look too much like my mother.
That's fine, but do put on a hat before you go out. It's cold outside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_QuestLongDescrip: Love is in the air, and just like radioactive fallout  - once it gets inside you it doesn't get out! All we need now is a ring to pop the big question. We might have some luck finding Pre-War jewelry in a nearby abandoned building.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_QuestShortDescri: Retrieve Pre-war Jewelry to make a ring.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_Conversation_1_T: Is your “prize” some sort of gold jewelry, by chance?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_Conversation_1_N: What? No, it's a sixpack of Nuka-Cola Quantum!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_Conversation_1_T: I don't want your “prize,” whatever it is. I'm looking for gold.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_Conversation_1_N: Oh, we don't care then. Here, for your troubles.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_Conversation_1_T: You don't kill us, we kill you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_Conversation_1_N: We hate when Dwellers makes fun of our grammar! Die!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThisGoldenRing_QuestObjective_1: Find any item made of gold.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_QuestLongDescripti: The big day is almost upon us. The idea was to have a wedding in a natural setting, but since it's too dangerous outside we'll use a nearby cave instead. We just need to sterilize it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_QuestShortDescript: Clear out a cave in preparation for a wedding.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_1_Tea: We just want to have a wedding here... Care to officiate it?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_1_NPC: Well, I'd have to ask my supervisor, but I think this can be arranged.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_1_Tea: Sorry, can't hear over all that laughter inside my head.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_1_NPC: I SAID, VACATE THE... Ah, just shoot them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_2_Tea: I'm afraid you guys have to vacate the premises.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_2_NPC: Well, that's unfortunate. I guess we'll have to kill you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_2_Tea: You know there's an abandoned Vault a few miles North, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_2_NPC: There is? We are so outta here... Come on gang, we're moving on up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_2_Tea: Sure, but maybe you want to look inside this gun's barrel first?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_Conversation_2_NPC: Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice... Won't get fooled again!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ALaborofLove_QuestObjective_1: Eliminate the Mole rat brood mother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_QuestLongDescript: That was quite the bachelor party last night! Too bad the groom's missing today. Last we saw, he was being carried away by the hired entertainment. We have to bring him back, and quick. Let's avoid a repeat of New Year's Eve...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_QuestShortDescrip: Rescue a missing groom from Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_1_NP: Not quite the response I was looking for.
Nice. But we're still going to kill you.
Okay, right after we're done with you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_2_Te: We came for the groom you kidnapped.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_2_NP: Groom? Oh, you mean slave-boy? Yeah, he's ours now.
Aww, that's so cute I almost feel like letting you live. Almost.
Come on ladies, let's show these losers what we're made of!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_3_Te: The party's been over for days...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_3_NP: It has? All right, time to face the music, I guess.
I thought that was the whole point...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_3_Te: It sure is... But we gotta go get you married now.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_3_NP: Oh, right. I almost forgot about that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_3_Te: Come on, let's get you home.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GroomforDoubt_Conversation_3_NP: You guys think I should grow a mustache?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_QuestLongDescripti: We've received a call for help from Vault 505. They've been working on a special project that would allow Dwellers to play games on their Pip-Boys. Imagine that! Unfortunately, they've also been overrun with Radroaches. We have to help them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_QuestShortDescript: Help Vault 505 deal with its bug problem.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_Conversation_1_NPC: It's a Vault simulator. We're calling it “Nuclear Bunker.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_Conversation_1_Tea: Why are you guys wasting your time on a silly game?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_Conversation_1_NPC: We set out to do a spreadsheet, but we got sidetracked...
Nah, your Pip-Boy is too old. Maybe you can try adding this expansion card...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_Conversation_2_Tea: Will this game drain my Pip-Boy battery?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_Conversation_2_NPC: Don't worry, you should be able to get a solid three minutes of play before that happens.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_Conversation_2_Tea: Shouldn't you be making useful stuff, like weapons?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDeBuggers_Conversation_2_NPC: As crazy as it sounds, some people will pay Caps to play games.
I'm a producer: I make sure we have fresh produce daily, so the team stays healthy.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_QuestLongDescript: A cat burglar has been hitting Vault after Vault, taking pets away from their owners. Stop them before they steal another cat!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_QuestShortDescrip: Solve the mystery of an elusive thief.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_1_Te: What if you lost a leg after taking an arrow to the knee?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_1_NP: You'll die for that cheap crossover joke!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_1_Te: Give it up or we'll drown this kitten.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_1_NP: No, don't! I'll stop stealing cats for my mother, I swear!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_1_Te: Okay, well, you got two legs, so you die.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_1_NP: Well obviously the rule doesn't apply to me. Duh!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_2_NP: My eyesight is fine, dearie. Here, have a cookie.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_2_Te: You realize most of the animals here are Mole rats, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_2_NP: Well, that would explain the lack of purring. Here, take this for your troubles.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_2_Te: I'm sorry, we've come to take away your cats.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCatBurglar_Conversation_2_NP: You've come to decorate your hats? Here, you can use this.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CollectorsEdition_QuestLongDesc: We've heard that local Raiders have found a brand-new Mr. Handy, still in his original box, in an abandoned industrial building. We should try to get our hands on this collector's item before those Raiders ruin it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CollectorsEdition_QuestShortDes: Retrieve a brand-new Mr. Handy from Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CollectorsEdition_Conversation_: You shouldn't. Mr. Handy robots are terrible at cooking.
Does that mean you've already taken it out of its box?
Not yet, but we'll do that right after killing you!
...or you could just surrender and give us the Mr. Handy.
Yeah, but how fun would *that* be?
Let me check if I have change first.
You're the one who'll pay! With your life! Because we'll kill you!
Yeah, I  got that - you know, *before* you over-explained it.
Give us the box and you'll live.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleRedRadiumHood_QuestLongDe: We sent one of our Dwellers to bring food to the old Non-Feral Ghoul known as “Grandmamma,” but we haven't heard from her in a while. We need to send a team to investigate!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleRedRadiumHood_QuestShortD: Locate and rescue the food delivery girl.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleRedRadiumHood_Conversatio: Are you sure it was Grandmamma?
Meh, I just followed directions. I'm not an expert on Ghouls.
Did she have large eyes, large hands, and a large mouth?
She did! Come to think of it, maybe it was a Deathclaw.
Well, it took you guys a while, and I was getting hungry, so I ate all the cakes.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleRedRadiumHood_QuestObject: Find out what happened to Grandmamma.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleRedRadiumHood_Conversatio: What's this we heard about you ogling our delivery girl?
Oh, that must have been my Fido. Found him in the Wasteland, poor little doggie...
Sorry, we're out of sweet cakes, but we have some yellow ones...
Oh, those give me heartburn. And radiation poisoning.
Of course! Here, have some peppermint candy. It's over 200 years old!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DivideandConquer_QuestLongDescr: There's a new Raider gang, Euler's Angels, terrorizing the Wasteland's perimeter! Without going on a tangent, we need to send our smartest Dwellers to reduce the threat these radicals pose, and solve this acute situation.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DivideandConquer_Conversation_1: That's *point* 22. Here, let me show you.
Only for very large values of 2.
...or very small values of 5. All right, you can go through.
Okay, maybe that was a little *too* simple...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DivideandConquer_Conversation_2: Wrong, the two are considered to be of equal value! Kill them!
Indeed, it is! Here's your reward.
Here, check out my infinitely repeating firearm.
I think I'll make a scatter plot... of your brains!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DivideandConquer_Conversation_3: Normally I'd agree with you, but I'm feeling negative today.
Maybe this was true once, but that's no longer the case.
The equation is ambiguous, and meant to trick people.
I can't add anything to this, you won fair and square.
Let me count out the answer with gunshots.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_QuestLongDescription: We've all heard rumors of a bottomless Vault, one that is deeper than any others that have been built, but now it seems we may have actually located it! We need to send a recon party to explore the Vault and unlock its deadly secret.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_QuestShortDescription: Explore the depth of a bottomless Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: Sure. I think. I've never been myself, but there *has* to be one, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_1_Team_2: What can you tell us about this place?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: You should ask my brother, he used to be the Overseer of this Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_1_Team_3: How much further down is your brother's place?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: Look for Deathclaws being too afraid to chase you deeper.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_QuestObjective_1: Solve the secret of the Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_: More or less. Some robots continued to dig a bit more.
I like the peace and quiet. It's pretty safe down here, you know?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_2_Team_3: So, this is the result of malfunctioning robots?!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_: Yup. That was our experiment, to have robots do all of the manual work.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_2_Team_4: I think your brother misses you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheAbyss_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_: Yeah, I haven't seen him in a while. Maybe I'll visit him in the Spring.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandTheMusical_QuestLongDe: A duet of singing Raiders has been spreading terror in the Wasteland using high production value musical numbers. We need to ring down the curtain on these musical thugs!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandTheMusical_QuestShortD: Stop a gang of singing Raiders from terrorizing the area.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandTheMusical_Conversatio: ♪ What an offer, how to say no? ♪ But not right now, I've got to go! ♪
♪ Don't worry, we're all good ♪\n♪ We'll be in the neighborhood! ♪
♪ And what if my long-lost parents ♪ Say, just happened to be mutants? ♪
♪ Then we're sorry, you're no good ♪\n♪ We'd kill you twice if twice we could! ♪
♪ I don't even know your song ♪ Can't we all just get along? ♪
♪ That is something we can't do ♪\n♪ Now we'll turn you into stew! ♪
♪ Lovely jacket, where'd you get it? ♪ Was it from a homeless guy? ♪
♪ Now you've done it, prep a casket! ♪\n♪ You had your laugh, now you die! ♪
♪ Even with the best intent ♪ I have no sins to present! ♪
♪ Sinners will try to circumvent ♪\n♪ But in the end they all repent! ♪
♪ Okay, let's say that I repent ♪ Just for the sake of argument ♪
♪ To Atom you will represent ♪\n♪ Say hi to Him on your ascent! ♪
Uh... Okay?
Oops, sorry. Wrong production.
♪ How bizarre, I hear talking ♪ And yet I don't see a thing ♪\n♪ Pretty please, don't shoot! ♪
♪ Isn't science wonderful? ♪ Makes us great and powerful! ♪\n♪ Accept no sub-sti-tutes! ♪
♪ I'm sorry but I've got orders ♪ If I meet with any posers ♪\n♪ I must e-xe-cute! ♪
♪ It's okay, we understand ♪ You're but a rube from the Wasteland ♪\n♪ A moron and a brute! ♪
♪ My parents, I can't believe it! ♪ But to this I can't commit ♪ Maybe I could just visit? ♪
♪ I guess this is a new start ♪ Of our lives you're now part ♪\n♪ Always you'll be in our hearts! ♪
♪ I sought you far and wide ♪ But now your request is denied ♪ The Overseer is my guide! ♪
♪ We're sorry it must come to this ♪ Without so much as a kiss ♪\n♪ We send you back to the Abyss! ♪
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleMissWasteland_QuestLongDe: Great news! We've been invited to participate in the Miss Wasteland pageant, which - in spite of its name - is open to men and women. Put on your nicest looking swimsuit and knock 'em dead!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleMissWasteland_QuestShortD: Compete in the Wasteland's most prestigious pageant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleMissWasteland_Conversatio: I always wear this when roaming the Wasteland.
Okay then! Just go through the door to begin.
This isn't a swimsuit, it's, uh... Camouflage!
Of course it is! Just go through the door to begin.
When this is over, I'm going to kill you.
Take a number! Until then, proceed through the door.
Was that the first question?
No, it wasn't. Just go through there.
Can I phone a friend?
Yeah, that's not a thing. Just go through the door.
Arf!
Aww, who's a good b... I mean, go through the door to begin.
Uh... It was... Um... Vault-Tec?
That took way too much time, but correct! Proceed to the next room.
Nuka-Cola. Final answer.
I'm so sorry, but that's incorrect. I'm sure you'll get the next one...
Can you repeat the question?
I'm sorry, there's no time. Please proceed to the next room!
I'm going to use my wildcard on this one.
There's no wildcard. Please proceed to the next room for a new question.
Makes my grandma feel warm and tingly, so I'm gonna say “good.”
Let me guess, your grandma is a Ghoul, right? (sigh) Proceed to the next room...
Can it be both?
That's not how this works. Just... go on through that door.
Uh...Vault-Tec?
Ugh, I can't even... Just go through the door.
Vault-Tec! The answer is Vault-Tec!
Riiight... Just go through there, and everything will be fine.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleMissWasteland_QuestObject: Place in the top three positions.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LittleMissWasteland_Conversatio: Well, the better candidate won. Can I keep the dog?
Sure, as long as you promise never to enter a pageant again.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_QuestLongDescript: We've just received news that a nearby Vault has descended into chaos. It seems fans of pre-war science-fiction novelettes have come to blows over which series is the best. We need to send a team to help pacify the Vault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_QuestShortDescrip: Bring peace to warring groups of science-fiction fans.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_1_Te: Right, we'll get right on it. Which are the main factions?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_1_NP: You've got fans of Space Trip - Trippies - and Cosmic Clash adepts.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_2_Te: I believe it's vol. 2, issue 7, “Nebulous Intentions.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_2_NP: Correct! Let's all lay down our arms and re-read that classic episode.
You lie! What else would you use to realign tachyonic flow polarity?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_3_Te: Your superstition is no match for our rusty weapons!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_3_NP: You forget our Energy Scimitars! Pkssshiioom... vwoom... vwooom...
Star Council commandos! I knew it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_3_Te: We only seek cosmic harmony. The galaxy's big enough for all.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaroftheNerds_Conversation_3_NP: Our passion *should* bring us together, not push us apart. Thank you, space traveler.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_QuestLongDescrip: Egads! We've just received word that William Peabody III, Esq., has been found murdered in his bedchambers. We must send our brightest detective and his trusty sidekick to solve this gruesome mystery!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_2_T: The game is afoot! Let's proceed!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_2_N: Okay, but just so you know, we tend to use metric around here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_2_T: Not so fast. Where were *you* on the night of the murder?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_2_N: Eating Cram in the boudoir. I still have the tins if you want to see them.
No sir, I don't think so.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_3_T: An industrialist? In this day and age?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_3_N: We mostly just collect old junk and resell it... but we're very industrious about it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_3_T: What were you doing when Mr. Peabody was murdered?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_3_N: Coincidentally enough, trying to find clever ways to murder Mr. Peabody.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_3_T: I had a cat named Priscilla, once.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_3_N: Don't get any funny ideas! It's bad enough Peabody tried to seduce my wife...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_4_T: How did he ruin her family?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_4_N: Got her son addicted to Rock-papers-scissors, then sucked him dry by always picking Rock.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_4_T: Was that before or after she was Ghoulified?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_4_N: Oh, she's not a Ghoul, she's just very, very old.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_4_T: What were you doing at the time of the murder?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_4_N: Resuscitating Lady Worthington after she tried to nibble on a blueberry scone.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_5_T: Are you saying you wanted him dead?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_5_N: I guess it would depend on how much suffering he'd go through first.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_5_T: Turkish blade, huh? Did you know Peabody was stabbed to death?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_5_N: Sixty-four times, if I recall correctly.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_5_T: What about you, Vicky? Did you see anything?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_5_N: I'm sorry, my niece has a poor memory. I'm sure she can't recall what happened last night.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_6_T: Do you often suffer such memory losses?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_6_N: Only when I go on a violent rampage, so...every other week, maybe?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_6_T: Did you get along well with your father?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_6_N: Oh sure! He'd disown me, I'd thrust sharp objects at him... The usual.
All my siblings met grisly fates, usually when playing by the cliffside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_6_T: I must say I appreciate your candor.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_6_N: I'll remember that next time I go on a violent, murderous rampage.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_QuestObjective_1: Solve the Murder of William Peabody.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_7_T: It was Rod Murphy, the industrialist.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_7_N: Not surprised, you can never trust the “nouveau riche.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_7_T: Lady Worthington's attendant Agatha did it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_7_N: Huh. Who knew such a monster hid behind those thick nerdy glasses?
I guess it all adds up. Here, Mr. Peabody would have wanted you to have this.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_7_T: It's obviously his son. You didn't need me for that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathandDenial_Conversation_7_N: Strangely enough, he's the one who sent for you. Guess he didn't think this through.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_QuestLongDescripti: There have been several reports of strange lights hovering over the Wasteland not far from here. The lights were congregating over an old abandoned mine. We need to investigate this before rumors of alien visitors start spreading!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_1_Tea: This isn't really a Vault, it's an abandoned mine.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_1_NPC: Ha ha yes, you have gotten us. You are funny and as humans we like to laugh.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_1_Tea: Have you guys seen strange lights in the sky?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_1_NPC: All lights in the sky are normal. You were confused by the planet Venus ha ha.
Ha ha, just kidding. Humor is a distinctive human trait, wink wink.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_2_NPC: Everything here is normal human stuff, no space aliens on a mission or anything.
Ha ha “take us to your leader” - I got that humorous cultural reference.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_3_Tea: We're investigating strange lights in this area.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_3_NPC: There is no need, you should go back home to enjoy a nice beverage and foodstuff.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_3_Tea: Nice to meet you both. Are you related?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_3_NPC: Ha ha well we were hatched in the same pod, so to speak ha ha.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_3_Tea: I don't see many women here... Are you guys all male?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_3_NPC: Good catch ha ha but seriously we do need females if you can spare some that'd be great.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_4_Tea: This isn't a Vault, it's a cave.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_4_NPC: Ha ha you say Zeta Reticuli a, I say Zeta Reticuli b...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_4_Tea: You mean Radscorpions? We'll take care of those.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_4_NPC: It is through collaboration that our primitive species evolves!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_5_Tea: You guys seem like pretty regular folks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_5_NPC: Super, now go tell others never to come here because everything is normal ha ha.
Ha ha no problem just look inside the opening of this pistol-like artefact.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumansLikeUs_Conversation_5_Tea: Well, you guys are a *little* bit weird.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSecretofREDACTED_QuestLongDe: Keep this to yourself, but we've been contacted by one of our deep agents, codename Moley, who says he's uncovered a massive conspiracy with vast ramifications. Go over to Vault 322 to hear Moley's big story!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSecretofREDACTED_Conversatio: Just passing through, 23 skidoo!
Yeah, I don't think so.
We're looking for Moley.
Have you tried asking the Freemasons?
We're here because of [REDACTED].
Shh, keep your voice down... here, you'll need this. Ordo Templi Borealis!
We've got plenty of caps.
Aw, how cute, your very first bribe attempt!
We've got this stuffed bear...
Ah, well you should have said so before. Can't be too careful, you know?
We've got guns.
Well whaddya know, so do we. All hail Discordia!
[REDACTED]
Okay, that's hilarious, but we still have to kill you.
[REDACTED]
That... is the most profound thing I've heard. Go, I need to re-evaluate everything.
[REDACTED]
Is this what you think? Well, we'll see about *that*!
Pfft, we've known that for ages... It's common knowledge by now.
It is?! No one ever tells me anything! That's it, I'm going back to [REDACTED]!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DibsattheRedRocket_QuestLongDes: One of your Dwellers found an abandoned Red Rocket truck stop! Maybe there's some valuable junk inside...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DibsattheRedRocket_QuestShortDe: Look through Red Rocket for useful junk.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DibsattheRedRocket_Conversation: No, I think I'll just stay and take what I want.
Oh well. I tried to warn you...
All right, I'll just show myself out, then.
Have this as a token of our appreciation.
Come on, can't you guys share anything here?
Well, I guess you can have that. We don't really need it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ANiceGhoulLikeYou_QuestLongDesc: One of your dwellers has come across a relatively untouched Red Rocket. Maybe there's some valuable junk inside!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ANiceGhoulLikeYou_QuestShortDes: Check out a Red Rocket fueling station for parts.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ANiceGhoulLikeYou_QuestObjectiv: Deal with a group of testy Ghouls.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ANiceGhoulLikeYou_Conversation_: Wrong. They're pretty loud, and they usually won't heal you.
Yes indeed! Sweet, sweet radiation. Here, you deserve this.
Nope. He makes that little eerie music when he shows up, remember?
I don't know, and I don't care.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CabinFever_QuestLongDescription: One of your dwellers has heard cries coming from an abandoned cabin. They should investigate to see if anyone needs help!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CabinFever_QuestShortDescriptio: Investigate strange sounds coming from a derelict cabin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CabinFever_QuestObjective_1: Investigate the noises coming from the cabin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CabinFever_Conversation_1_Team_: You guys know I can see you, right?
I feel a sudden urge to shoot that area of empty space, right there.
I'm going to pretend I didn't see and hear that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Infested_QuestLongDescription: A woman living by herself in an abandoned cabin is being plagued by Radroaches. We should help her with that!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Infested_QuestShortDescription: Help a nice lady with her pest problem.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Infested_Conversation_1_Team_1: No problem, ma'am, I'm on it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SuperDuperTrooper_QuestLongDesc: One of your Dwellers has heard gunshots coming from a Super-Duper Mart while exploring the Wasteland! You should investigate.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SuperDuperTrooper_QuestShortDes: Investigate a stand-off at the Super-Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SuperDuperTrooper_Conversation_: Oh yeah? Well I think you need a wake-up call...
I'm just a Vault Dweller exploring the Wasteland.
Okay. We're trying to smoke out some dangerous elements holed up in the basement.
Well, we all feel safer with you guys around.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SuperDuperTrooper_QuestObjectiv: Talk to both sides of the stand-off.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SuperDuperTrooper_Conversation_: Friend. I killed those Brotherhood doofuses for you.
You did? We had it covered, but thanks! Here, take these.
You know what? I don't really care about your little spat.
Well, we don't care about you, so there!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HopontheRoachCoach_QuestLongDes: Abandoned Super-Duper Marts sometimes contain useful stuff. They also often serve as lairs for dangerous creatures. Be careful!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HopontheRoachCoach_QuestShortDe: Check out the Super-Duper Mart for loot.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HopontheRoachCoach_QuestObjecti: Look for loot in the Super-Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HopontheRoachCoach_Conversation: You could always join our Vault. We value loyalty.
Wow, that's a great offer, thanks! I'll do it!
Well, maybe next time you'll make better choices.
Yeah, maybe. Anyway, thanks for the help!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FonsVivus_QuestLongDescription: People are talking about a new kind of water that has healing properties, makes you stronger and brings good fortune. Adventure! Action! Refreshing Beverages! We can drink to that!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FonsVivus_QuestShortDescription: Learn more about the magical water people are talking about.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FonsVivus_QuestObjective_1: Talk to settlers who've tried the magical new water.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FonsVivus_Conversation_1_Team_1: You wouldn't happen to have any left over, would you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FonsVivus_Conversation_1_NPCEnd: We tried to save some but it was so REFRESHING! Try Vault 315, they bought some as well.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OurCupsRunnethOverWITHFAILURE_Q: Our Cups Runneth Over... WITH FAILURE
Can it be true? Has someone figured out a way to create water so powerful it can heal any ill, boost any crop, and fix any door? The people at Vault 315 should know more!
Visit Vault 315 to gather information on the magical water.
Get more info on the so-called magical water.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OurCupsRunnethOverWITHFAILURE_C: You don't have any left, do you?
NO! We buried it under a tree, which got hit by lightning! Talk to the crew at the old RobCo plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HalfFullHalfEmpty_QuestLongDesc: Apparently there's more to this story than meets the taste buds. This refreshing miracle beverage isn't so miraculous or refreshing after all, and the folks at the RobCo plant just may know the truth...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HalfFullHalfEmpty_QuestShortDes: Find more info about the magical water at the old RobCo plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HalfFullHalfEmpty_QuestObjectiv: Meet the people at the old RobCo plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HalfFullHalfEmpty_Conversation_: You wouldn't happen to have any left, would you?  We'd pay handsomely...
Our brahmin drank it all. Who can say no to golden dung? Try the abandoned Vault-Tec offices.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaterintoBrine_QuestLongDescrip: Does the “magical” water really work or is it a total sham?  We need to track down this Water Wizard and see if he's the real deal or a snake oil salesman.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaterintoBrine_QuestShortDescri: Talk to the folks at the Vault-Tec offices about the water.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaterintoBrine_QuestObjective_1: Ask about the Wizard's water at the old Vault-Tec offices.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WaterintoBrine_Conversation_1_N: Tell you what, some Raiders have been hassling us. Take down their leader and we'll tell you. Deal?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AquaNukaCola_QuestLongDescripti: The only way we can get more information about the Water Wizard is to clear out this Raider camp. Should be a walk in the park!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AquaNukaCola_QuestShortDescript: Clear out the Raider camp for the settlers in the Vault-Tec offices.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Aquaschema_QuestLongDescription: We did what the people at the Vault-Tec offices asked. Now it's time for some answers!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Aquaschema_Conversation_1_Team_: Do you know where we can find him?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Aquaschema_Conversation_1_NPCEn: His former assistant is holed up in a Super-Duper Mart off yonder.  He'll know for sure.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheReluctantShill_QuestLongDesc: We're close to tracking down the Wizard! Apparently his assistant abandoned him and is holed up at a Super-Duper Mart. We'll beat the truth out of him if we have to!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheReluctantShill_Conversation_: Can you point us to him?
He's in a dilapidated factory not too far away. Be warned, he's gotten more and more... eccentric.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SnakeWater_QuestLongDescription: We've finally pinned down the Wizard of Water. Time to confront him and stop him from selling any more of his glorified tap water.  Maybe we can make some money on the side as well...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SnakeWater_QuestShortDescriptio: Shut down the Water Wizard's operation.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SnakeWater_QuestObjective_1: Shut down the Water Wizard's operation.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SnakeWater_Conversation_1_Team_: Settle down, Wiz. We don't want to fight. We just want our cut.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SnakeWater_Conversation_1_NPCEn: A wise choice! Take your reward, my loyal subjects!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SnakeWater_Conversation_1_Team_: You took advantage of too many people. You're going down, “Wizard”!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SnakeWater_Conversation_1_NPCEn: Fine, then! If not the water of life then the BLOOD OF DEATH! HAVE AT THEE!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ShamrocktheCasbah_QuestLongDesc: We've received information that Vault 317 contains clover samples from before the Great War. This hardy, nutritious weed, believed to be extinct, could prove an important staple for us. We need to bring back these samples - if there are any left!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ShamrocktheCasbah_QuestShortDes: Retrieve clover samples from an abandoned Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DrivingtheSnakesOut_QuestLongDe: A band of Raiders known as the Snakes has been targeting Settlers with red hair, calling them “gingers” and claiming they are inferior beings. We need to drive these Snakes out of the neighborhood, for good!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DrivingtheSnakesOut_QuestShortD: Defeat a band of Raiders hostile to redheads.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DrivingtheSnakesOut_Conversatio: A bonnie lass once broke me heart, and I couldn't deal with it.
I say you care way too much about hair color.
That's exactly what a ginger lover would say!
I say it's time to get all Saint Paddy on you Snakes!
Ireland's lack of snakes goes back to the last ice age!
I think you're about to get your wish.
I don't think it's supposed to be literal...
Is that really what you think, boyo?
Pfft. Thinking is for chumps, and losers, and gingers!
I guess we'll have to agree to disagree.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheEndoftheRainbow_QuestLongDes: We've heard strange rumors of a great treasure found at the end of the rainbow! Our calculations indicate that's near the abandoned talc mines to the West, ruled by a myserious Raider boss called “Shaun the Leper.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheEndoftheRainbow_QuestShortDe: Find the treasure at the end of the rainbow.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheEndoftheRainbow_Conversation: So you're the leper Shaun at the end of the rainbow?
Hmm...when ya say it out loud it *does* sound a bit daft.
I'm not sure what you're saying, but I sense you're upset.
Hand us your treasure and everything will be fine.
No, we're freelancers, killing for fun and profit.
I heard the treasure's at the *other* end of the rainbow.
Makes sense. All we found so far is this junk.
If we believe in it, then it exists in our hearts.
On that topic, do you believe in bullets?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ItsnotEasyBeingGreen_QuestLongD: Nearby Settlers have become very sick following the annual St. Patrick's Day festivities, with some reported cases of Ghoulification! This might just be, um, “food” poisoning, but we should investigate in case it's an actual epidemic...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ItsnotEasyBeingGreen_QuestShort: Help nearby Settlers deal with a strange epidemic.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ItsnotEasyBeingGreen_Conversati: No thanks, we'd rather just see the afflicted.
Late in the evening on St. Patrick's Day. Think there's a link?
Oh yeah, we dye them to celebrate St. Patrick's Day.
First, we need to figure out what's causing all this.
Beats me. Sure you don't want a pint of glowin' green?
Did you do anything out of the ordinary these past few days?
You mean, apart from drinking green beer? Nope. Nothing at all.
Is green beer really that good?
It's so refreshing it tickles your throat as it goes down...
I'm starting to think the beer may have something to do with it.
Impossible! We brew it ourselves, add some Biohazard brand dye, and...oooh.
What do you guys put in the beer to make it green?
Just some Biohazard brand dye we found in old drums... oooh.
The green beer is making you sick.
Are you saying that “Biohazard” *isn't* a brand of food coloring?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBansheesKeen_QuestLongDescri: We've received reports from nearby Settlers that their building is haunted by a wailing female spirit. That sounds unlikely, but we should investigate in the name of... Science! Don't worry, we'll honor your memory if the angry dead end up eating your souls.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBansheesKeen_QuestShortDescr: Solve the mystery of a haunted building.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBansheesKeen_Conversation_1_: What does the wailing sound like?
What, you can't hear it? But, it's so *loud*!
Don't worry, we'll take care of it.
Thank you so much! Here, this might help.
Really? It's so loud I can barely make out what you're saying!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBansheesKeen_Conversation_2_: Sorry, but we can't hear anything.
Then you're one of *them* and you must be killed!
Let us through! We'll take care of it.
You'd better, or we'll kill you too!
Give us your weapons first, then we'll make it stop.
Okay. Sure. Whatever. Here you go!
Nuts? NUTS?! I'll show you nuts!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBansheesKeen_QuestObjective_: Solve the mystery of the wailing spirit.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBansheesKeen_Conversation_3_: You can't experiment on Settlers without their consent.
Sure we can! It's for the greater good, or something...
Your scientific experiment is enabling superstitious beliefs.
We'll let you live if you give us the parrot.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheRiteofSpraying_QuestLongDesc: We've had reports of nearby Settlers being randomly sprayed with radioactive material by unknown assailants. We should deliver some RadAway to those settlers and find out more about the attacks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheRiteofSpraying_Conversation_: They called themselves the “Children of Atom.” Worship radiation, or something like that.
Did they mention why they were doing this?
They kept saying we should rejoice, that “E-Ster” is coming. Don't know what that means.
No idea, but they kept saying it was coming. Some god or goddess, maybe?
Are you sure it was the Children of Atom?
Yeah. They're usually pretty harmless. Don't know what's gotten into them.
Yeah, through that door... But it's probably too late for them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringForwardFallBack_QuestLong: Our investigation has indicated that a local chapter of the Church of the Children of Atom was responsible for the recent toxic spraying attacks. We have to confront their leader, Confessor Alvarado, and tell him to stop these attacks, or else.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringForwardFallBack_QuestShor: Confront the local Children of Atom leader.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringForwardFallBack_Conversat: Ah! Unbelievers! We've got an even quicker way for you to meet Atom!
No thanks, we're here to politely ask you to stop spraying people.
You can't stop us, we're on a mission from Atom!
Our Overseer wants you to stop spraying people at random.
Fine. We only did this to save the daylight, but we'll find other, less intrusive ways.
Give me one good reason not to shoot you...
Well, who will save the daylight, if not us? Though I guess we can do that without involving Settlers...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_QuestLongDescript: Confessor Alvarado has agreed to put a stop to radioactive spraying, and as a sign of goodwill we've agreed to help the Church recover a sacred circuit board rumored to contain data about the ancient rite of E-Ster.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_QuestShortDescrip: Help the Children of Atom recover an ancient artifact.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_1_Te: Why is the circuit board so precious?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_1_NP: It teaches us about E-Ster, and the coming of the Sixth Sun.
Er...no one important. Forget I even mentioned him.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_1_Te: Aren't you going to help us find it?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_1_NP: We're humble servants of Atom, not adventurers...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_2_Te: How long has Brother Will been missing?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_2_NP: I'm really not supposed to talk about this... About three days.
I'm pretty sure I can't talk about it but... I fear he's lost his mind.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_2_Te: What can you tell us about E-Ster?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterisComing_Conversation_2_NP: That it's coming? Also, it's the time when the Daylight is saved, praise Atom!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_QuestLongDescriptio: We think Brother Will, the Church initiate who has gone missing, may have been kidnapped by a band of Raiders camped nearby. We'll send a team to rescue him, then inform Confessor Alvarado if and when we've brought him back to safety.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_1_Team: Release Brother Will and no harm will come to you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_1_NPCE: He's our brother now, and he won't come with you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_1_Team: I'll see your fury and raise you by a wrath.
Here's a warning for you: get out of my way or I'll kill you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_2_Team: What? We don't want to kill him, but to return him to the Children of Atom.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_2_NPCE: Well, you'd better talk to him then, as he doesn't want to go back.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_2_Team: If go through you we must, then go through you we will.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_2_NPCE: Just to be sure, you realize that's a figure of speech, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_2_Team: What do you mean, “under your protection?”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_2_NPCE: He asked us to save him from his Church brethren, who are trying to kill him.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_QuestObjective_1: Rescue Brother Will from the Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_3_NPCE: Why? Has he found it? If so, we're all doomed!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_3_Team: Why does he want to detonate this bomb?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_3_NPCE: He's convinced the sun is dying, and that a new one must be ignited to “save the Daylight.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_3_Team: When is this E-Ster supposed to take place?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSixthSun_Conversation_3_NPCE: Right after the ritual Deathclaw Egg Hunt, which is tomorrow.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_QuestLongDescripti: We've been invited to the Children of Atom's annual Deathclaw Egg Hunt! This is a good opportunity to validate Brother Will's claims that the Church plans to detonate a large nuclear bomb on E-Ster Sunday...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_QuestShortDescript: Find out more about the alleged nuclear bomb.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_1_Tea: Anything else we should look out for? Large, emits radiation...?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_1_NPC: I'm pretty sure I'm not supposed to know what you're talking about.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_1_Tea: This Egg Hunt is *the bomb*! Get it? The Bomb?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_1_NPC: I get it. I mean... I *don't* get it. Yeah, that last one.
Twenty, to be precise. Er, I mean... Enjoy!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_2_Tea: I thought I did, but it turned out to be some kind of big bomb?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_2_NPC: Oh yeah, that... Never mind that. Just find some eggs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_2_Tea: Do you really think this will save daylight?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_2_NPC: We'll find out soon after detonation... I mean, after we, uh, *atone* for our sins.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_2_Tea: Are you guys planning on detonating a nuclear bomb?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_Conversation_2_NPC: Why are you being so dramatic? Think of it more like “birthing a new sun.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ESterEggHunt_QuestObjective_1: Learn more about the alleged nuclear bomb.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_QuestLongDescrip: We need to stop Confessor Alvarado and the Church of the Children of Atom before they detonate their 20-megaton nuclear device, lest the entire area be vaporized!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_QuestShortDescri: Stop the Children of Atom from blowing up the area!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_1_T: Don't you guys realize the blast will kill you too?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_1_N: You're wrong! And don't count on us to reveal how Daylight Savings will let us live!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_1_T: Yeah, about that secrecy thing... you guys aren't very good at it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_1_N: If the Confessor were here instead of upstairs with the detonator, he'd tell you you're wrong!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_2_T: A good wash wouldn't do you any harm yourself...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_2_N: May Atom have mercy on your soul!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_2_T: You would sacrifice yourself for Atom?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_2_N: No need to, we'll all be spared - but you won't!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_2_T: If we're now on the Fifth Sun, what happend to the other ones?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_2_N: That's... a very good question. Let me get back to you on that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_3_T: I don't think that's how Daylight Saving is supposed to work...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_3_N: Silence! Your words have no power over me!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_3_T: You fool, you won't be transported into the future, you'll die as well!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_3_N: ♪ La la la la ♪  I can't hear you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_3_T: Why not wait until tomorrow, see if the sun is still there?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SavingDaylight_Conversation_3_N: Nice try! Now let me concentrate as I input the detonation code...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllSalesFinal_QuestLongDescript: Our new chef has some bold ideas to spruce up our daily fare, and he's made a list of specific ingredients he needs. We should visit a nearby abandoned Super-Duper Mart to see if we can find any of them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllSalesFinal_QuestShortDescrip: Retrieve ingredients from infested Super-Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllSalesFinal_QuestObjective_1: Search the Super-Duper Mart for ingredients.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllSalesFinal_Conversation_1_Te: So, is there any food left here at all?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllSalesFinal_Conversation_1_NP: There is now that *you* showed up!
Okay, first, that's rude. Second, there hasn't been any food here in months.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllSalesFinal_Conversation_1_Te: Sorry to trouble you. We're looking for these ingredients.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AllSalesFinal_Conversation_1_NP: I'm so sorry, there's no food left here. This is all we got.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThymeisMoney_QuestLongDescripti: All right, the Super-Duper Mart was a bust as far as ingredients go. This time, though, we have a sure lead to a cache of spice in a nearby building! And the chef is convinced the Raiders will just hand it over...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThymeisMoney_QuestShortDescript: Steal some spices from a band of Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThymeisMoney_Conversation_1_Tea: So many puns, so little thyme.
What's anise girl like you doing in a place like this?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThymeisMoney_Conversation_1_NPC: Careful, I don't saffron fools gladly.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThymeisMoney_Conversation_2_Tea: I have no idea what you're saying.
You know these are just seasonings, right? Like, to add flavor?
You're busted, buster! Hand over the mustard!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_QuestLongDescripti: The chef is happy - and surprised - that you made it back in one piece! He now requires processed cheese, AKA gray gold, the miracle food that endures the passage of time and nuclear war. Some may be left in the old Cheese Factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_QuestShortDescript: Obtain processed cheese from the abandoned factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_QuestObjective_1: Retrieve cheese paste from the factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_Conversation_1_Tea: We're just here to clean the gray goo off the machinery.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_Conversation_1_NPC: Really? Thanks! We were wondering how to get rid of it. We even tried this!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_Conversation_1_Tea: Not before we get what we came for.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_Conversation_1_NPC: All right, have it your way!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_Conversation_1_Tea: Our chef wants us to bring back processed cheese, and we will.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheesePlease_Conversation_1_NPC: You guys actually eat that? We could kill you, but this actually sounds worse...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_QuestLongDescript: The chef never ceases to be amazed by your uncanny ability to escape death, and he wants to celebrate it with a Radscorpion egg omelet. Vault 923 was recently overrun by these critters, so that'd be a good place to start.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_QuestShortDescrip: Bring Radscorpion eggs back to the chef.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_1_Te: We're here to harvest Radscorpion eggs, and nothing else.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_1_NP: Good, 'cause there ain't much else here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_1_Te: Our Vault isn't too far away. You should go there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_1_NP: Yeah, that's probably a good idea. You should leave too.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_2_Te: Wait a minute, did our chef hire you guys as well?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_2_NP: He probably thought you weren't up to the challenge. He was right!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_2_Te: Sorry, but we're getting those eggs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_2_NP: Tell you what: you kill the critters, cut them up, and we'll take it from there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_2_Te: Hey, what if we joined forces?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_Conversation_2_NP: And split our share of the eggs with you? No way, José!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheYolksonYou_QuestObjective_1: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion and harvest its eggs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_QuestLongDescription: Okay, so that Radscorpion omelet was kind of gross. To make up for it, the chef proposes to make his trademark Deathclaw Wellington. All he needs is fresh Deathclaw meat, straight from their den (sunlight is said to alter the taste).
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_QuestShortDescriptio: Bring Deathclaw meat back to the chef.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_Conversation_1_Team_: We were sent here by our borderline-homicidal chef.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_Conversation_1_NPCEn: So... a regular chef, then. Here, take this for your trouble.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_Conversation_1_Team_: We've come for some Deathclaw meat.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_Conversation_1_NPCEn: Why? It's so stringy it's barely edible. And the taste... yuck!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_Conversation_1_Team_: How come the Deathclaws haven't killed you yet?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_Conversation_1_NPCEn: As it turns out, I'm pretty good at playing dead.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HighSteaks_QuestObjective_1: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw and harvest its meat.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheToweringIlForno_QuestLongDes: That Deathclaw steak was a bit... stringy, to say the least. The chef feels bad about this, and wants to make his favorite comfort food, lasagna. Unfortunately, Raiders have stolen his secret sauce recipe, and we need to get it back from their towering lair first.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheToweringIlForno_Conversation: What was the second one again?
We're here to retrieve a top secret culinary document.
You're risking life and limb for a recipe? That's kind of sad.
We've been sent on another suicide mission by our chef.
Seems like he's got a bone to pick with you...
We came for the recipe. Hand it over.
Recipe? All I have is this blueprint for weaponized marinara.
I'm pretty sure our chef sent us here to get us killed.
Well, we wouldn't want to disappoint him now, would we?
We'd die for a good meal.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ByHookorbyCook_QuestLongDescrip: As it turns out, the chef *really* was trying to kill us all. Seems he's with a band of Raiders who've been eyeing our Vault. He fled as soon as he was exposed, but we know he's set to meet other Raiders at an abandoned Red Rocket.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ByHookorbyCook_Conversation_1_T: Bad food, bad service... I give this place one star.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ByHookorbyCook_Conversation_1_N: That's still indicative of a quality establishment!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ByHookorbyCook_Conversation_1_T: You cooked your last meal, chef.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ByHookorbyCook_Conversation_1_N: That was boeuf bourguignon, and it was spectacular!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ByHookorbyCook_Conversation_1_T: You'll pay for using rolled fondant on all your cakes!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ByHookorbyCook_Conversation_1_N: You try making marzipan without any almonds!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BugHunt_QuestLongDescription: Hunter Big Wes has put out a series of challenges for anyone brave enough. The first is to bag a Glowing Radroach. Time to lock and load!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BugHunt_QuestShortDescription: Kill the Glowing Radroach in the factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhackaMole_QuestLongDescription: Now Big Wes wants you to kill a Mole rat brood mother, with one catch. You can only use pistols. Good luck piercing moleskin with those!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhackaMole_QuestShortDescriptio: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhackaMole_QuestObjective_1: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AimfortheHead_QuestLongDescript: Time to go after something a little smarter: Feral Ghouls! And speaking of smart, you'll have to do it wearing lab coats!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RockThemLikeAHurricane_QuestLon: Let's see how you fare against a nest full of Radscorpions. Oh, and this time, you can only have two people in your squad.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheMostDangerousGame_QuestLongD: Looks like you need a bigger challenge. How about hunting some humans for a change? This time you can only wear your Vault suits.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_12PointBuck_QuestLongDescriptio: “I once shot a Deathclaw in my pajamas. How he got in my pajamas I'll never know.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheFinalHunt_QuestLongDescripti: Big Wes is calling you out! Time to dethrone him and become the Wasteland's number one big game hunter.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheFinalHunt_QuestShortDescript: Track down and take out Big Wes.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HaveGunWillTravel_QuestLongDesc: You found the holotape records of Maxson's Roughnecks, a Brotherhood of Steel team searching the Wasteland for technology. Track them down to discover their fate - starting at Vault 450!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HaveGunWillTravel_QuestShortDes: Discover the fate of Maxson's Roughnecks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HaveGunWillTravel_Conversation_: Yeah! Do you know where they went?
I think they headed to the Wilson Atomatoys Factory. Good luck!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ToySoldiers_QuestLongDescriptio: A Dweller told me that Maxson's Roughnecks made their way to the Wilson Atomatoys Factory. That should be my next stop.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ToySoldiers_QuestShortDescripti: Look for Maxson's Roughnecks at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ToySoldiers_Conversation_1_Team: You mean the Roughnecks? Where did they go?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ToySoldiers_Conversation_1_NPCE: The survivors ran off to Poseidon Energy's Offices. Too bad you won't be so lucky!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NoStoneUnturned_QuestLongDescri: Some of Maxson's Roughnecks were killed at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory, the rest retreated to the Poseidon Energy Offices. That's where I need to go.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NoStoneUnturned_QuestShortDescr: Find the rest of Maxson's Roughnecks at the Poseidon Energy Offices.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NoStoneUnturned_Conversation_1_: My pleasure. Where did the rest of your team go?
The few that are left decided to cleanse the Nuka-Cola Plant of its Feral Ghoul infestation.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SlashandBurn_QuestLongDescripti: One of Maxson's Roughnecks told me his team went to clear out a Nuka-Cola Plant. Looks like that's the next stop on my hunt.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SlashandBurn_QuestShortDescript: Search the Nuka-Cola Plant for Maxson's Roughnecks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SlashandBurn_Conversation_1_Tea: I'm so sorry. Can I help?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SlashandBurn_Conversation_1_NPC: No, just save the rest of my team. They're trapped in Vault 390.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MissionofMercy_QuestLongDescrip: I stumbled across a Ghoul who used to be one of Maxson's Roughnecks. He told me the rest of his team is trapped in Vault 390. It's time for a rescue mission!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheFinalPush_QuestLongDescripti: A Raider Boss in the ruins of Vault 390 told me that Maxson's Roughnecks are in Vault-Tec Headquarters. I'm concerned for their safety, so I better armor up and hurry!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheFinalPush_QuestShortDescript: Find Maxson's Roughnecks in the Vault-Tec Headquarters.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheFinalPush_Conversation_1_NPC: Likewise, soldier. Here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
Suit yourself. Here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
Hmph. Well, here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheFinalPush_Conversation_1_Tea: You should be more careful next time.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheFinalPush_Conversation_1_NPC: We will. Here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FollowingHisFirstSteps_QuestLon: Famed Minuteman, Preston Garvey, has gone missing! Search for clues to his whereabouts at his last known location.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FollowingHisFirstSteps_QuestSho: Search for clues to Preston Garvey's location.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FollowingHisFirstSteps_QuestObj: Search the office building for clues.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FollowingHisFirstSteps_Conversa: Yes! That's the one. Left here and headed to that factory across the river to take out Road Rash and his gang of Raiders!
Did he mention where he was going?
He was heading towards the automobile factory to take out that Raider gang living there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaiderTroublesatCorvega_QuestLo: The path has led you to the home of Road Rash and his gang of Raiders! Find out if they know anything.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaiderTroublesatCorvega_QuestSh: Search for Preston in the Corvega Factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaiderTroublesatCorvega_Convers: What did you do with Preston?
Nothing, he left before we could catch him. Said some settlers were stuck in a Mole rat den. But enough talk, now you die!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhenPrestonCalls_QuestLongDescr: A group of settlers is stuck in a Mole rat den. Word is, they have info on Preston Garvey. Go help them out of their jam!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhenPrestonCalls_QuestShortDesc: Get more information to find Preston.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhenPrestonCalls_Conversation_1: Did he say where he was going?
Said there were some settlers that had been kidnapped by Raiders. They're in Vault 778. Here, take this uniform. I sure won't need it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhenPrestonCalls_QuestObjective: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KidnappingatVault778_QuestLongD: Some Raiders have kidnapped some settlers and have them held hostage at Vault 778. Maybe they know where Preston Garvey went.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KidnappingatVault778_QuestShort: Save the kidnapped settlers in Vault 778.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KidnappingatVault778_Conversati: Think he said something about the Kendall Hospital. Take this. He left it on accident, but I think you could use it.
He didn't say. Not that it matters, you're never leaving this room alive!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASettlerNeedsYourHelp_QuestLong: Minuteman Preston Garvey has gotten himself stuck in the Kendall Hospital surrounded by Feral Ghouls and who knows what else. Save him!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASettlerNeedsYourHelp_QuestShor: Find Preston Garvey in the Kendall Hospital.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASettlerNeedsYourHelp_QuestObje: Find Preston Garvey in Kendall Hospital.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASettlerNeedsYourHelp_Conversat: Any bad guys I should look out for around here?
There's a Glowing One I saw somewhere around here. Look out for her.
There's a bunch of supplies in the Manager's Office if you haven't found it yet. Might be something useful.
“Protect the people at a minute's notice.” That was the idea.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SOS_QuestLongDescription: You've picked up a distress call from an abandoned building. Assemble a rescue team and find the source!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SOS_QuestShortDescription: Find the source of the distress call.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SOS_Conversation_1_Team_1: Dognapping is a crime. I'll get him back!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SOS_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_1: You're a real hero! I don't have any Caps, but maybe you can make use of this.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SOS_Conversation_1_Team_2: If anything's toast, it's your dog.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SOS_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_2: I don't believe it! No one makes a hot dog out of Bigsby. I can't pay you, but maybe you can make some use of this.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CanineRecovery_QuestLongDescrip: I need to search an old warehouse to try and find Bigsby. The Raiders are using it as a hideout, so I'll need to be careful.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CanineRecovery_QuestShortDescri: Look for Bigsby in the old warehouse.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CanineRecovery_Conversation_1_N: That flea bag ran off with the others. Probably to Vault 199. It'll be the first place we look once we're finished with you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Vault199_QuestLongDescription: The Raiders mentioned Bigsby may have fled to Vault 199. I should go ask around. Hopefully, the Dwellers have him.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Vault199_Conversation_1_Team_1: Has a dog named Bigsby stopped by here?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Vault199_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: No dogs here. Try our sister Vault: 899. They're classier. But first, take this as our token of thanks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_InAnotherVault_QuestLongDescrip: Bigsby wasn't in Vault 199, but a member told me he may be in their sister Vault: 899. I should go check it out.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_InAnotherVault_Conversation_1_T: No, but I'm looking for a dog that was with them named Bigsby.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_InAnotherVault_Conversation_1_N: Our salvage team took Bigsby to the Atomatoys warehouse, but hasn't returned. Take this. You'll need it if you look for them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheTailContinues_QuestLongDescr: Overseer Emma said Bigsby stopped by their Vault. Since then, a salvage team took him on a run with them to the Atomatoys warehouse, but hasn't returned.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheTailContinues_QuestShortDesc: Find the salvage team from Vault 899 in the old Atomatoys Warehouse.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheTailContinues_Conversation_1: No, do you know where they went?
They're a couple of tough cookies. I'm betting Sally would've taken cover in Vault 314. It's abandoned, so be careful!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NoTimeforPaws_QuestLongDescript: I rescued the salvage team, but Bigsby wasn't with them. One said they may have taken shelter in Vault 314.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NoTimeforPaws_QuestShortDescrip: Find Sally and Bigsby in Vault 314.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NoTimeforPaws_Conversation_1_Te: I'm here to find Bigsby, and bring him home. Please say he's with you...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NoTimeforPaws_Conversation_1_NP: I didn't realize he already had a home! You're one lucky owner. Here he is! Bigsby! You can come out now!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JourneytotheCenterofVaultopolis: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TruthAmongtheAshes_QuestLongDes: Vault 333 has been ransacked, but maybe there's a clue to Paula Plumbkin's whereabouts!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TruthAmongtheAshes_QuestShortDe: Search Vault 333 for a clue to Paula Plumbkin's whereabouts.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Overrun_QuestLongDescription: Overseer Patel's journal indicated Paula Plumbkin had gone to Vault 909, but that it had already been overrun! Hopefully she's okay...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Overrun_Conversation_1_Team_1: Yes! Tell us where Paula Plumbkin went.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Overrun_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_1: Fine. She said something about the nuclear power plant. Now die!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PoweredUp_QuestLongDescription: The Radscorpion's creepy keeper said Paula Plumbkin went to the nuclear power plant, so that's where we'll look for her.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PoweredUp_QuestShortDescription: Search the nuclear power plant for Paula Plumbkin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PoweredUp_QuestObjective_1: Search the nuclear power plant for Paula Plumbkin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheRoadtoVaultopolis_QuestLongD: A friendly Ghoul in the nuclear power plant told us Paula Plumbkin continued her search for Vaultopolis in Vault 813. We're hot on her tail!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheVaultTecVantage_QuestLongDes: Vault 813's Overseer Alvarez told us the same thing he told Paula Plumbkin - to search the Vault-Tec offices for info on Vaultopolis!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheVaultTecVantage_QuestShortDe: The Vault-Tec offices may hold info on Vaultopolis...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheVaultTecVantage_QuestObjecti: Search the Vault-Tec offices for info on Vaultopolis.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheQuestforVault525_QuestLongDe: We need to find Vault 525, but our supplies are running low. It's time to visit the Super Duper Mart and scavenge whatever we can before continuing our search.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheQuestforVault525_QuestShortD: We're looking for Vault 525, but need to resupply first.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheQuestforVault525_QuestObject: Resupply at the Super Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PlayingPolitics_QuestLongDescri: According to a page from Paula Plumbkin's journal, Vault 525 really is Vaultopolis, but even she doesn't know where it is. But the Mayor's office may hold that information!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PlayingPolitics_QuestShortDescr: We need to search the Mayor's office to find the location of Vault 525.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PlayingPolitics_QuestObjective_: Search the Mayor's office for info on Vault 525's location.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheRedRocketReveal_QuestLongDes: The official documentation Vault-Tec sent to the Mayor's office said that the entrance of Vault 525, a.k.a. Vaultopolis, is hidden in the Red Rocket Headquarters! What are you waiting for? Get to Vault 525!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheRedRocketReveal_QuestShortDe: The entrance to Vault 525 is in the Red Rocket Headquarters!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheRedRocketReveal_Conversation: Well. Gotta admit. I did NOT see that coming.
Vaultopolis is in the Shaded Valley! Take that to your grave!
Morons! Vaultopolis is in the Shaded Valley! And you'll never see it!
So if Vaultopolis isn't here, where is it?
In the Shaded Valley, if you must know! Now prepare to die!
You treacherous tart! You'll never rule Vaultopolis!
Oh yes I will! I know where it is, too! The Shaded Valley! Muhahaha!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultopolisAwaits_QuestLongDesc: Paula Plumbkin turned out to be an evil Raider wannabe, but at least she gave us the location of Vault 525, otherwise known as Vaultopolis!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultopolisAwaits_QuestShortDes: Vaultopolis is in the Shaded Valley - time to complete our Quest!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WithFriendsLikeThese_QuestLongD: I've found a ransom note written by a Raider Boss named Willard Glover. He says he's captured a settler and taken him to the nearby Corvega Factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WithFriendsLikeThese_QuestShort: Rescue the settler trapped in the Corvega Factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WelcometoParadise_QuestLongDesc: I've discovered a map leading to Vault 242, where the “Dwellers” were all creatures rather than humans. I should follow the map and unlock the secrets this Vault has to offer.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Getting Started_QuestLongDescri: For your training mission, Vault-Tec asks you to prove yourself as a worthy Overseer and kill a Glowing Radroach.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Getting Started_QuestShortDescr: Kill the Glowing Radroach and complete your training.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OutoftheVaultIntotheShadows_Que: Out of the Vault, Into the Shadows
For too long, the evil bandit Eli Calvert has raided the innocent Dwellers of the Wasteland. For the safety of your Vault, assemble your soldiers and rain death upon Eli and his gang of madmen!
Destroy Eli Calvert's Raiders with your Military Death Squad.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OutoftheVaultIntotheShadows_Con: You've brought this upon yourself, Eli Calvert.
Whatever, like I care. Get ready to die!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HotTubSlimeMachine_QuestLongDes: Rumors have been circulating about a Vault with a pool, sauna, and even a hot tub! Search Vault 189 to find this oasis of relaxation, but beware of the ghoul infestation!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HotTubSlimeMachine_QuestShortDe: Find the pool room in Vault 189.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GameofVaults_QuestLongDescripti: Hear ye, Hear ye! A fierce and loathsome beast has been terrorizing the villagers throughout the land. Track it to its lair and slay the creature.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GameofVaults_Conversation_1_Tea: Hark, fair maiden! It is I, your savior. Come forth and ride with me out of this beast's den.
