resolvedText.QuestLoc_GameofVaults_Conversation_1_NPC: Uh... ok, whatever, let's just go...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Firestarter_QuestLongDescriptio: One of your Dwellers is a serial arsonist. We've decided to employ their talents outside the Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Firestarter_QuestShortDescripti: Send a lone Vault Dweller with a Flamethrower out to wreak havoc!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ChooChoo_QuestLongDescription: One of your Dwellers won't stop calling themselves “The Pain Train.” Let's make that nickname a reality...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ChooChoo_QuestShortDescription: Send a lone Vault Dweller with a Railway Rifle out to wreak havoc!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BewareofOverdog_QuestLongDescri: The Overseer from Vault 850 has sent us a distress signal! The catch is the Overseer is apparently a dog...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BewareofOverdog_QuestShortDescr: Go to Vault 850 and find the Overseer.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BewareofOverdog_Conversation_1_: How'd a dog get to be Overseer?
He was the most qualified, obviously. What's that, Overseer? You want to go with them? I suppose I could run things while you're gone...
Well, we're glad to have helped...
Wait! I think our Overseer wants to go with you. He says it'll help diplomatic relations between our two Vaults.
We're almost 100% certain that you're crazy.
No, I'm not! Tell them I'm not crazy, Overseer! What's that? Oh, you want to go with them? I guess that would be all right...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OverwhelmingForce_QuestLongDesc: There's no sense toying around with Raiders when we can just crush them! Send a group loaded with Power Armor out to a local Raider camp and deal with their Boss.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OverwhelmingForce_QuestShortDes: Send a group of Dwellers in Power Armor to clear out a Raider camp.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_QueenoftheDeathclaws_QuestLongD: A Raider calling herself the Queen of the Deathclaws has been terrorizing the Wasteland!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_QueenoftheDeathclaws_QuestShort: Defeat an Alpha Deathclaw and the Raider controlling it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_QueenoftheDeathclaws_QuestObjec: Kill the Queen of the Deathclaws.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReignofRadroachRodney_QuestLong: Radroach Rodney and his army of mind-controlled Radroaches are invading the Wasteland!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReignofRadroachRodney_QuestShor: Defeat Radroach Rodney and his Radroaches!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandDoctoring_QuestLongDes: We've picked up a radio transmission. A nearby settlement has sick and wounded in need of help!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandDoctoring_QuestShortDe: Bring medical aid to a nearby settlement.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandDoctoring_Conversation: Don't worry. We'll patch you all up.
You've saved this settlement. Here. You deserve everything we can afford to give!
You owe us big time, but I guess we'll help.
Thank you! Here. It's everything we have.
Speedy medical service! Courtesy of your friendly neighborhood Vault!
You Vault Dwellers are amazing! Thank you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DiplomaticMission_QuestLongDesc: A local settlement wants to make contact with our Vault! We should send some diplomats.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DiplomaticMission_QuestShortDes: Send a team in Formal Wear out to talk to a settlement.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DiplomaticMission_Conversation_: Very well. Here's what we have!
We'll take whatever weapons you have.
I think we can spare a few implements of destruction.
Our Vault has great fashion sense. We want more outfits.
I think we have something right up your alley!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Broadsides_QuestLongDescription: What's this about a New Boston Bugle? It's a chance to have our exploits published for all the world to see! Fame! Fortune! Caps!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Broadsides_QuestShortDescriptio: Find out about the New Boston Bugle.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Broadsides_QuestObjective_1: Learn about the New Boston Bugle.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Broadsides_Conversation_1_Team_: How did you get ahold of a copy of the Bugle?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Broadsides_Conversation_1_NPCEn: We got a back issue from Vault 819. Until then all we had to read was an old copy of “One Ghoul, Two Ghoul.”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Broadsides_Conversation_1_Team_: So you can get in the Bugle by kicking butt and taking names?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Broadsides_Conversation_1_NPCEn: That's right! We're heading out to hunt some Raiders - I'm destined to be a front page star! Vault 819 look out!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headshots_QuestLongDescription: We've discovered that someone is printing new editions of the Boston Bugle and making stars out of schlubs - we're destined for fame and fortune!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headshots_QuestShortDescription: Find out more about the New Boston Bugle.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headshots_QuestObjective_1: Learn more about the New Boston Bugle.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headshots_Conversation_1_Team_1: If you're so great, then why is your Vault infested with vermin?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headshots_Conversation_1_NPCEnd: Everyone's in the Wasteland, looking for fame - who has time for stomping bugs? We have to beat Vault 404!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AMaptotheStars_QuestLongDescrip: The Overseer of 404 appears to have a way to get in contact with the publisher of the New Boston Bugle. She's our ticket to stardom!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AMaptotheStars_QuestShortDescri: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 404 about the New Bugle.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AMaptotheStars_QuestObjective_1: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 404.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AMaptotheStars_Conversation_1_T: What are you going to do now?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AMaptotheStars_Conversation_1_N: We're headed to Vault 120... They were the stars of the latest edition of the New Boston Bugle...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AMaptotheStars_Conversation_1_T: Do you know who is publishing the Bugle?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AMaptotheStars_Conversation_1_N: No idea, I was just a worker in the diner. Maybe the Overseer of 120 will know?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheThinlyVeiledPlotThickens_Que: Vault 404 was destroyed in a Raider attack... but Vault 120 might have more information.
Talk to the Overseer at Vault 120 about the New Bugle.
Talk to the Overseer of Vault 120.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheThinlyVeiledPlotThickens_Con: After he visits the settlers at the RobCo Plant, he comes here to get updates on supplies and treasure to bring back to the Editor.
Any idea where the Bugle's offices are located?
I'd talk to the settlers at the RobCo Plant. They were the first to get hit. They'd know the more about the Bugle Boy and his Editor.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CollateralMurder_QuestLongDescr: It seems like if you get mentioned in the New Boston Bugle, you end up with your head on a Raider pike. Now we have to figure how to NOT make the front page!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CollateralMurder_QuestShortDesc: Find the first group of settlers to get attacked by Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CollateralMurder_QuestObjective: Meet the Settlers at the RobCo Plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CollateralMurder_Conversation_1: Do you know where he is?
Oh yeah. We've been watching him, waiting for the right time to strike. Try the old Super Duper-Mart about a click north of here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BoogieWoogieBugleBoy_QuestLongD: Turns out the New Boston Bugle is some kind of con - our only lead is the Bugle Boy who is holed up in a Super-Duper Mart. Time to track him down and extract some information!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BoogieWoogieBugleBoy_Conversati: No? Because it says right here on the masthead that the New Boston Bugle is published out of the Nuka-Cola Warehouse.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_StopthePresses_QuestLongDescrip: We've found out that the whole “New Boston Bugle” thing is a total scam. We have to hunt down the Editor and put him out of business.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_StopthePresses_Conversation_1_T: We'll take the Caps. Just keep your Raiders away from our Vault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_StopthePresses_Conversation_1_N: Smart move! We would have wiped the floor with you. Here's your loot.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_StopthePresses_Conversation_1_T: Lying is lying and people are dying! We're here to stop you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheMysteriousDisappearingSpuds_: All across the Commonwealth, Tatos are being wiped out by a mysterious blight. Settlers are starving! Maybe we can help.
Find out more about the Tato blight.
No, but we've heard you're not the only ones who have been hit by this. Do you know any other farmers that have lost Tatos?
There's a crew holed up at an old factory up the street - check with them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSpreadingBlight_QuestLongDes: We've found out from a group of farmers that the Tato blight isn't restricted to just one location - it's hitting multiple farms throughout the Wasteland!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSpreadingBlight_QuestShortDe: Meet up with another group of farmers that have been hit by the Tato blight.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSpreadingBlight_QuestObjecti: Get more information on the Tato blight.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSpreadingBlight_Conversation: We're not botanists, but we want to help - what's their theory??
You'll have to ask them - we need to put in a new crop!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheNightWatch_QuestLongDescript: We've found out there's a group of settlers that has more information about the widespread Tato die-outs. Let's talk to them and see what they know.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheNightWatch_QuestShortDescrip: Find out more about the alternate theory concerning the Tato blight.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheNightWatch_QuestObjective_1: Get more information on the Tato blight.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheNightWatch_Conversation_1_NP: I'd try McClure's Place. They were the first to get hit and already put down a second crop as bait.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpearFishing_QuestLongDescripti: It turns out that this isn't a disease - someone has figured out how to steal Tatos from underground! We need to meet with the group that's figured it out.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpearFishing_QuestShortDescript: Meet up with the first Tato farmers to lose their Tatos.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpearFishing_QuestObjective_1: Meet the first farmers to lose their crops.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpearFishing_Conversation_1_Tea: How do you train Mole rats to do anything?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpearFishing_Conversation_1_NPC: Beats me. We sent our best tracker, Shadow Wolf, to follow their tunnels back to their source. He headed north, left an hour ago.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheShadowWolf_QuestLongDescript: Some nefarious person has been training Mole rats to steal Tatos from under people's noses. We need to meet with a tracker who might have found the source.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheShadowWolf_QuestShortDescrip: Meet the tracker who may have found the source of the Mole rat infestation that's targeting Tatos.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheMoleRatMan_QuestLongDescript: A lunatic who calls himself Mole rat Man has been training Mole rats to attack settlements and steal their Tatos. Now's the time to strike!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheMoleRatMan_QuestShortDescrip: Confront Mole Rat Man at his base.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheCapturedCanine_Ques: The Case of the Captured Canine
You've discovered some unsolved case files of the legendary Wasteland detective, Nick Valentine! First up - the case of the captured canine!
Feral Ghouls have captured a canine! Rescue the potentially delicious doggie.
Rescue the dog from the Feral Ghouls.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheCapturedCanine_Conv: Thanks for the heads up! You're not so bad... for a Ghoul.
Yikes! Then there's no time to waste!
How come you're being, you know... reasonable?
Cause my daddy raised me right! Also, because I still have a fairly intact amygdala.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheMissingMitt_QuestNa: The Case of the Missing Mitt
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheMissingMitt_QuestLo: A note among Nick's files requested his help in recovering a lost family heirloom - a pre-war catcher's mitt with great sentimental value.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheMissingMitt_QuestSh: Help an old Ghoul recover a precious family heirloom, would ya?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheMissingMitt_Convers: What if I just talk to them instead? Ask for the mitt back?
Fine. Whatever. So long as I get what's mine.
Rough them up? Sounds like fun.
That's the spirit. Now get going. That mitt ain't going to return itself.
How do you know it was this “whippersnapper”?
Cause there ain't no one else around. Now, I ain't looking for an interrogation. I just want that mitt back. So go.
What's so special about this mitt?
It's mine. That's what's special. And I won't have folks stealing from me. Now how about you hop to it, eh?
Any idea who might've taken it?
Nope, but it didn't walk off on its own. Might be someone else around who snatched it.
Clarence suggested I rough you up. You want to give me a reason not to?
Hey, hey. Let's not do anything hasty here. I'll give you some of the other stuff I “recovered.” Now, don't you have a mitt to recover?
Honestly? Guy just rubbed me the wrong way. Wanted to wipe that droopy grin off his face.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheQuantumCreeper_Ques: The Case of the Quantum Creeper
Nick was asked to solve the mystery of “The Quantum Creeper,” a beast that's been munching on the citizens of a local Vault and stealing their Quantum. What say you lend them a hand?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheQuantumCreeper_Conv: Oh thank goodness. Last time anyone spotted it, it was further into the Vault. Please. Take care of that beast before it kills again!
Are you going to make it worth my while?
Seriously? Fine. Here. Just make sure you take care of that thing, okay?
Well, I didn't get a good look at it, but I can tell you it's hideous. Three heads, quick as a shot. But most of all, it loves Quantum. Stole every last bottle we had!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheLostLunch_QuestName: The Case of the Lost Lunch
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheLostLunch_QuestLong: You uncovered a poorly written note among Nick's files, asking for his help in finding a kidnapped friend.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheLostLunch_QuestShor: Someone's been kidnapped! Help bring them home!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheCaseoftheLostLunch_Conversat: Tell me the truth and I'll consider helping. Did you steal from them?
What? No! We didn't take nothing. I mean, look at this place. What's to steal? Now, please, go help my pal, huh?
I'll help, but only if you stop robbing people.
You will? Oh thank you! And sure, sure. I won't rob no one. Scout's honor. Heh.
I'm not doing it for free.
Does that mean you'll do it? Oh thank you! And yeah, here. This is all I got on me.
You think I want to do this? But we're starving here! Look, you find our grub, maybe we could consider letting him loose.
Woah! No need for that! But we're not letting that Raider go until we get our food back. You find it, then maybe we'll let him go.
How do you know he did it?
Well if it wasn't that Raider, then who was it? Look, you find that food, then maybe we'll consider letting the Raider go.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBigsbyBrownCase_QuestLongDes: Nick's old pal Bigsby Brown has gone missing. An old file suggests he'd gone out in search of a missing Vault Dweller, but no one's heard from him since. Track down that sleuth!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBigsbyBrownCase_QuestShortDe: Track down missing sleuth Bisgby Brown.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBigsbyBrownCase_Conversation: Great! Here, take this. Good deeds ought to be rewarded. Now get moving! There's no time to waste!
I'm in no shape to take on those Deathclaws myself. But I won't make you do it for free. Take this and get going! There's no time to waste!
How about you come live at my Vault?
Really? Oh, that'd be great! Thanks again! Now let's get out of here!
Actually, I don't need another mouth to feed.
Ah. I see. Well, thanks for the rescue anyway. Now let's get out of here!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SignalFailure_QuestLongDescript: You've picked up a distress signal emanating from the supposedly abandoned Vault 233. It's up to you to investigate.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SignalFailure_QuestShortDescrip: Follow up on the old distress signal emanating from Vault 233!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SignalFailure_QuestObjective_1: Find the source of the Vault 233 distress signal.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TakeMeOuttotheBallGame_QuestNam: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TakeMeOuttotheBallGame_QuestLon: Slugger the Raider is hosting a baseball game, but he forgot to invite you. Time to throw him out at home plate.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TakeMeOuttotheBallGame_QuestSho: Beat Slugger the Raider at his own game.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TakeMeOuttotheBallGame_Conversa: It's a hit! Actually, lots of hits.
I'll hold. I think you'll throw a ball.
Ball four! You get to walk, home that is.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MallMadness_QuestLongDescriptio: Who knew shopping could be so dangerous?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RevengeoftheGeeks_QuestLongDesc: Who says accountants are wimps? Answer the questions or face the consequences.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RevengeoftheGeeks_Conversation_: Wrong! That's going to hurt your grade.
If you want to pass this course, you do.
Wrong! Do you even know what a prime number is?
Hmmph. I guess you got that one right.
The only prime I want is a prime rib.
That's it. Detention for a week!
Hah! You failed this pop quiz.
Then I guess you flunk this course.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogShelter_QuestLongDescription: Someone let Fido out without a leash. Guess you'll need to get him back.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogShelter_Conversation_1_Team_: Can a Ghoul even take care of a pet?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogShelter_Conversation_1_NPCEn: I keep telling them to be gentle.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogShelter_Conversation_1_Team_: You mean you got them lunch.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogShelter_Conversation_1_NPCEn: They would never eat my gift.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ArghMatey_QuestLongDescription: Grandpa wants to play Pirates, but he needs a Parrot first.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DuoofDestructionMoleRatBroodMot: Duo of Destruction: Mole Rat Brood Mothers
Two Mole rat brood mothers have been spotted at the nearby dog food factory. It's about time someone took them down.
Eliminate the two Mole rat brood mothers at the old dog food factory!
Eliminate the first Mole rat brood mother.
Eliminate the second Mole rat brood mother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DuoofDestructionGlowingRadroach: Two Glowing Radroaches have chased the residents of the “Nuclear Arms Apartments” out of their home. Time for a little exterminating.
Exterminate the pair of Glowing Radroaches residing at the Nuclear Arms Apartments!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DuoofDestructionGlowingOnex2_Qu: A pair of Glowing Ones have taken over an old Fusion Core factory. Toss those Ghouls out on their keisters!
Put down the pair of Glowing Ones at the old Fusion Core factory!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DuoofDestructionGlowingRadscorp: Two Glowing Radscorpions are causing havoc in Vault 512! Squash those bugs good!
Exterminate both of the Glowing Radscorpions in Vault 512!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DuoofDestructionAlphaDeathclaws: Two Alpha Deathclaws have decided to make their home at the old Grotton Depot. Yikes! Time to bring out the big guns!
Put down an angry pair of Alpha Deathclaws!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyOlOneEye_QuestLongDescrip: Someone's put a bounty on the head of a meddlesome Radroach known as 'Ol One-Eye. Swat that bug and claim your reward!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyOlOneEye_QuestShortDescri: Help 'Ol One-Eye shuffle off this mortal coil and collect your bounty!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyBash_QuestLongDescription: The Raider Boss known as “Bash” has made one too many enemies. Claim the bounty on his head!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyBash_QuestShortDescriptio: Take down the Raider Boss Bash and claim your reward!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyShiner_QuestLongDescripti: The Glowing One known as “Shiner” has made trouble for the last time. Put him on ice to claim your reward.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyShiner_QuestShortDescript: Take down the Glowing One known as Shiner and claim your reward!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyYak_QuestLongDescription: The Mole rat brood mother known as “Yak” has stolen her last snackcake! Whack Yak to claim your reward.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyYak_QuestShortDescription: Take down the Mole rat brood mother known as Yak and claim your reward!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountySnips_QuestLongDescriptio: There's a bounty out on “Snips,” a Glowing Radscorpion. Put down that pest and the reward's as good as yours.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountySnips_QuestShortDescripti: Exterminate the Glowing Radscorpion known as “Snips” and claim the bounty on its carapace!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyButcher_QuestLongDescript: There's a bounty on an Alpha Deathclaw known as “Butcher.” Don't worry. I'm sure it's just a nickname. But take her down and you'll earn yourself a hefty prize.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BountyButcher_QuestShortDescrip: Eliminate the Alpha Deathclaw known as “Butcher” to collect your bounty!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HittingtheBooks_QuestLongDescri: As Halloween approaches, the story of Vault 31 and its strange past is being told once again. But is the Vault really haunted, or is something else to blame? It's up to you to solve... The Mystery of Vault 31!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HittingtheBooks_QuestShortDescr: Learn more about Vault 31 at the ruined library.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HittingtheBooks_QuestObjective_: Learn more about Vault 31 at the ruined library.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HittingtheBooks_Conversation_1_: Do you know anything about Vault 31?
No, but ask Herb Vest at the old candy factory. And here, take my costume.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoWest_QuestLongDescription: The library caretaker told me someone named Herb Vest might know more about Vault 31. I can track him down at the old candy factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoWest_QuestShortDescription: Seek advice about Vault 31 from Herb Vest.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoWest_QuestObjective_1: Search for Herb Vest at the old candy factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoWest_Conversation_1_Team_1: I'm trying to find out anything I can about Vault 31.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoWest_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_1: Anyone that goes near it disappears. I think it's haunted! Vault-Tec's local office might have more.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DaysGoneBye_QuestLongDescriptio: Herb Vest told me that people who go to Vault 31 end up missing. I'm going to head to Vault-Tec's offices to learn more about the Vault's past.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DaysGoneBye_QuestShortDescripti: Search the Vault-Tec offices for information about Vault 31.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DaysGoneBye_QuestObjective_1: Track down information about Vault 31's past.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DaysGoneBye_Conversation_1_Team: Then it's time to turn the tables on those Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DaysGoneBye_Conversation_1_NPCE: Hmm, maybe you could scare them away with Ghost Costumes from the old costume factory nearby!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_QuestLongDescripti: In order to scare the Raiders away from Vault 31, a helpful traveler suggested getting Ghost Costumes from an old factory nearby.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_QuestShortDescript: Get the Ghost Costumes from the old costume factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_QuestObjective_1: Get the Ghost Costumes from the factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_Conversation_1_Tea: I fear ending this day with unnecessary bloodshed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_Conversation_1_NPC: Your restraint has impressed us. You may leave unharmed.
Then you'll never leave here alive!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_Conversation_1_Tea: I fear turning into an ugly mug like you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_Conversation_1_NPC: Your bravery has impressed us. You may leave unharmed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_Conversation_1_Tea: No games! Just let me have what I came here for.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MaskHysteria_Conversation_1_NPC: You've just taken your last breath!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScareTactics_QuestLongDescripti: With the Ghost Costumes in hand, it's time to head out to Vault 31 and confront the Raiders there once and for all!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScareTactics_Conversation_1_Tea: Boooo! Leave this place and never come baaaaaack!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScareTactics_Conversation_1_NPC: We will, we promise! Here, take this... it's everything we have.
Wait, what? It's not a ghost... get 'em!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScareTactics_Conversation_1_Tea: I can't believe this actually worked.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScareTactics_Conversation_1_NPC: Huh? Hey! It's just a costume... get 'em!
Hallow-what? Hey! This ghost is a fake... get 'em!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhostlyGag_QuestLongDescription: Raiders are so superstitious. Let's give them something to be scared of.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhostlyGag_Conversation_1_Team_: Oooo. I am the ghost of your grandmother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhostlyGag_Conversation_1_NPCEn: Wait, my grandmother is still alive. You're no ghost!
It's not my time. I'm not going easy.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheHauntingofVault110_QuestLong: Like most bullies, Raiders are usually cowards. Rumor has it the Raider Boss who just took over the Mass Chemical building is exactly that, so maybe you can scare him off without a fight.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheHauntingofVault110_QuestShor: Scare off a Raider Boss holed up in the Mass Chemical building.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheHauntingofVault110_Conversat: You've defiled my resting place, mortal! Leave at once!
I... I didn't know! I promise, I'll leave!
What?! A disguise? I'll make you a ghost for real!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HorrorMovieNight_QuestLongDescr: One of your Dwellers is feeling... “inspired” by a horror movie he watched.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HorrorMovieNight_QuestShortDesc: Send out a lone Vault Dweller wearing a Ghost Costume to wreak havoc!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ClearingAPath_QuestLongDescript: There's a group of soldiers called the “Brotherhood of Steel” that insist the Vault would be an ideal outpost! To meet their standards, we're going to have to provide a little bit of fire support. We'll start at the nearby machine parts factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ClearingAPath_QuestShortDescrip: Provide fire support at the machine parts factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ClearingAPath_QuestObjective_1: Clear a path for the Brotherhood of Steel squad at the factory.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ClearingAPath_Conversation_1_Te: Thanks. What else can I do to help?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ClearingAPath_Conversation_1_NP: How about clearing Vault 840 of those nasty Ghouls? Good luck, soldier!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TakingOuttheTrash_QuestLongDesc: In order to convince the Brotherhood of Steel that the Vault is worthy enough to be one of their outposts, we're clearing the Ghouls out of Vault 840.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TakingOuttheTrash_QuestObjectiv: Clear the Ghouls out of Vault 840.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TakingOuttheTrash_Conversation_: I'm honored. What are my orders?
Another squad could use your support at the RobCo Corporate Offices!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HeatoftheKnight_QuestLongDescri: We need to convince the Brotherhood of Steel that the Vault is worthy enough to be an outpost! Time to support the squad of soldiers at the RobCo Corporate Offices.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HeatoftheKnight_QuestShortDescr: Support the Brotherhood at the RobCo Corporate Offices.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HeatoftheKnight_QuestObjective_: Support the soldiers at the RobCo Corporate Offices.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HeatoftheKnight_Conversation_1_: Rest yourself. I'll save your squad leader.
Thank you, Knight! If you hurry, you can find them at the Nuka-Cola Plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_InShiningArmor_QuestLongDescrip: We've almost proven the Vault's worthiness to the Brotherhood of Steel! Last task - a rescue mission at the Nuka-Cola Plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_InShiningArmor_QuestShortDescri: Rescue the soldier from the Raiders at the Nuka-Cola Plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OfftheRails_QuestLongDescriptio: A group known as “The Railroad” was trying to sneak refugees through the area, when they were captured by Raiders. Find and rescue them before it's too late.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OfftheRails_Conversation_1_NPCE: Thank you, but you've got to find my friends! I heard something about the Atomatoys Offices...
The Synths we were trying to help. I think they headed for the old Atomatoys Offices...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OfftheRails_Conversation_1_Team: What did the Raiders want with you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OfftheRails_Conversation_1_NPCE: Nothing, they were only after the Synths! I think they went to the old Atomatoys Offices.
Androids from the Institute! They deserve better than to be dragged off to the Atomatoys Offices...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SynthinaPinch_QuestLongDescript: Synths and their Railroad supporters were captured by Raiders. They need to be found before something horrible happens!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NotSoSafehouse_QuestLongDescrip: Railroad agents managed to evade capture and headed for one of their safehouses. Check in with them and make sure they're all right.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SynthsforSale_QuestLongDescript: Raiders are trying to ransom Synths back to the Institute. Time to step in and save the day!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SynthsforSale_Conversation_1_Te: No such thing as a “normal” life these days, I'm afraid.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SynthsforSale_Conversation_1_NP: Maybe not, but we'll take our chances!
Oh my gosh, you can't just ask someone if they're robots!
You know, I... uhh... I'm just not sure! How strange.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SynthsforSale_Conversation_1_Te: You might want to think about finding different clothes.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SynthsforSale_Conversation_1_NP: The jumpsuits are kind of a giveaway, aren't they? Thanks for the advice.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThePartyattheEndoftheWorld_Ques: The Party at the End of the World
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Blackout_QuestLongDescription: It's New Year's day... and the Vault threw one heck of a party last night. But the Overseer's son, Jack, is missing and we need to find him! We know he was with us before the clock struck 12, but everything afterwards is a blur. And we're all wearing Radiation Suits. We must have been at the Corvega Auto Plant at some point...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Blackout_QuestShortDescription: The Overseer's son, Jack, is missing after a crazy New Year's party!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Blackout_QuestObjective_1: Search for Jack in the Corvega Auto Plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Blackout_Conversation_1_Team_1: We were partying with Raiders? We don't... remember... any of this. Where was this party?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Blackout_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_: At our Warehouse up the street. You kept claiming you were aliens from mothership Zeta.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASpecialBrand_QuestLongDescript: Last night, we ended up partying with Raiders at an old Warehouse. We should search there for clues to Jack's whereabouts. He's the Overseer's son, after all. If we lose him, we'll end up getting kicked out of the Vault with nothing on our backs... or worse!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASpecialBrand_QuestShortDescrip: We were partying at an old Warehouse! Maybe there are clues there...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASpecialBrand_QuestObjective_1: Find out if the Raiders know what happened to Jack.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASpecialBrand_Conversation_2_Te: Jack's still alive? Then we might live to see another day, too...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASpecialBrand_Conversation_2_NP: Oh yeah, he's alive and married to Kaela. Her crew is over at a cave east of here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ASpecialBrand_Conversation_1_NP: The one you traded for your friend Jack? As dowry? Talk to Krant - he's got what you came for.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WalkofShame_QuestLongDescriptio: I guess we traded Jack for a pet, or Jack traded himself, or something! But he ended up married to a Raider Boss named Kaela who hangs out in a cave...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WalkofShame_QuestShortDescripti: Jack may still be alive at the Ironworks - but he's married to a Raider?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WalkofShame_Conversation_1_Team: He's not your husband, he's our friend. Where are the Slavers?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WalkofShame_Conversation_1_NPCE: They were headed west - they may have already left the Red Rocket. That's a mile north of here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JackAintBack_QuestLongDescripti: The Overseer's son got married to a Raider, but she sold him to Slavers! We have to catch them before they disappear west!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JackAintBack_QuestShortDescript: First married, then sold to Slavers... Can we get to Jack in time?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JackAintBack_Conversation_1_Tea: What'd you do with him? Is he alive?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JackAintBack_Conversation_1_NPC: We sold him to a cannery that's been producing Potted Meat. But you? You, we're just gonna kill!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumanBeanJuice_QuestLongDescrip: Jack's been through the ringer - and now he might get turned into dinner! Slavers sold him to a Potted Meat plant. We need to head there!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumanBeanJuice_QuestShortDescri: Find Jack before he gets processed into dinner!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumanBeanJuice_QuestObjective_1: Find Jack before he gets processed into dinner!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HumanBeanJuice_Conversation_1_N: They make camp at a Radaway plant up north.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KHAAANNNNN_QuestLongDescription: Our boy got traded into marriage against his will, sold into slavery, shipped to a meat factory and now some Raiders have him hostage... What's next?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KHAAANNNNN_QuestShortDescriptio: Jack was stolen by Khan Killian's gang and we need to get him back!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KHAAANNNNN_QuestObjective_1: Rescue Jack from Khan Killian's gang!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KHAAANNNNN_Conversation_1_Team_: I'm not dying for a kid who can't handle his booze. Stay away from our Vault and we have a deal.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KHAAANNNNN_Conversation_1_NPCEn: Good! The Khan is most pleased by this arrangement!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KHAAANNNNN_Conversation_1_Team_: No deal, Raider scum! You'll just go back on your word anyway!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KHAAANNNNN_Conversation_1_NPCEn: Fine! The Khan gives you the boy and your lives. But remember... the Khan is always watching...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_QuestLongDesc: Rumor has it Area 51 is packed with tech that could benefit our vault. It's bound to be heavily guarded: we better stock up on medical supplies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_QuestShortDesc: We need medical supplies before our raid on Area 51.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question1_Line1_A: Ah, then you're in luck: shoppers skip the line.
Sure, honey! Make your way to the big rooms with padded walls and the staff will help you out.
No one's died of old age waiting... yet.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question4_Choice1: If it comes with free stimpacks, sure!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question4_Answer1: Oh! I am not a doctor. I fix eyebots. Thought it was obvious.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question4_Choice2: Oh! Ha, eyebots! I get it! Funny!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question4_Answer2: I fix robots. No bot, no service: move along.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_QuestObjective1: “Convince” a doctor to hand over medical supplies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question5_Choice1: Hand them over, or we'll send you to your morgue!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question5_Answer1: Stealing from the sick? You are gonna feel so guilty about this…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question5_Choice2: Please, good lady, we are in dire needs of stimpacks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q1_Doc_Question5_Answer2: We can spare a couple, but keep it quiet. If we gave them out every time...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_QuestLongDesc: Thanks to our contacts, we're confident we can convince the Brotherhood of Steel to sign off on gear we'll use to raid their own facilities. Ah! The irony!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_QuestShortDesc: Find the paladin on assignment and get them to sign a requisition form.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question1_Choic: Err… yeah sure… we are the reinforcements.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question1_Answe: You look like recruits, not the elites we sent for. Guess we can use you as a decoy.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question1_Choic: We're looking for the paladin in charge. We got paperwork.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question1_Answe: So you're not here to help us? The bureaucrats will be the death of us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question1_Choic: You're half-dead already. We could mercy-kill you if you want.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question1_Answe: You're no reinforcement. Brothers, to arms!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_QuestObjective1: Get the requisition signed by the paladin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question2_Choic: Yep, you're free! Just sign the dotted line here… and initials here… and here…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question2_Answe: Wait, what? You came all this way for a requisition form? I guess we owe you. Give it here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question2_Choic: We're here to offer you the chance to win a million caps. You may already be a winner.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question2_Answe: Ooooh, a sweepstake! I love those. Quick, let me sign the waiver!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question2_Choic: Sir, we have an official equipment request for you to approve as per the chain of command.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q2_Field_Question2_Answe: You're the uptight type, huh? Let me sign and get outta here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_QuestLongDesc: With requisition forms in hand, we're headed to the Brotherhood depot for top-tier gear. How hard can it be?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_QuestShortDesc: Acquire requisitioned Brotherhood of Steel gear
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question1_Choice1: We're here to deliver this requisition form and pick up some gear.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question1_Answer1: Go meet the quartermaster B38. Up a floor, second left, then down, retrace your steps, up again... maybe.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question1_Answer2: Hmm... It isn't on my list of valid reasons. I'll have to deny access using strong language and stronger weapons.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question2_Answer1: Oh! This is gear-related. I handle plushies. But hey, you look like you need a hug. Here's a teddy bear.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question3_Answer1: Are you daft? This is the food storage. Your form is no good here. Shoo! No soup for you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question4_Choice1: We may have squashed one or two on the way in.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question4_Answer1: Oh no! My poor babies! So missunderstood. Go. Go. Leave me to my grief, you monster!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question4_Choice2: Bit careless of you letting them loose. Should we tell the commander?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question4_Answer2: Oh my! I'm just a humble researcher acting out of love. Please, please keep this quiet, yeah?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question5_Choice1: Oh ho, I smell a ramble coming. Sorry lad, we're short on time.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question5_Answer1: I understand how the constant pressure of time can lead the mind away from the satisfaction of indulging in... hey, where are you going?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question5_Answer2: Being a scribe is first and foremost devoting oneself to the pursuit of knowledge! Scribes are the living memory... Oh, hey, you feel asleep there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question6_Answer1: A requisition, eh? Sorry, pal, we don't do requisition. But we do offer combat training! Get ready!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question7_Answer1: There, take this. Now leave us!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question7_Choice2: Wouldn't mind some nice power armor, for sure.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question7_Answer2: There, take this. And this weapon comes with it. Now leave us!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question7_Choice3: Put a weapon in my hands and an armor on my shoulders, and we shall be on our way.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q3_Req_Question7_Answer3: Here you go. Now leave us!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_QuestLongDesc: With gear and meds ready, we are set for our heist. Something feels wrong, though. We might not be facing the enemy we expected!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_QuestShortDes: We're ready for the Area 51 heist. That alien tech is almost within reach.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_Question1_Cho: Beating the unbeatable is our specialty. Step aside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_Question1_Ans: Hope you like getting probed! Adieu!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_Question1_Cho: We'll handle the threat! What can you tell us about it?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_Question1_Ans: They're not of this world. I think they're here to reclaim their tech.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_Question1_Cho: We are here on... uh... official business. We'll negotiate our way through!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL2_Q4_Roswell_Question1_Ans: I don't think the "We come in peace" routine will work, but hey, your call!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_SecuritronsUncapped_1_Qu: Reports confirm Securitrons have gone haywire, threatening our vault and NoVac.
Investigate the cause of the Securitrons' malfunction.
Outside's clear. Move out while you can.
You're heading in there? You are crazy, man!
We can't accompany you, but the path's open.
Thank you, dear. Now do I have everything? My purse. My cat. Oven is turned off. Time to go.
We shut them down for you. Tip's appreciated.
Oh! But of course, honey! Here you go, 1 cap.
This must be the leader. Let's send it to the scrapyard.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_QuestLongDesc: Despite our success, more rogue Securitrons swarm the Mojave region. The RobCo factory might hold answers.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_QuestShortDesc: Search the RobCo factory for answers.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_Question2_Choic: Lucky us, this one's disabled. Let's hack it and find out what it hides.
Sounds almost friendly. Let's gut it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_Question3_Choic: We'll find you. We need answers.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_Question4_Choic: Duh! You think we got here without smashing a few?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_QuestObjective1: Uncover the cause of the Securitrons' attacks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_Question5_Choic: You look knowledgeable. Do you know why they'd go berserk?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q2_Handy_Question5_Answe: Of course I do. Someone carefully removed their combat inhibitor gaskets… But who… and why?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_QuestLongDesc: We heard a distress call from "sane" Securitrons holed up in a vault. Maybe they can shed light on the combat inhibitor issue.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_QuestShortDes: Find out who removed the combat inhibitors of Securitrons.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question1_Cho: These ones are clearly berserk too. We need to go deeper.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question2_Cho: Is it hiding under your skin?
Mind if we take a look at your circuits?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question2_Ans: Oh, you're a killjoy! I'll find a place where I can be my true self.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question3_Cho: So, no gasket means no inhibitor… and more berserk bots. Yikes!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_QuestObjectiv: Meet with the Securitrons behind the distress call.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question4_Cho: Quick, tell me who did this to you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question4_Ans: Warehouse… Near the Sarsaparilla bottling plant. Please… <error>… Criminals! Halt!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question4_Cho: We'll shut you down and fix you. But we need to find who's behind this.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q3_Insider_Question4_Ans: Go the Sarsaparilla bottling plant's warehouse. Ok. Now shutting down…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_QuestLongDe: The rogue Securitrons trace back to a warehouse near the Sarsaprilla bottling plant. Find whoever's responsible.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_QuestShortD: Seach the warehouse where it all started.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question1_C: Your boss sent me. You're fired!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question1_A: You're a funny one, are you? Go get smashed by the robots or something.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question1_C: There's a new working-from-home policy in effect!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question1_A: We're factory workers. Not sure you thought that through. But hey, pants-free work sounds good!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question3_C: These Securitrons are different. This confirms it. This place services Securitrons.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question4_C: Tampering with bots causes killing sprees. You know that, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question4_A: How'd you know the gaskets come from Securitrons? Oh… shouldn't have said that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question4_C: Where'd the gaskets come from? Spill it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question4_A: Securitrons don't need 'em. Why the third degree? You're no buyers!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question4_C: Actually, we're taking over your operation!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question4_A: You're the worst kind of gold diggers!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_QuestObject: Solve the mystery of the murderous Securitrons.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question5_C: The jig is up. We are here to stop you from turning Securitrons into murder machines.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question5_A: What? We thought removing the gasket did nothing… What have we done? It's over.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question5_C: You just ignored the “COMBAT INHIBITOR” part? You are killing people.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question5_A: Could this be a delayed reaction? Securitrons leave the warehouse just fine… We meant no harm.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_S2_QL3_Q4_Warehouse_Question5_C: Your tinkering with combat inhibitors turned the robots into killers. Here! Let me show you how that feels!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_QuestLongDe: Some slick raiders breached our vault and made off with critical supplies. We traced them to an abandoned Vault-Tec site near the Strip.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_QuestShortD: Hunt the bandits. End their thievery.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question0_L: Tell me more about this outbreak!
Experiment "Molespy" failure. Hostile creatures have taken over the building.
Seal the building. Flood it with toxic gasses.
Cannot comply. Resident mutated Mole rats control the facility.
Have you seen a group of brigands carrying a bunch of stuff?
“Stuff” undefined. “Brigands” undefined. Facility overrun by intelligent Mole rats.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question1_C: Holy Overseer! A talking Molerat! Can I pet you?
This ain't right. Vermin shouldn't talk.
We will wander where we want, wannabe wombat!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question1_A: Rational retorts reap its reward. Roam restraintlessly.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question3_C: So you admit guilt? Time to carve some Molerat steak!
Want us gone? Tell us where to find our stuff.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question3_A: This token testifies to our thirst for tranquility. Take it and turn tail.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question3_C: Err... Beat it brood babies! This band will bust your base! See?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_QuestObject: Uncover the true nature of the thieves
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question4_L: More facilities to shut down? Let's finish here and investigate.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question5_C: Still gotta put a stop to these rodents, though...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question6_C: Fancy speech for what amounts to a quaint group of bandits! Mole-pi-rats?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question6_A: Pitiful pun proves your poor perspicacity. Prepare to perish.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question6_C: The novelty of talking Mole rats has worn off. Time for some pest control.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question6_A: A vitriolic vindication of our violence versus villains.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question6_C: Man! I'm trying to match your speech, but alliterations are hard!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_1_Question6_A: Stay silent, sinister strangers, and succumb to our strike!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_QuestLongDe: When we shut down the Molerat gang, we uncovered a series of failed experiments, each one a threat the security of New Vegas. The next one concerns Ghouls.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_QuestShortD: Investigate the Vault-Tec Ghoul mind-control experiment
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question0_C: What the heck? Did these Ghouls grow a hivemind?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question0_A: Please address us when you speak about us! We are peace incarnate. Case in point: you may pass.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question0_C: Pfft… Another failed experiment, I see.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question0_A: We ended envy. We erased strife. Is that failure? We worried about what you deem success.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question0_C: Groupthink! This must be a commie's ploy! To arms!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question0_A: Oh, naive child of discord! If only you had tasted our serenity.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question1_C: Is the fresh meat Bob? He went missing near here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question1_A: Bob is meat. You are meat. We are meat. Let us show you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question1_C: Sure let's have a barbecue, as you strip us of what makes us unique!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question1_A: Loneliness is a fate worse than death. We will grant you peace, and bolster our pantry.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question1_C: You wouldn't want my mind in your mix. It's… disturbed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question1_A: Then we'll quell the turbulence, and add you to the meat reserve.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question2_C: Must be boring being you then.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question2_A: Boring? When every voice sings in unison? Think on it, wanderer.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question2_C: You know what? You make a good case. Where do I sign?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question2_A: Oh… well, truthfully, we didn't expect a yes. Give us a day to… consider.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question2_C: Let's see if you still feel nothing when you're full of lead.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question3_C: I'll pass. My love life doesn't involve irradiated flesh.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question3_A: That's because you've never been to one of our soirées. Your loss.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question3_C: Guess I'm in the other 25%. No thanks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question3_A: Division. Dissension. Enjoy your touchless minority.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question3_C: You're really pushing this sales pitch. You know we're here to end you, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question3_A: There is no end to us, as we are many.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question4_C: Is that a wild Deathclaw? Or part of the hivemind? No matter: it's charging!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question5_L: Uh-oh… collective brain spilled the beans?
We can resolve this, by eating YOUR brain!
Does this thing have a mute button? I am growing tired of your nagging.
Typical self-centered mindset. Get rid of that self. Here, we will help you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_2_Question6_L: <Choose option: pit half against the other half>
That'll keep them busy till oblivion. Let's bail.
There is a note: <Detonation will occur after departure.> Lucky us!
It reads <Subjects severed from the collective. Silence and despair imminent.> Our job here is done!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_QuestLongDe: Next on our list of failed experiments to shut down: Vault Tech has unleashed the subversive power of philosophy. Everyone's sanity is at risk.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_QuestShortD: Meet with the "philosophes" and show them what real life is about!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question0_L: First Mole rats, now Radroaches? Vault-Tec's trying to turn the wasteland into a cartoon?
We have no knowledge of "car tunes". But we hope it makes you merciful. Does it?
Sorry! Should've been born cute and cuddly.
Ah! To perish as the victim of human aesthetic prejudice!
Maybe... if you can give us something that isn't crap.
Here. You humans cherish useless drinking container leftovers, correct?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question1_L: Because it's fun! It goes "swissh" and then there's bug juice everywhere. Let's get stomping.
Why is it that higher intelligence often leads to cruelty?
You speak of peace, but the way you breed, how long before you need more space? Our space?
Your wars left the world mostly empty. We mean no harm. You can move freely.
Here is an “idea”: give me Nuka Cola Quantum or die!
We do have a small number of bottles preseved here. Is that serendipidy?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question2_L: I heard war never changes. But talking Radroaches? That's a change we can't stomach.
Ah! The inescapability of our fate as war machines, how ever much we despise it.
War is fun! Like… we are about to go to war with you, and we will have fun doing it.
A hedonist and a sadist. This day is one of doom for us.
Pay tribute and you'll avoid war!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question3_L: That's the tyranny of beauty for you. Butterflies are pretty. You? Not so much.
We are survivors. We are resilient. Isn't there beauty in that? Consider it, as you keep walking, please.
Maybe if you slapped on some colors, learn to fly gracefully… put some effort in…
It's the whole rebirth... from worm to wonder. Ugly duckling and all that.
Ackshooally, butterflies start as larvae, not worms, and… oh! eh! put that weapon away…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question5_C: Yeah! I, too, prefer my mind quiet. Sit tight. We'll keep smashing.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question5_A: We look forward to being numb again. Take this as your reward.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question5_C: I heard somewhere it means that you exist. So... maybe you should be grateful?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question6_L: If the deeds of the one bring pain to the many, then the one must be stopped.
Then move along and ponder this: who defines pain but the many, to oppress the one?
I am the one in that story, right? Here to squash the many!
Then we need to excert our power as a majority to stop you.
If jealousy rules unchecked, human ingenuity fizzles. Oh wait, you're not human!
But we are many, seeking enlightment, threatened by the selfishness of ones like you. Could a bribe prevail?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_QuestObject: Prove your superior intellect… or gunslinging
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_3_Question7_L: So you're the boss, I take it? Time to die!
So you are saying: life is fleeting... and can end anytime?
Life is like a box of Sugar Bombs! You always know what you're gonna get: the craps!
Ah! An idiot savant! You will need this to survive the wasteland. As for us, we promise to stay in here.
Love. For all life spawns from an act of love.
Yet life consumes life to sustain its existence. Like we will feast on your corpse.
Life is a battlefield! You only hold on to it if you can defend it.
Is that why you humans love your tools so much? Take this and go prove you're alive! We will not leave this vault, promise.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_QuestLongDe: We located the control site for all the failed experiments. Time to put an end to them once and for all.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question0_C: Easy there, unstable fellow... Purple is a color. It doesn't make sounds.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question0_A: The heretic heralds the blind blanket!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question0_C: Huh... I can hear some weird buzz. Very faint.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question0_A: Give it time. Give it eternity.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question2_L: So you pumped yourself full of what? Mentats?
No. No. Psycho. Psycho helps. But you need to hurt.
Multiple mainframes to shut down! Got it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question4_C: My headache is growing. I can almost understand you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question4_A: You must not. Only one can remain.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question4_C: Err… let me try this. But the sun of reason makes you whole again.
We are here to help. We are looking for ways to shut down what ails you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question4_A: Yes. Yes. The mainf…. Noooo you made it angry!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL2_Leftovers_4_Question7_C: No, I want the other thing.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_QuestLongDes: The Strip is under siege by Deathclaws. Civilians are trapped and in need of a hero.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_QuestShortDe: Be a hero: save the people of The Strip from Deathclaws.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question1_Li: You're in shock, you need help!
You sure can! One just so happen to be waiting for your touch outside!
We are here to put them down, so… no.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question5_Ch: That sure is your right! You just have to go sign the discharge with the officer outside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question5_An: You bet I will sign the… Hey, wait a minute! Nice try.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question5_Ch: We're sanitizing the whole place with fire so... your call.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question7_An: Ah, that ain't it. Oh well, I should have written it down
Got it! Let's see what we have here.
Ah, shoot. That ruined some of the content, but at least it's open!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question8_Ch: Wait, is that Deathclaw humming? It gives off real boss vibes!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question9_Ch: Of course we do, and we came here to save you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question9_An: Ah, Pumpkin, do I look like I need saving?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question9_Ch: We killed the Deathclaws. You're welcome!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_1_Question9_An: Well, hurrah for me, I guess. Would you like a little kiss on the cheek with that?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_QuestLongDes: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip to discuss defense strategy and secure allies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_QuestShortDe: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question1_Li: Hey, I'm a poisoner, not a miracle worker.
Don't stop at the first hurdle! Keep at it!
Nah, I decided to work on bio-engineering furry roaches instead.
Whatever. They ain't resisting bullets, I'll tell you that.
<Eye roll> Next you'll tell me you can wrestle one barehanded...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question2_Ch: An Enclave uniform? Hmm… that's suspicious.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question3_An: I'm obviously not talking to the right people. Move along.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question3_Ch: You don't look like you're from around here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question3_An: The Enclave is everywhere. Oops. And now I must ensure your silence.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question3_Ch: We found an Enclave uniform earlier. Yours?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question4_Li: Deathclaw eggs are hard to come by, but I too would like a taste.
A gastronome after my own heart! Here's something to help your hunt.
I find 'em rubbery and foul. Me like the steak better.
Where you find one, chances are you'll find the other. Take this. It'll get you in the mood.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question5_Li: That's right. Mind your own business and pitter-patter out of here.
Don't talk trash about her mom, I'll smack you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question6_Li: We are here to help. Recruiting allies and stocking up on weapons.
Then this will help you. We'll keep in touch.
You are on your own. We just came here to watch you fail.
You are jesting, I'm sure? No? What if we pay you like… a lot?
We'll fight them off, but not alone. You, too, are capable.
How about we send a couple of our finest combat-ready pets. Keep them alive, will you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_2_Question7_Li: Glad to hear. Anything else you can help with?
This weapon might come in handy. You should also seek a Ghoul who calls himself The King. He is useful.
Mr. House! What an honor to meet you!
Another sycophant! Then The King will adore you. You should seek his help too. And take this for your trouble.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_QuestLongDes: The King is a major player on The Strip. He can tip the scales against the Deathclaws.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_QuestShortDe: We need to enlist the King to fight against Deathclaws.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question1_Ch: They love greasy hair, but dude, not that greasy!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question1_An: My hair is perfect, you meanie... <sob>
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question1_Ch: Sure will. Just so happens I'm here to collect the registration fees.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question1_An: That's the third fee I've been asked to pay. How many more are there?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question1_Ch: Well met, fellow hopeful! We're here for the same reason. Any tip?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question1_An: I make my own pomade out of Wonderglue. Here. Try for yourself.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question2_Li: I'm the boss of my own destiny, you bet! But you must mean The King! He's up top!
That's the spirit! You'll have to meet The King first. Higher floor.
Easily solved. Also, go ask the King for permission, up a couple of floors.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_3_Question5_Li: Knowing you'll fight alongside us is it's own reward.
Ah! That's something the King can respect, but you won't refuse this boon, will ya?
But of course! Are your pockets deep enough?
I'd like to officially join the Kings.
Then the King grants your request with glee. You'll need this.
We do a lot of travelling. Makes one thirsty. Any Nuka Cola Quantum around?
I'm certain I've got a six-pack somewhere. Don't drink it all in one sitting!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_QuestLongDes: Our efforts have paid off. The last remaining Deathclaws and their Alpha have been cornered in a cave.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_QuestShortDe: We have trapped the Alpha Deathclaw. Time to end the threat.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question0_Ch: I have half a mind to let them gnaw on your bones. Get out of here, idiot!
You're in my way. So I will remove you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question0_An: You're brutes. But we came prepared.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question0_Ch: Maybe you're onto something. I met a talking Deathclaw once.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question0_An: See? You get it. So you'll go in and help them, right? RIGHT?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question4_Ch: We're not Deathclaws. Maybe they're malfunctioning?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question5_Li: Hey, the funny-speaking Mole rats are back. Time to finish the job.
More Mole rats… err… merit more… oh screw it. Let's just cook 'em.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question6_Ch: Here's the Alpha! With the whole family!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question7_Ch: You're safe now. And anyone willing is welcome to join our vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question7_An: Ah thank you, friend! This is a generous invitation. It's dangerous out here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NVB_QL3_Stripper_4_Question8_Li: No chance! We are an eradication team. So we eradicate.
We can show mercy… for a price
Perhaps an assortment of paraphernalia from my collection would satisfy your covetousness.
Déjà vu. This time, can you die for real?
Alas, I will not escape fate on this day.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_QuestLongDe: We've intercepted a coded plea from someone seeking to break from the Enclave. They're holed up in a civilian outpost ripe for infiltration.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_QuestShortD: An Enclave defector wants refuge in our vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room0_Quest: I am a colleague. We shelter many former Enclave ourselves.
Oh, you're with *them*. I can get promoted out of here if I stop you!
We're not with the Enclave, but Grandma is. We're visiting!
Not with the Enclave? The result of bad parenting, right here. We'll keep an eye on you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room1_Quest: Speaking of gold, do you have any?
Every ounce of gold is a brick in the fortress of liberty.
Wait, we're not residents, we're visitors. Much too young to retire…
Gold is forever while flesh is fleeting.
I feel like no matter what I say, you'll igore it.
Liberty was born in a cradle of gold.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room2_Quest: How insulting! You youngsters have it easy with... err... your tiny Radscorpions and friendly Radroaches...
Apologies. I'm simply collecting donations for Enclave orphans.
Throw 'em in a vat for all I care! Oh, alright! I don't need my uniform anymore, I guess. Take it and leave.
Are you trying to grift me? You'll never find my gold. Scram!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room3_Quest: Exactly what a Mole rat would say...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room5_Quest: Showed mercy to my enemy once. The next day, he rallied the survivors and struck back. Lost many friends.
Anything left on your bucket list?
The restoration of America, but I'm out of time! You, you still have some life left in you. You do it.
Ah! I'm not crying, you're crying!
You're an emotional one, aren't you. Maybe the Enclave isn't for you, then.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room9_Quest: Well, our vault never sleeps. You are welcome to slip out with us.
I'll play dead. Pretend to hit me, make it look real. Oh, and if you can, get my pet. That crazy lady stole it from me.
Gather your things, time to go!
Give me a second. Oh, and I can't find my pet, so if you can oblige...
You don't look very knowledgeable... or skilled. We'll pass.
I'm still coming. And also, get my pet. It's probably with that hag in her room…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room7_Quest: Enjoy the peaceful days ahead of you. It seems we owe you a lot.
Vault technology is decades old. You don't look that old to me.
That's kind of you to say. But, you know, I have my ways…
I have a list of complaints. If I write them down, will you read it?
I was always one to hear Dwellers' feedback, but you'll have to find a new set of ears.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room8_Quest: Oh! I know that one! Freedom is doing whatever you want! Damn the consequences!
Incorrect: Freedom is the golden rule granted by the pursuit of wealth.
Hey resident! Want us to smack those bots?
You are unpatriotic! Leave us be.
Let us just slip by, thank you very much.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_1_Room6_Quest: <PLAY DUMB> What are you talking about?
Oh, you're not with her? Then can you take my sweetie for a walk? My legs ain't what they used to…
Animal control! Give it up, or face eviction.
You're a cruel one, threatening to toss your former best sniper to the street... Go on, break my heart!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_QuestLongDe: We've been invited to opening night of an Enclave play. It screams trap, but we can turn it into a golden opportunity!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_QuestShortD: Attend the opening night of the Enclave play.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_Room0_Quest: Errr... There's something wrong with you. Mind if I check your code?
From forth the fatal vaults of these two foes, a pair of star-cross robots, take their strife.
Ooooh, has the play started already? Continue. Continue.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_Room1_Quest: Wait! Are we switching plays now? Err... I think therefore I be?
Does not compute. Error. Remove non-actors.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_Room2_Quest: Sorry, I don't do interactive theater. I'll just take my leave.
Actually, you should be saying a couple more lines before my turn.
Updating database. Awaiting programming. Take this to director.
I take thee at thy word. Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized. Henceforth I never will be Romeo.
Error. Name of character is Horatio, who is the totally original author and director of this play. Remove youself.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_Room3_Quest: But your circuits are so golden, and your declamation routine is a beautiful singleton!
Ah, a fan... Let me give you my autograph and a care package.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_Room4_Quest: Fairies? Fairies grant wishes, no? I wish for gold.
Hmm... Maybe some wings made of paper maché, and a cute tutus, you could pass for fairies.
We will wait for the costume designer. Bring it this payment.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_Room5_Quest: Isn't it obvious? I'm training these good-for-nothing pests as stage hands. Don't interfere.
We can't get any good help these days.
Perhaps you'd be interested in an unpaid internship then? Think on it and come back to me.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_2_Room6_Quest: How foul and loathsome is thine image!
What? But that killed last time... Quite literally. I will perform for you!
You speak an infinite deal of nothing.
You are just like the rest of them. They prefer chasing gold to chasing art...
Thy constellation is right apt for this affair.
People of great taste raised you well! Please take this with you as a token of my gratitude
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_QuestLongDe: We caught an odd signal inviting Enclave to a refuge in a former NCR base located in a mausoleum. Worth a look.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_Room0_Quest: NCR and Enclave living together? How is that possible?
If you leave behind the ambitions of the narcicists, you can find peace.
Stand aside, we are here to defeat the Enclave.
Bad answer. We are in this together, and will defend one another.
Neither, we are Vault Dwellers, seeking former Enclave to recruit.
Those who come here have forsworn violence. You may enter, but keep the peace.
Forget all that. Where's your gold?
You sound like the local Enclave leader. We will stop you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_Room1_Quest: It's an Enclave ambush! Weapons ready!
No, wait, don't let your trauma win!
Sniff. I have found gold, and... and... the... the Enclave tried to take it from me, and they're big meanies...
There. There. Is this what you were fussing about?
Hurt me? No, I hurt them.
Violence is not the solution. Return when you've welcomed peace into your heart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_Room2_Quest: Raiders! Don't let them steal the medicine!
This place looks ripe for a little bit of looting.
Looting a place full of former military sounds like a real smart plan!
You want our paperweight? You're a strange one.
Since you all let go of the fight, can I get your weapons?
We keep some to defend ourselves, but you can have this one.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_Room3_Quest: That's Enclave propaganda, if I ever heard one. You can't just shoot whomever you have beef with.
Then you'll be the one who gets shot, NCR lover! My friend here will surely reward you for siding with him.
The NCR has lost their way. The Enclave could rise up in the open and offer a true alternative.
Exactly! Democracy brought to the Wasteland. You deserve my favorite gun. Take good care of Henrietta.
It doesn't matter. Whoever has the biggest guns makes the law, and that's us.
Wrong move. Time to kick your testosterone down a notch!
The key is healthy debate, without violence, just like the one you're having.
That's a fair point. If you tire of your vault, come stay here and debate with us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_Room4_Quest: Friends, we need to teach these "comedians" some respect.
<The people assembled nod to you, and hand you something.>
<Hand over invitations to join your vault>
All Enclave must perish. Let's add a couple more names to those tombs!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_QuestObject: Find the one who doesn't belong
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_3_Room6_Quest: Here's an alternative: how about you defect to us?
Sure. Just give me all your gold! ... Yeah, didn't think so.
Relax. We are with you on this. We killed a bunch of your Enclave on our way here.
Is that true? Then all that's left for me is to tie up loose ends.
A spy! Let's capture him for interrogation.
As if that was ever an option!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_4_QuestLongDe: We must be popular: we've got another distress call, this time from a defecting scientist named Wilzig. By now, it's clear none of these are a trap.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_4_QuestShortD: We're off to answer a new distress call. Definitely not a trap.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_4_Room3_Quest: I'm not falling for that one.
Finally, we found you and... hey, wait a minute...
Prove it. Tell me the first 20 digits of pi.
Digits? You mean fingers? In pies? Oh! You tricked us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_4_Room4_Quest: We're the Heaven Water Super Elite! You lose!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_4_Room5_Quest: The Gold-Obsessed Leadership Directive and Amassment System does not answer to you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL2_Defective_4_Room6_Quest: Good thing you didn't lose your head over it!
Yeah, well... I'll be *heading* for your vault soon. You just wait.
No time to chat. Come with us.
No time? I'm pretty sure you cleared up the place. I will show up in time.
Before we leave, any good stuff we can bring with us?
I do have these plans. Take them. I'll sabotage this place, then make travel arrangements.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_1_QuestLongD: Intel says the Enclave's coming for us with something big, but we're already one step ahead. First stop: a lab running twisted experiments on animals.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_1_Room0_Ques: Wow. Not only intruders, but too dumb to play along?
Don't hold your hands out. I'm not the one giving them out, that's further in.
Certainly. As you can see by my outfit, I do undercover work.
We need more folks like you to deal with those pesky Vault Dweller gold thieves.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_1_Room1_Ques: You might yet live! What's the plan here? How do you turn pets into spies?
I run the virtual reality programming. That's how we train them.
You look ready for a villain monologue, but I'm in a bloody mood.
Err... more peeps like me, I guess. Storage units too. And watch out for Agent Deathclaw.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_1_Room4_Ques: You don't look like much. Think you can stop me?
If not us, then Agent Deathclaw will. Our greatest success. He even talks and everything.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_1_Room5_Ques: Ahem... I can see you just fine.
No you can't. But just to be sure, let me pluck out your eyes.
Even if you were invisible - and you're not - your stink gives you away.
I smell bad? I need a bath, then. Rain check?
You can't see me either. We are two phantoms crossing paths in the dark.
What was that? Who's speaking? ... Must've been the wind.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_1_Room6_Ques: Let's pick the cat. I'm more of a cat person, anyway.
<Participant number critical. Freeing all subjects.> Oh neat! We got them all.
I choose the biggest, meanest dog.
<Lord Puffington disconnected. Puffington's friends also disconnected. Current occupancy: 0.>
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_2_QuestLongD: We've detected a foreign substance in our power supply. We traced the toxin back to an Enclave research bunker.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_2_Room1_Ques: Our escort's in a puddle of their own blood back there.
Girls, let's show these ruffians the power of STEM!
They're with another group. So, what's the test?
Well, we were set to try bio-engineered Radscorpion venom, but the sample's gone. Come back later.
Are you the ones poisoning our water?
Nope. That's Group C under Dr. Jackal. If you're headed that way, can you deliver this?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_2_Room5_Ques: So you're dumping venom in our water supply?
Venom? No. Why would you think that? And since you're here…
You guys suck at naming things.
Preposterous. Time to give you a different kind of lead poisoning.
Is stopping you for good considered a hindrance?
Wanna fight with words? Or fight with weapons?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_2_QuestObjec: Set back Enclave research by decades
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_2_Room6_Ques: With this power, call me Mr. Snide!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_2_Room7_Ques: We haven't seen a single bathroom. There is gonna be chaos.
They'll be swimming in babies. That'll keep them busy. No more time for scheming.
I almost envy all the naps they're about to take.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_QuestLongD: Our spies report the Enclave is breeding abominations to field as soldiers. There's still time to shut them down.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_Room0_Ques: Looks like we came for nothing then. Our goal was to stop those experiments.
Or maybe you can help. Deeper in this facility, horrors still linger.
I hear what you're saying, but honestly, we can't take that risk.
We were bred as killers, but we chose love. Why force us to fight?
Join us. We also fight the Enclave.
You don't get it. We refuse to be weapons, no matter the master. Take this as proof.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_Room1_Ques: Radroaches and Mole rats? Sorry friend, they were already monsters going in.
Then you won't have scruples putting them down, will you? Their very existence is pain.
Let me guess, you want them put to rest? What's it worth to you?
My poor babies... I'dd choose another fate if I could. Now I am buying their end.
