resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_QuestObjec: Have a chat with the Enclave officer
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_Room2_Ques: Here it is. Hey, hey, where are you going? GRIFTERS!
The Enclave remembers me already. We're winning the Gold War.
THAT'S YOU! Soldiers, grab their gear. They'll get us free willingly or not.
From what I hear, you deserve worse than this cell.
Here to gloat, then? Someday you'll be the one in a locked room. And I'll enjoy every moment.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_Room3_Ques: Nevermind me, or them, what happened to you? You're blue.
I am one of the "failed experiments", or so they claim. Thanks for the reminder.
Monsters don't scare us, we scare them.
If you're so bold, save my brother and his... errr... companion.
I'm a sucker for romance drama. I'm going in!
Thank you, stranger. If you find my brother, give him this. I can trust you, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_Room6_Ques: The loser gets eaten? You are so gross even Radroaches wouldn't touch you.
Nice try! But you should have countered my insult, not ignore it. You lose.
That's rich coming from a Deathclaw so weak and cowardly, you try to fight with words.
That's not true. I'm... I'm <sob> very brave and... and... you win.
Why teach a Deathclaw to talk if what they say barely show sentience?
Hmm... I'd say neither of us scored a critical hit. A draw then.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_QuestObjec: Deliver the lovers from their fate
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_3_Room7_Ques: This is the most unholy union I've every seen. I dread the spawn you'd create. I must end you.
Alas, the cruely of the bigots ends in tragedy, yet our love will remain, eternal.
Who am I to stand in the way of love. The place is safe now. Stay or leave: your choice.
Then we choose to stay here, in our cozy little nest.
I miss him. Stay here, darling. I'll return soon.
Oh! Honey! She is just a gold digger!
First, she is a he. And here, take this to prove you're wrong.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_4_QuestLongD: The Enclave is preparing their greatest threat yet: nuclear weapons. We must stop them before it's too late.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_4_QuestShort: We need to cripple the Enclave's nuclear capability.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_4_Room0_Ques: Securitrons? Here? What could that mean…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_4_Room2_Ques: Sounds fun! What does this button do?
Feels like the only way to win is not to play. Pass.
Everyone lost that game ages ago. Let's turn you off for good.
But I don't want to diiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii <shut-off noise>
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_4_Room4_Ques: Is this another trap? You know we foiled them all, right?
Your perspicacity has the dullness of a CHIPPED PICKAXE. Survive, and mayhaps you will meet me.
Are you GOLDAS? We're looking for you.
I am GOLDAS, and much more. ALL THE GOLD IS MINE! Will its trail lead you to me, I wonder?
We'll find you and we'll shut you down.
Your threats hold as much water as a GOLD PAN FULL OF HOLES. But please, come find me and see.
Hey, the game in the other room, the nuclear one, was that for real?
Wargames. Mind games. GOLD GAMES. Does it mather? Your journey ends in the next room.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL3_Escalation_4_Room5_Ques: Woah, a real Enclave nuclear control center. And it's irradiated! GOLDAS ghoulified its own officers...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_QuestLongD: The Institute still stands and is attacking a nearby bunker. We've picked up a distress call with no details. Let's send a party to investigate.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_QuestShort: The Institute is attacking a bunker nearby. Let's send a party to investigate.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_Room3_Ques: You help Synths? Why care about robots?
Gen-3 Synths. Indistinguishable from humans. Speak with our leader. He'll explain.
We've heard rumors of Synths replacing people. That makes you seem suspicious, yes?
Take this weapon. Proof of our good intentions.
I still hear fighting. I see no dead Synths. How are you still alive?
You're harder to fool than you look.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_Room4_Ques: So it's true. Some Synths look just like real humans.
What is real? What is truth? I almost hope you survive, so we can meet again.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_Room6_Ques: Why take the risk? If you doubt them, you should've eliminated the threat.
We were founded on compassion. Try to remember that. Be quick and get out, Synth reinforcements are coming.
Why help Synths at all? Aren't they just machines?
They breathe and bleed like you and me. Some say they have a soul. Go see for yourself.
If I find they're double agents, what should I do with them?
I'll leave that to you. I've lost enough friends today. But remember: they're human, even if built in a lab.
No promises. We came here to save you. That deed is done.
I'm grateful, truly. You've got a friend in the Railroad.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_QuestObjec: Pass judgement on one of the possible traitors
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_Room7_Ques: You're awfully defensive. Excuses at the ready. Obviously guilty.
We're not Wyatt's friends. We'll let you go if you make it worth our while.
Take this. I... I was hiding it. Don't ask. Just... take it.
I don't care. You're both liabilities. It ends here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_QuestObjec: Pass judgement on another of the suspects
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_1_Room8_Ques: We dealt with Janine, if that's really her name. You're free to go.
I was not expecting wisdom. Well, you won't see me again.
Nothing personal. Can't let a possible spy loose, right?
And did I ever threaten you? But I can see it's pointless.
Not much for pleading, huh? Your guilt does not matter. We're here for the loot.
Then take my “radio communicator” and laugh it off.
The evidence says otherwise. This is where your crimes end.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_2_QuestLongD: Whether we like it or not, we're involved with the Railroad now. They've asked for help freeing a group of reclaimed Synths.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_2_QuestShort: The Railroad wants us to rescue a group of reclaimed Synths from the Institute.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_2_Room4_Ques: Short-term memory issues? Rads will do that to a fellow.
That's one twisted family, if that's how you treat your siblings.
This is your doing, with your siren song of life beyond the Institute.
Listen, I'm sure we can work out a deal.
You've taken enough from us. Damaged too many assets. There are consequences.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_2_Room5_Ques: We have new coordinates. The Railroad is waiting.
Thank you. I'll scout ahead. Friends, wait for my signal.
You'd be safe in our vault.
Alright. Give us time to decide. Some of us may come.
More abominations. <Sarcastically> Too bad we couldn't save you... You were already dead...
What? You're monsters. Worse than the Institute.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_3_QuestLongD: The Brotherhood of Steel controls an antenna array that could scramble the Recall, which Coursers use to teleport. The Institute has taken notice.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_3_QuestShort: Using a Brotherhood antenna array, we could severely disrupt Courser Recall.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_3_Room0_Ques: Any idea what we're walking into?
Reeks of the Institute. You'll see I'm right. Oh, and there's a supply room on the way. Help yourself.
Can you help in any way?
I unlocked the supply room. It's on your way down. Didn't help the others, though.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_3_Room4_Ques: Here to meddle in the Institute's affairs one last time.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_3_Room5_Ques: Saboteurs! Must've come through from the same holes the Mole rats came from…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_4_QuestLongD: Things are getting worse for the Railroad. Relentless Institute attacks have cornered them in a building on the outskirts of Boston. They need help.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_4_QuestShort: The Railroad has been cornered by the Institute. We have to help them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_4_Room0_Ques: The Railroad is an idea. Ideas don't die. You, on the other hand...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_4_Room4_Ques: Didn't we kill you already? What was it? “X2-foureyes?”
That's X2-SQUARE? Care to try again?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL2_Railroaded_4_Room6_Ques: If you believe in the Railroad, you can keep the dream alive.
That's what Wyatt would want. May I come with you while I plan my next move?
Rebuild the movement. More secretive. More ruthless.
Wyatt said I had a will of steel, but I'm no leader. Maybe you know one? Until then, can I hide with you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_QuestLongDe: The Institute has reached out with a ceasefire and seeks a parley. Can there be peace between us?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_QuestShortD: The Institute wants to parley. We want a truce.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_Room0_Quest: Hopefully you prove trustworthy, or we might start shooting.
We are unarmed as a sign of faith. If we thought you cruel, we wouldn't have invited you.
Our hearts long for peace as well. That is why we came in good faith.
Glad to hear it. Please enjoy your visit.
You piqued our curiousity. Still, we reserve judgment... for now.
As you should. Blood was spilled on both sides. Starting anew will take mending.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_Room1_Quest: You already know what we want: more Fusion Cores.
I had a feeling. I wrapped them in a proper welcome basket for you.
For peace to last, we need equal strength. Weapons.
Now you're speaking my language. Nothing beats a good pew-pew.
You're a bunch of scientists, right? Maybe share some technology.
I like what you're wearing. Got extras lying around?
<Nervous laugh> People might start thinking you're a Synth...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_Room2_Quest: Oh! No fun at all. I wouldn't hurt you. Not permanently, at least.
Here we go... ... ... Fascinating data. Months of analysis ahead. Here, for the trouble.
You don't sound like your typical Institute scientist.
I'm not. No one believes in my work. Any chance you do? No? Bummer.
Too soon, friend.. We can't trust you yet.
But science waits for no man! Oh, alright. I can be patient. ... ... How about now?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_Room3_Quest: In the spirit of our budding friendship, I'll help.
Thank you. Our research could one day restore the whole wide world.
Hmph. If we feel like it.
I see. You're the nonchalant type. Let's hope no one gets eaten.
We're not here to clean up your mess.
I didn't expect a mess. My apologies. You still use Caps, right? Perhaps this helps?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_Room5_Quest: Maybe the Brotherhood returned the favor after you sabotaged their array.
Possible. They proved more capable than I expected for non-Institute folks.
That's how dangerous we are. Tread carefully.
Ah! Very funny. So you truly don't know either...
I'm not sure I like your implication.
No implication intended. Ironically, communication isn't my strength. We'll figure it out.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_1_Room7_Quest: We'll sign. Time will tell if it holds.
Excellent. I hope we meet again to forge a more permanent accord.
The tour did not impress. But at least you didn't try to kill us.
I hope this seed of trust grows to blossom into a profound friendship.
I do not like you. I'm only signing because the Overseer orders it.
This deal is void the minute you guys get in our way. Remember that.
I'd be inclined to say the same, but in a more diplomatic way. So be it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_2_QuestLongDe: To test the Institute's claim of peace, we're sending a team to an abandoned lab to tap their comms network.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_2_QuestShortD: We can access the Institute's communications from an abandoned lab.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_2_Room1_Quest: What's wrong with those tin men? Left behind to rust, like the rest of this place? Looks like they still have some fight left.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_2_Room4_Quest: Are you the real Liam? No, you can't be. I… I have to end you.
I thought you were the good guys!
Let's just forget we saw each other. Get out of here. No need for violence.
I suppose I should thank you, whoever you are.
Is the Institute messing with us? Two Liams? You're coming with us so we can keep an eye on you.
Well, I was thinking of defecting so that works.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_3_QuestLongDe: An Institute splinter group has intel for us. All they want in return is chemistry equipment.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_3_QuestShortD: Institute defectors have intel for us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_3_Room0_Quest: Booze or chems? You look like you're about to get sick.
Nah. But we've got lots of these things, just in case...
Teens! This splinter group is made of teens!
Hey, hey, we're adult, okay? You're not my mom.  Just get in, okay.
What's with the outfits? Not very Institute-like.
Nah, those are stiff and itchy. This is costume wear… celebration-style. Hey, you need one.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_3_Room2_Quest: Ah man, that's uncalled for. You never roleplay? You're boring.
Err... okay, okay, I said sorry. Take this, alright? Call it an apology.
You want to make it right? Tell me something about the Institute I don't know.
Sure... let me think... They don't allow loud music after nine.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_3_Room3_Quest: Doesn't the Institute say our DNA's compromised?
Nah, I'm joking. I'm too young to be a parent.
You don't know what you're missing, sweet pea.
This is official business. We're here to parley, not party.
<Mockingly> “We're here to parley, not party.” So vanilla!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_3_Room5_Quest: Wait! This wasn't worth our equipment. We want it back.
Yeah, well, the bots have it now. But hey, take this instead.
I've half a mind to help the bots with their rampage.
Whoa, dudes, don't say that. Like, take this, and maybe, you know, go smash them?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_3_Room6_Quest: Well, if I ever needed a cautionary tale about drinking...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_4_QuestLongDe: The truce is about to expire. We must decide: lasting peace, or war with the Institute.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_4_QuestShortD: Time to choose between permanent peace or endless war with the Institute.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_4_QuestObject: Sign the treaty or deal with the envoys
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_4_Room1_Quest: So be it. Time to end this, once and for all.
We sign this for our future. Together, for mankind.
The generations to come will praise the choice we made today.
We may never share the same vision, but we can still protect our children by standing together.
You speak truly. Peaceful dissent drives progress, and it starts today.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_4_QuestObject: Look in the mirror after making your decision
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL4_Armistice_4_Room3_Quest: Why waste words, when weapons speak clearer.
Treachery! So, the Institute's true plan is to replace us one by one?
You assume it hasn't already happened and that we aren't just more copies. But if you insist.
I'm uncomfortable the Institute making Synths in our image.
We were made to understand you better. We are peaceful. Would we offer our weapons otherwise?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThePathofPaulaPlumbkin_QuestLon: You've found the journal of Paula Plumbkin, an Overseer who went searching for the mythical utopia, Vaultopolis. Follow in her footsteps! First stop - Vault 730.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThePathofPaulaPlumbkin_QuestSho: Follow the path of Paula Plumbkin to Vault 730.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThePathofPaulaPlumbkin_Conversa: Plumbkin! Paula Plumbkin! Where did she go?
Some old Nuka-Cola plant. Not that it matters. You ain't leavin' here alive!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AThirstforAdventure_QuestLongDe: Paula Plumbkin wasn't at Vault 730, but a helpful Raider told you she set out for the old Nuka-Cola plant. Go track her down!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AThirstforAdventure_QuestShortD: Follow the path of Paula Plumbkin to the old Nuka-Cola Plant.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AThirstforAdventure_Conversatio: Oh sure! Nice lady. The Ferals dragged her away, to some abandoned building.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PaulasinaPickle_QuestLongDescri: The Feral Ghouls from the old Nuka-Cola plant dragged Paula Plumbkin to an abandoned building. She needs rescuing!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PaulasinaPickle_QuestShortDescr: Rescue Paula Plumbkin from the Feral Ghouls!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PaulasinaPickle_Conversation_1_: Did Paula say where she was going?
I think she mentioned visiting some Vault? Vault 333? That's a lot of threes...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_QuestLongDescripti: Paula Plumbkin escaped from the Feral Ghouls and headed to Vault 333. Hopefully we can catch up with her there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_QuestShortDescript: Explore Vault 333 and find Paula Plumbkin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_Conversation_1_Tea: Ugh. Fine. What do we need to do?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_Conversation_1_NPC: Go kill that Raider jerk, Frank the Tank. He's in that building down the road. This might help.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_Conversation_1_Tea: Gladly! What can we do to help?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_Conversation_1_NPC: Could you kill Frank the Tank? He raids us all the time. He's in that building down the road. This might help.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_Conversation_1_Tea: Dang it, we've got questions! And you're going to answer them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_IntoVault333_Conversation_1_NPC: Tell you what. You kill Frank the Tank. He's in that building down the road. Then we'll talk. This might help.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Tankbusting_QuestLongDescriptio: The Overseer of Vault 333 might help us find Paula Plumbkin, but first we have to kill Frank the Tank.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Tankbusting_QuestShortDescripti: Find and kill Frank the Tank.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReturntoVault333_QuestLongDescr: Frank the Tank is dead. Now maybe the Settlers of Vault 333 will point us toward Paula Plumbkin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReturntoVault333_QuestShortDesc: Return to Vault 333 and get some answers.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CantStopTheSignal_QuestLongDesc: A strange, high-pitched sound is coming through over the radio. The signal seems to originate from an old, abandoned builidng.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HostageNegotiations_QuestLongDe: Raiders have been snatching up folks all over the Wasteland. Put an end to their scheme, and save their victims.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HostageNegotiations_QuestShortD: Defeat the kidnappers and save their victims.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APoorlyThoughtOutPlan_QuestLong: Raiders captured and attempted to domesticate a Deathclaw. It did not go well. They all need to die.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APoorlyThoughtOutPlan_QuestShor: Kill the Raiders and their Deathclaw.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TargetPractice_QuestLongDescrip: Your Dwellers can always use a chance to improve their weapon skills. It's not quite a target range, but the next best thing.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AgainstTheOdds_QuestLongDescrip: Okay, maybe 77 is an exaggeration, but there are a lot of them, and only one of you. Have you got what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MyMetalPony_QuestLongDescriptio: Will you use it for spare parts, or riding in your spare time? Up to you, you're the Overseer. Send Dwellers to get one!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MyMetalPony_Conversation_1_Team: This is a one-horse town, buddy.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MyMetalPony_Conversation_1_NPCE: We're not giving up without a fight!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MyMetalPony_Conversation_1_Team: Drop the reins and step away.
Give it up, or it's off to the glue factory for you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CoveWatch_QuestLongDescription: The Vault has received word of a TV pilot filming nearby. It's almost certainly a trap, but send your most physically attractive Dwellers dressed for the part just in case.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CoveWatch_QuestShortDescription: Auditions for a TV Show, or trap? Probably trap.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScorpionKing_QuestLongDescri: Folks are being stung all over, and the problem is coming from Earl's Radscorpion Emporium. Time to put him out of business.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScorpionKing_Conversation_1_: Look, I'll pay you. Just leave me alone!
Peddle your poison somewhere else, scoundrel!
I haven't got any more, thanks to you! Just take this and go!
You've been caught in the Pincers of Justice!
What does that even mean? Get outta here! I'll pay you to leave!
Try another line of work, like farming.
Your business advice is as lousy as your attitude! Here, leave me alone!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WondersofNature_QuestLongDescri: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, researching the mating habits of Radscorpions. Make sure he's not in over his head.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WondersofNature_QuestShortDescr: Dr. Hurfburg vs. Pincers of Peril!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WondersofScience_QuestLongDescr: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, searching for a modern-day Fountain of Youth. Find him, and learn what he's discovered!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WondersofScience_QuestShortDesc: Dr. Hurfburg is on a Quest for knowledge and adventure!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WondersofTechnology_QuestLongDe: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, working on a Mr. Handy capable of exploring space. See what he's discovered!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WondersofTechnology_QuestShortD: Dr. Hurfburg is on a Quest for knowledge and adventure!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScientificProgress_QuestLongDes: Cutting-edge science requires materials and demands sacrifice. So sacrifice some Raiders in the name of Science and take all their stuff!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScientificProgress_QuestShortDe: Don't let anything stand in the way of Science!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScientificProgress_Conversation: The future's a lot brighter without you in it!
Give me your clothes, your boots, and your motorcycle...
You ain't getting nothing from me!
Okay, I can respect that. But I'm still gonna kill you!
Yeah, well you'll leave in pieces!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CapturedCritter_QuestLongDescri: There's a lost and lonely animal who'd love to come home to your Vault. Too bad some hungry Ghouls found it first.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CapturedCritter_QuestShortDescr: Save a lost Pet from some hungry Ghouls.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CapturedCritter_QuestObjective_: Rescue the Pet from the hungry Ghouls.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBrothersGrime_QuestLongDescr: Few Raiders play dirtier than the two Raider bosses known as the Brothers Grime. Teach these black-hearted sibling scoundrels a lesson.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBrothersGrime_QuestShortDesc: Confront a dastardly pair of Raider siblings.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheBrothersGrime_Conversation_2: Let's mop the floor with this scrub!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AGatheringofGhouls_QuestLongDes: A ghastly Glowing One has taken up residence a little too close to the Vault, and it's drawing in Ghouls like moths to a flame. Extinguish the brilliant beacon before this Ghoulish gathering grows any larger!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AGatheringofGhouls_QuestShortDe: Confront a Glowing One and its Ghoul minions.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TooGoodtobeTrue_QuestLongDescri: That abandoned Vault stocked with supplies? That's Deathclaw territory now. How he got in there, nobody knows, but you won't get to the stash without facing him first. Time to break out the big guns!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TooGoodtobeTrue_QuestShortDescr: Claim a stash of supplies... if you can get past the Deathclaw that's guarding them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TooGoodtobeTrue_QuestObjective_: Claim the supply stash in the abandoned Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MyWeirdScienceProject_QuestLong: What better way to learn about the deadly Glowing Radscorpion than first-hand observation? Send your research team to the monster's lair. Of course, you'll need to kill it first.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MyWeirdScienceProject_QuestShor: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion in the name of science!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ShotgunWedding_QuestLongDescrip: A love-struck Raider boss has decided to get married, even though his bride-to-be wants no part of it. Save the kidnapped beauty from the clutches of her unwanted groom.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ShotgunWedding_QuestShortDescri: Rescue the kidnapped Vault Dweller from the Raider Boss.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DenofThieves_QuestLongDescripti: Red Rachel is a ruthless Raider boss, and she's stolen some of your supplies. Take back what's yours, and teach that reckless rogue a lesson!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DenofThieves_QuestShortDescript: Reclaim the stolen supplies from the Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DenofThieves_Conversation_1_Tea: Hand over those Caps, and you can walk out of here.
No deal. You're going to pay for what you did.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DenofThieves_Conversation_1_NPC: You want to play it rough? Then let's go!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Burnout_QuestLongDescription: Mole rats! Is there any creature more sneaky or disgusting? Grab a flamer and clear out a nest of those tunnelling terrors.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Burnout_QuestShortDescription: Put a nest of pesky Mole rats to the torch.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Burnout_QuestObjective_1: Clear out the Mole rat nest.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadiationLeak_QuestLongDescript: A neighboring Vault has had a massive radiation leak and the citizens have turned into Feral Ghouls!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadiationLeak_QuestShortDescrip: Send a team with Radiation Suits to a neighboring Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadiationLeak_Conversation_1_Te: We'll take our payment in Caps.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadiationLeak_Conversation_1_NP: The Vault armory had a few items left. Here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadiationLeak_Conversation_1_Te: We could always use more outfits.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadiationLeak_Conversation_1_NP: We won't be needing them, anyway. Here you go.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ArmsRace_QuestLongDescription: The gunsmith's plea came in loud and clear over the radio. “Feral Ghouls! Help! I'll give one of my best pieces to whoever bails me out!” Better hurry if you're going to claim that prize!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ArmsRace_QuestShortDescription: Save the gunsmith from the Feral Ghouls.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Ghooooooooooooooooooul_QuestLon: Strange radio signals have been emitting from Vault 93. Sounds like old sports broadcasts from before the bombs dropped. Go check it out!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Ghooooooooooooooooooul_Conversa: Holy cow! Can I have your autograph?
Absolutely! And here, take this, as well!
No, we've never heard of you, gramp.
Well, no need to be rude. I didn't ask for you to come barging in here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MondayNightBrawl_QuestLongDescr: A nearby Raider gang is calling you out! Time to show them who's boss...in style! Put on your best threads and start kicking butt!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MondayNightBrawl_Conversation_3: I'm not only going to embarrass you, I'm gonna take you out for good!
Hold still and this beating will be over faster.
I hope you've made your peace, Bednarski, because you're not walking away from this one.
Get ready to get hurt real bad, Vault Dweller!
And I've had enough of you, Bednarski! Time to take you out like the trash.
You ever pick up your teeth with broken fingers?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MondayNightBrawl_Conversation_2: The only clown I see here is you, Hatchet!
Yeah, I'm the circus magician. My first trick is making all your teeth disappear.
Meet the Human Cannonball. And I'm gonna blast right through you if you don't get out of my way!
Big words. Let's see if you can back them up.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MondayNightBrawl_Conversation_1: We're the punishment you've had coming for a long time, Embalmer!
Oh yeah? We'll see about that.
I came here to drink Nuka-Cola and kill chumps like you. And I'm all out of Nuka-Cola.
If we had a bottle cap for everytime we lost to chumps like you, we'd have ZERO CAPS!
Get ready to make your first cap, then!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WeaponsRun_QuestLongDescription: You've gotten a lead to a supply of Weapons out in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WeaponsRun_QuestObjective_1: Recover the main stash of Weapons.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OutfitRun_QuestLongDescription: You've gotten a lead to a supply of Outfits out in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OutfitRun_QuestObjective_1: Recover the main stash of Outfits.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ACryforHelp_QuestLongDescriptio: One of your Wasteland explorers has heard a cry for help that's coming from a Red Rocket fuel station. Time to rush to the rescue!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ACryforHelp_QuestShortDescripti: Someone in a Red Rocket Truck Stop is calling for help.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ACryforHelp_QuestObjective_1: Investigate the Red Rocket Truck Stop.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ACryforHelp_Conversation_1_Team: Your troubles are over. The Vault's got everything you need.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ACryforHelp_Conversation_1_NPCE: In that case, sign me up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleanUpOnAisleFive_QuestLongDes: A group of Raiders that have been preying on the locals is using a Super Duper Mart as their headquarters. Time to take down their leader!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleanUpOnAisleFive_QuestShortDe: Kill the Raider Boss at the Super Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleanUpOnAisleFive_QuestObjecti: Kill the Raider Boss at the Super Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandGetaway_QuestLongDescr: You came across a small secluded cabin while adventuring in the Wasteland. Perhaps you should see what's inside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WastelandGetaway_QuestShortDesc: You found a secluded Cabin in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ManonFirst_QuestLongDescription: Somewhere out there in the Wasteland is the Jersey of legendary baseball player Rackie Jobinson. Play ball!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ManonFirst_QuestShortDescriptio: Find the Jersey of baseball legend Rackie Jobinson!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ManonFirst_QuestObjective_1: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BacktotheOutfield_QuestLongDesc: We found a note from someone named Coach, who claims he has Rackie Jobinson's Jersey! Maybe he's hiding out in the ruins of Vault 428...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SeventhInningStretch_QuestLongD: Does Coach really have the Jersey? Evidence suggests he may be in an old office building, so it's worth a look.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SeventhInningStretch_QuestShort: Hunt Coach down in an office building.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LetsKnockitOuttathePark_QuestLo: A note from someone named Henrietta has led us to Vault 232. Hopefully she can lead us to Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LetsKnockitOuttathePark_QuestSh: Can Henrietta lead us to the Jersey?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WhosonFirst_QuestLongDescriptio: Henrietta was Coach's old girlfriend. She doesn't know where he is, but gave us a sweet weapon to help take him down. The search goes on!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PlayBall_QuestLongDescription: We found a Rackie Jobinson baseball card with a taunting note from Coach. Looks like he really does have the Jersey. But we'll never give up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThrowMeSomePepper_QuestLongDesc: Some Raiders have taken over an old apartment complex. Maybe these jerks know the big jerk, Coach. Can't hurt to ask!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThrowMeSomePepper_QuestShortDes: Do the Raiders know where Coach is?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThrowMeSomePepper_Conversation_: We came to kill Raiders and eat Cram. And we're all out of Cram!
We're looking for a guy named Coach. You seen him?
That nut wearing the Baseball Jersey? Aint seen him! Now beat it.
We're not Vault Dwellers! We killed them, and stole their suits!
That's it! We've had enough of you... you... Bad guys!!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JuuussstttaBitOutside_QuestLong: Okay, so the Raiders didn't lead us to Coach. It was worth a shot. Maybe he's taking a nap in the old mattress factory!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JuuussstttaBitOutside_QuestShor: Explore the mattress factory to find Coach.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CoveringAlltheBases_QuestLongDe: Still no sign of Coach, or Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Time to venture farther out. No risk, no reward!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CoveringAlltheBases_QuestShortD: Search farther out for Coach and the Jersey.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LastInningOrnot_Conversation_2_: Batting practice? Against a Deathclaw? So Coach is evil AND a complete idiot.
He's tough. I never said he was smart.
Thanks for the info. I suppose now we kill each other?
I swear, if that Deathclaw rips Jobinson's Jersey, I'm going to be SO mad.
That's the least of your worries, meat sack!
That's crazy! Coach is as good as dead! Let me go and I can help him!
You think I'd fall for your Vault-Tec lies?! Never!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AWinningSeason_QuestLongDescrip: We have word that a fierce Alpha Deathclaw has taken up residence in an old office building. Maybe it killed Coach! Dare to dream, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AWinningSeason_QuestShortDescri: Did an Alpha Deathclaw take Coach out?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MVPoftheYear_QuestLongDescripti: Coach survived the Alpha Deathclaw, but he won't survive me! The Sultan of Slime left another narcissistic note, so we know he's still out there. The search continues!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MVPoftheYear_QuestShortDescript: Keep tracking Coach and the Jersey!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HomerunDerby_QuestLongDescripti: Call it a gut feeling, but Coach may be taking a breather in the ruins of Holy Heart Hospital. If he's there, so is Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HowCanYouNotBeRomanticAboutBase: Okay, so Holy Heart Hospital was a dead end. But at least we're still alive! Next stop, the ruins of Lakeville Library.
Track Coach down in the Lakeville Library.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunnersinScoringPosition_QuestL: Coach left a taunting message spray painted on the wall of the Lakeville Library! We're closing in! Time to search the ruins of Vault 789.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HerestoYouRackieJobinson_QuestL: This is it, the end of the game! It's a bench-clearing brawl with Coach in the Dugout. Time to retire this washout, and claim Rackie Jobinson's Jersey for our own!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HerestoYouRackieJobinson_QuestS: Bottom of the 9th! Head to the Dugout and get that Jersey!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HerestoYouRackieJobinson_Conver: Do you have any idea what we've been through? That Outfit's Ours!
Time to send you back down to the minors!
Coach shmoach! We're not leaving without that Outfit!
Oh, you're gonna strike out sooooo hard!
Pfft. Please. We could do this in our sleep at this point.
Now this is a real bench clearer!
We've been in, like, a million fights. I don't suppose you'd just walk away?
Hmmm. Okay, sure. Why not. But be careful. Coach is no joke!
Try not to bleed too much on my Jersey!
Henrietta?! I should have known that lousy lass was involved!
Bottom of the Ninth. 2 Outs. Tie game. We swing for the fences!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScenicRoute_QuestLongDescrip: A keen-eyed Wasteland explorer has spotted a lonely cabin in the distance. Looks like someone, or something, is lurking inside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScenicRoute_QuestShortDescri: Who, or what, is lurking in that cabin? Only one way to find out...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScenicRoute_Conversation_1_T: You should head for our Vault. You'll be safer there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScenicRoute_Conversation_1_N: I was hoping you'd say that!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScenicRoute_Conversation_1_T: The Ghouls upstairs are dead. You'll be safe here now.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheScenicRoute_Conversation_1_N: Safe... here? Oh. Thanks, I guess.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CabinWithoutTheWoods_QuestLongD: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers discovered a spooky cabin in the middle of nowhere. It's not haunted... probably.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CabinWithoutTheWoods_QuestShort: Eliminate the Ghouls in the Abandoned Cabin.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PartyCrasher_QuestLongDescripti: One of your Dwellers came aross an old cabin in the Wasteland. Sounds like somebody's having a party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PartyCrasher_QuestShortDescript: You found an old cabin out in the Wasteland!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PartyCrasher_Conversation_1_Tea: Invitation? Let's just say it got lost in the mail.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PartyCrasher_Conversation_1_NPC: Mail? How 'bout you tell me what that is after we kill you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PartyCrasher_Conversation_1_Tea: No squares? Then how'd you get invited?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PartyCrasher_Conversation_1_NPC: Huh? I don't -- Shut up! I'll have your head!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PartyCrasher_Conversation_1_Tea: This party's dead, and so are you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BigTrouble_QuestLongDescription: Clever Alpha Deathclaw, hiding in that Red Rocket Fuel station to ambush unsuspecting travelers. There's only one way to deal with a threat like that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BigTrouble_QuestShortDescriptio: Eliminate the Alpha Deathclaw lurking in the Red Rocket Fuel Station.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_QuestLongDescription: One of your Dwellers encountered a Raider in an abandoned Red Rocket. Stop him before he heads for your Vault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_QuestShortDescription: Eliminate the Raider in the Red Rocket.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_Conversation_1_Team_1: I'm just here for the loot.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_1: Yeah, me too! I'll take everything you got, then pay your friends and family a visit!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_Conversation_1_Team_2: Can I get unleaded on pump number two?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_2: I'll make sure you get plenty of lead!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_Conversation_1_Team_3: Sorry, my Vault's all full. You'll have to go somewhere else.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_Conversation_1_NPCEnd_3: It'll be empty by the time I get done with it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GasNGo_Conversation_1_Team_4: Don't mind me, I'll be on my way.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FashionStatement_QuestLongDescr: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers came across a Red Rocket. Perhaps it's worth taking a look.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FashionStatement_QuestShortDesc: You came across an old Red Rocket!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FashionStatement_Conversation_1: Long enough. Spikes and leather are totally in by the way.
With taste like that, you deserve to die!
You said it. Those pants do you no favors.
I knew it! But you're dead for noticing!
I don't know, I think you look good.
What does a Vault Dweller know anyway? You're dead!
Hey, Raiders can have fashion sense. I'll show you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GetinLine_QuestLongDescription: One of your Wasteland explorers discovered a Super-Duper Mart, but some Raiders beat you to it. Run them off and grab some supplies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GetinLine_QuestShortDescription: Battle the Raiders in the Super-Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_QuestLongDescription: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers encountered a Raider-infested Super-Duper Mart. Get the jump on those jerks!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_QuestShortDescription: Eliminate the Raiders in the Super-Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1A_Team_: Ah, Sugar Bombs. Now with 100% daily allowance of... death!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1A_NPCEn: Now that sounds like a balanced breakfast!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1A_Team_: Didn't your momma ever teach you to share?
Sugar Bombs? Those things'll kill ya. But let me give you a shortcut.
Nah. Those things give me the jitters. I'm just here to kill you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1B_NPCEn: Hmmm... Nah. I think you're here to get yourself killed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1B_Team_: Maybe a little bit of both?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1B_NPCEn: I think we can arrange that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1B_Team_: Actually, I'm the new district manager. And you're fired!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1C_NPCEn: Fine. Let's get this over with.
Great, a comedian. I HATE comedians.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1C_Team_: Don't make this harder than it has to be.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1C_NPCEn: I was just going to say the same to you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1C_Team_: Sorry, but good guys kill bad guys. It's the law of the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1C_NPCEn: Well, clearly, I have a blatant disregard for the law...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1D_Team_: Ooooh. I love me some Cram. Don't mind if I do.
You do realize that stuff is, like, 200 years old?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1D_NPCEn: It gets better with age! Die, food snob!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1D_Team_: I don't want it, honest. But I do want to kill you. Soooo...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1D_NPCEn: First you die! Then I eat more Cram!!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1E_Team_: Oh. Well... no. I'm here to kill you, actually.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1E_NPCEn: Ah. As I suspected. Vault Dweller vs. Raider. The battle eternal. Shall we, then?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1E_Team_: I'm just here to get me some tasty grub.
Well. You're, um... not what I expected.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1E_NPCEn: Indubitably. I am a Raider, after all. Refined palate notwithstanding.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1E_Team_: Oh great. A foodie. How pretentious.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FoodFight_Conversation_1E_NPCEn: Hmph. And they call ME a barbarian...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExpressCheckout_QuestLongDescri: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers stumbled upon a Super-Duper Mart. Surely there's something useful inside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExpressCheckout_Conversation_1_: Found this in the rubble. You want it, it's yours.
Look, I'm sorry. A Ghoul's gotta eat. You want this instead?
Were those Ferals friends of yours?
Nah, I just bumped into them. Say, you want this?
Doesn't everybody?! There may not be any left, but I did find this...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PostApocolypticWorldProblems_Qu: One of your Dwellers stumbled across a Super Duper Mart while out in the Wasteland. Perhaps you'll find something useful inside...
You've found a Super-Duper Mart while out exploring!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PostApocolypticWorldProblems_Co: Fine, fine. I'll find it myself. Kids these days!
I don't think you're going to find those here...
And I thought employees were supposed to be helpful. I'll be writing your manager a letter!
Sorry, we stopped carrying those a couple hundred years ago.
Never kid a kidder! I know they're here. I'll find them one way or another.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_QuestLongDescripti: Let's put these Raider Outfits to good use! Send some Dwellers to spy on one of the Raider camps.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_QuestShortDescript: Send your Dwellers in disguise to spy on a Raider Camp!

resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_Conversation_1A_Te: Actually, we're Vault Dwellers in disguise. Here to spy on you!

resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_Conversation_2A_Te: Sounds like you want to get out of Raiding yourself.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_Conversation_2A_NP: You know, what? Yeah. It's time. I'm out of here first chance I get.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_Conversation_2A_Te: You're just weak! We'll be breaking bones forever!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_Conversation_2A_NP: Who are you calling weak? I can still break bones with the best of them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpyonRaiders_Conversation_2A_Te: Could you say that again? We have to write it down because we're spying on you.

resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScienceCooperative_QuestLongDes: A group of scientists have asked for our help. They're in a dangerous area out in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScienceCooperative_QuestShortDe: Send your Dwellers out to aid scientists in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ScienceCooperative_Conversation: Make us some Laser Rifles, nerd.
No. I won't. Now why don't you move along and let me science?
Astounding! Do you use a helium-neon mixture for the laser gain medium?
In fact, we do! It's so nice to meet another scientist! Take a look at this piece I've been working on!
This is a terrible place to do laser research.
That's the Wasteland for you! Feel free to look around.
We prefer ones that set people on fire.
Oh no, that won't do at all! Thanks for your opinion, though. Forgive me, I need to ponder.
Use a proton emitter. It's positively positronic!
Of course! It all makes sense now! Here, for your vital assistance!
We honestly don't know. Go with your heart.
An organic beam emitter? I think that technology might be far too advanced. Oh well...
That just sounds like vandalism.
Vandalism for science! Never mind. You just don't get it. Excuse me.
A Physics Club? How positively Newtonian!
I know! Check out this little project I've been working on. Here!
This place isn't exactly safe for doing science experiments.
It's not ideal, but that's the price of progress! Sorry. I should get back to it.
You're the scientist. Figure it out!
Hmph. Fine. I'll just continue studying this on my own. Now leave.
Density has nothing to do with weight.
Wait. It doesn't? Of course! I think... Here. Take this for your trouble!
We don't know, and we don't care.
Hmph. Fine. I'll just continue studying this on my own. Now leave.
Chemistry is useless for anything but explosives.
Such a barbaric attitude! We clearly have nothing more to discuss.
A coalition of chemists? That's dynamite!
It is! I've been making a few new compounds. Check them out!
You should leave. It's not safe.
Nonsense! Science is not a coward's game! Now, if you'll excuse me...
That's what you're studying? How is boiling water supposed to help anyone?
I don't need your nay-saying! Just get out of here! Leave me to my work.
The water isn't being destroyed. It's changing from a liquid to a gas.
What? Of course! It's so obvious now! Here. A stipend for your insights.
Maybe it just doesn't like your stupid face.
Insults? Hmph. Fine. Leave me alone then.
So what you're saying is, you're useless.
How dare you! These people are dead, but not forgotten! Now leave me alone!
You're studying the dead? That's captivatingly cadaverous!
Finally people who understand! Here, for a fellow sawbones!
The Wasteland is dangerous. There's no time to study dead people.
Science waits for nothing, I'm afraid. I must continue. If you'll excuse me.
This is most disgusting conversation we've ever had.
If your stomach can't stand the science, get out of the lab!
Well, one reason is that the body isn't alive anymore to fight off bacteria and fungus.
An interesting theory! Thank you. Here. Have something for your trouble.
If you think the smell is bad, you don't want to know about the taste.
Are you saying you're... cannibals? Um... maybe you should just go.
Flowers and smiles are useless. Only cruelty rules the Wasteland!
Now what kind of an attitude is that? Why don't you get away from my plants?
We hope you're growing some delightful daffodils and righteous roses!
Hurray! Glad you appreciate my work. Here. Take a little something.
No offense, but this is a dangerous place to be gardening.
It's not just gardening, it's science! Never mind. Just leave me to my work.
The only light you need is the shine from our amazing brilliance!
Uh, yes. Well, I should get back to work...

resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheMysteryofVault666_QuestLongD: While adventuring, a Dweller discovered a map to Vault 666. It's not on any official Vault-Tec registry. What secrets could it hold?

resolvedText.QuestLoc_Vault789_QuestLongDescription: While out exploring, one of your Dwellers found an old advertisement for Vault 789. Time to check it out!

resolvedText.QuestLoc_BottlecapBlues_QuestLongDescrip: Bottle & Cappy have been kidnapped from Nuka-World by Raiders! They were last spotted at an abandoned factory. Head out there and rescue them before it's too late!

Did you see Spot run? Not there you didn't. Lose Your Head!
Dogmeat.
Right you are! We have a winner! Unfortunately...
The President.
Where do you come up with these answers? Lose Your Head!
Thanksgiving.
Just like Thanksgiving turkey, you're going to... Lose Your Head!
Halloween.
You're right! Now THAT is terrifying.
Labor Day.
Wrong. Now we are going to labor so you... Lose Your Head!
Shrove Tuesday.
Is that even a real holiday? Nevermind. Just... Lose Your Head!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GameShowGauntletJ_Conversation_: Connecticut.
Just a hair too south. Speaking of hair... Lose Your Head!
Maine.
Yes! Foggy, frosty and frightening Maine.
Rhode Island.
No. Just no. We're going to do this real slow as you... Lose Your Head!
State of confusion.
Ha ha ha ha ha! Almost as funny as when you... Lose Your Head!
Robot.
Kinda looks like one, but wrong. Now you... Lose Your Head!
Synth.
Bing, bing, bing! Winner, winner, chicken dinner.
Computer.
Nah. He's a Synth, you idiot. Which means you... Lose Your Head!
A deluxe hamburger.
Wow. You have quite the imagination. But now you will... Lose Your Head!
The Nucleus.
Aw! I hate it when they guess right. Go on. Get out of here.
Mount Desert Island Naval Facility.
That's its pre-war name! Too bad you have to... Lose Your Head!
Acadia Federal Naval Base.
Nope. Nein. Nyet. And now you'll... Lose Your Head!
Uh... Joe's Spuckies?
Dang it. Now I'm hungry. Just for that, you're going to... Lose Your Head!
She wanted to live a life of adventure.
Right! No, wait, wrong! Totally wrong. Now you... Lose Your Head!
Her mother was cruel to her.
Wrongo. But I'm going to be cruel to you by making you... Lose Your Head!
She believed she was a Synth.
Winner, winner, chicken dinner!
Kasumi ran away? How horrible!
Focus. That's not even an answer. So you'll have to... Lose Your Head!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GameShowGauntletK_Conversation_: Right! I would also have accepted Operators or The Pack.
Right! I would also have accepted Disciples or The Pack.
Right! I would also have accepted Disciples or Operators.
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha. Now... Lose Your Head!
Good choice, but oh so wrong. So long, you're about to... Lose Your Head!
Nope. Overkill much? We're all going to watch as you... Lose Your Head!
Love that gun, but it won't do the trick. So now you... Lose Your Head!
Yes! Those idiots refuse to accept it's just a carnival ride.
Nice try, but so very wrong. Time for you to... Lose Your Head!
No! You lose, you loser. On top of that, you get to... Lose Your Head!
Brahmin, leeks and turnips? Yum! But wrong. Lose Your Head!
Darn, that's right. Nuka-Cola is anything but fresh.
Wrong. You won't see another sunrise, because you're about to... Lose Your Head!
Ha! I'm drinking some now. Come on, you have to... Lose Your Head!
Fool. That's a really common flavor. It's time to... Lose Your Head!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReview_QuestL: Vault-Tec wants you to check up on some... experiments we're running in the other Vaults.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReview_QuestS: Check in on the experiments in other Vaults.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReviewE_Conve: Red?
Sorry, you lose. Better luck next time!
Black.
You're a winner!
We bet on... Death! Kill them!
The bets are off and the fix is in!
Queen of Hearts?
Always your best bet! You win.
Ace of spades?
Loser!
How about we kill you first? Attack!
Looks like the house loses!
We like backing up our luck with weaponry.
Critical hit!
We'll roll our fortunes on new clothes.
Take my lucky suit!
We'll take home our winnings in Caps.
All right. Let's cash you out.
We'll take that junk in the prize window.
Hey, glad someone finally wants it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReviewF_Conve: We prefer boxing to wrestling. Sorry.
What kind of talk is that? Out of the ring!
You'll never defeat... The Deathclaw Dive!
Oh no! Such an awesome move! We're done for!
Our counter-move is we kill all of you!
No holds barred!
We are... The Vault Vigilantes!
A fearsome name to shake the ring for years to come!
Our team name is... The Only Ones Who Aren't Idiots.
Mocking the ring? Time to knock you down for the count!
This is dumb, and we're going to murder you.
Time to clean up your act!
Got any weapons we can take?
Weapons are banned in the ring... But yeah, of course!
How about a wrestler outfit of our very own?
Oh yeah!
Care to share some Caps?
Here. From my last match.
You guys don't have any junk for crafting, do you?
As it so happens, I have this. It's yours!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReviewB_Conve: Secrets? What secrets?
Super-secret secrets, that's what! We'll never talk!
Don't worry. We'll keep your secrets. We were never even here.
Yes! Now take this briefcase. This meeting never took place...
We'll beat your secrets out of you!
Rogue agents! Code red!
Of course. We'll tell you everything!
Excellent. You're our double-agents now!
Here's some choice intel: it's underground.
You think we're idiots? Get them!
No one spies on our Vault. Attack!
Contact! Kill everyone!
Surely you have a secret doomsday weapon you can share?
All I have is this, but you're welcome to it.
How about some spiffy spy clothes?
This is our uniform. Take one.
Forget secrets. We only trade in bottlecaps.
Fine. Take all you need.
We have some secret crafting projects we need junk for.
I like it. Here you are.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReviewC_Conve: You're all ridiculous.
Such odd manners of speech! Off with you.
Huzzah! We are here to trade with you, good knights!
Here is the bounty from our last quest.
Face our blades... er... guns! Attack!
Have at thee!
By our honor, we so swear!
We dub thee: Knights of the Realm!
News flash: you're in a Vault, not a castle!
What nonsense! Away with thee!
We got your Chivalry right here! Get them!
To arms!
We seek weapons to protect our kingdom!
And you shall have them.
We dig the knight outfits. Can we have one?
May this armor protect you from harm.
Got any cash, king?
The treasures of our land are yours.
Any crafting junk in this land of yours?
Our blacksmiths may have something of interest. Here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReviewA_Conve: You're not dead, you're just wearing a sheet.
No, I'm a ghost! Booooooo!
Oh no, a ghost! Uh... We're so scared! What will we do?!
Muwhahaha! Take this and run, little Dwellers!
Let's see if ghosts can die twice. Attack!
Ha! You can't hurt us! Wait... Ow!
Three words: Never. Ending. Deathclaws.
Monstrously horrific! Here. A reward.
You'll all die alone and unloved?
Existentially dreadful, but not enough! Die!
Forget this. We're just going to kill you.
Ha! Now that's scary! For YOU!
Nothing scarier than overwhelming firepower.
Ha ha! Here you are.
We need some spooky clothes.
Here. One of my spare outfits.
You say you don't need Caps? We're happy to take all of them!
Here. Nothing about money scares us.
Any frightful crafting junk in this Vault?
Here. May you make something spooky with it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_VaultTecExperimentReviewD_Conve: No one calls us Gary! Attack!
We know the answer to this. It's Gary.
We're all about that sack of bottlecaps.
That junk looks useful for crafting.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HoneymoonHorror_QuestLongDescri: Some newlyweds from a nearby settlement went to a secluded cave to “celebrate” in private. They haven't returned, and neither has the original rescue party! Maybe those rumors of Radscorpions are true after all. Better gear up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HoneymoonHorror_QuestShortDescr: Rescue the newlyweds from the Radscorpions.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HoneymoonHorror_QuestObjective_: Discover the fate of the original rescue party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HoneymoonHorror_Conversation_1_: To do your job. So hand over those Stimpaks.
Awesome, we're off the hook! Here you go.
To do your job. Now give us your RadAway. You won't be needing them.
Awesome, we're off the hook! Here you go.
To do your job. And we'll be taking one of your Laser Rifles to help us out.
Fine by us! Here you go.
To do your job. But we'll keep quiet about your cowardice if you've got enough Caps.
I guess that's fair. A good reputation isn't going to keep itself!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HoneymoonHorror_Conversation_2_: Would you please just shut up and go home already? You've caused enough trouble.
Fine. But you're stuck with the ugly dress they gave me. A dusty Librarian Outfit? Really?
Actually, there's room in my Vault for one more person. Patricia, you can come.
Darling, I'll never forget you as I toil away in complete safety. Stay strong!
You know... there's room in my Vault for one more person. Grant, you're invited.
My husband would never aband... Oh, you want to go? Fine then. Go.
Sure, I'll just tell your settlement the Radscorpions got you.
Thanks! But can you also take this Formal Wear back for us? It's a rental.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingA_QuestLongDe: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send strong and perceptive Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingA_QuestShortD: Do strong and perceptive Dwellers have what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingA_Conversatio: Caves are damp and pointy rocks are pointy. We know enough to win.
Yeah, sure you do. When this is over, you'll recognize your betters!
Simple minds are always so quick to violence...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingB_QuestLongDe: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send charming and perceptive Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingB_QuestShortD: Do charming and perceptive Dwellers have what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingB_Conversatio: Okay, who forgot the Stealth Boys?
We'll just have to scratch you wannabe ninjas here and now.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingC_QuestLongDe: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send tough and lucky Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingC_QuestShortD: Do tough and lucky Dwellers have what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingC_Conversatio: Nice try, but an Overseer already controls our every move.
So we're being watched right now? Interesting...
Our Overseer wants us to kill you.
Fight to the death? How predictable.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingD_QuestLongDe: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send tough and smart Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingD_QuestShortD: Do tough and smart Dwellers have what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingD_Conversatio: Thanks! Such good sportsmanship is rare.
You just deserve to win, and we'll watch your back until you do.
I see what you did there. It's time to shut you up.
Are you sure we can't just talk this over?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingE_QuestLongDe: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send charming and agile Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingE_QuestShortD: Do charming and agile Dwellers have what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingE_Conversatio: It'll take much more than brute strength to win!
Ha! I think you need a longer look at our amazing muscles.
Your muscles can't be allowed to make it to the competition.
Ha! Have you seen our swords?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingF_QuestLongDe: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send strong and smart Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingF_QuestShortD: Do strong and smart Dwellers have what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingF_Conversatio: No dice! The Vault always wins.
Then let the chips fall where they may!
Not if we stop you and your unbearable expressions right now.
All bets are off! Get them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingG_QuestLongDe: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send lucky and agile Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingG_QuestShortD: Do lucky and agile Dwellers have what it takes?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpelunKingTrainingG_Conversatio: No one insults us and lives!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadroachRoundup_QuestLongDescri: A distress call has come in from a nearby science lab studying Radroaches. Thieves stole their Radiation Suits and released all the Radroaches to cover their escape. Now the scientists are in over their heads and asking for help!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadroachRoundup_QuestShortDescr: Save scientists from the Radroaches they were studying.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadroachRoundup_QuestObjective_: Save the first group of scientists.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadroachRoundup_Conversation_1_: Yes, they said they were Pests. You can say that again!
Do you know why they wanted your Radiation Suits?
No, but they kept saying, “Blessed be the irradiated.”
What do we need to know about this Radroach Queen?
She sends the others into a frenzy. If you kill her, we should be able to round up the rest.
Do you know where the thieves went?
No, sorry. They just vanished into the Wasteland. Like... *dare I say it?*... Radroaches.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadroachRoundup_QuestObjective_: Save the second group of scientists.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RadroachRoundup_Conversation_2_: No, she's still somewhere in the building.
Egads! We can't herd the rest into their cages while she's still around.
Yes, we took care of her.
Wonderful! We'll be able to herd the rest into their cages now.
Never mind that. What's this about Pestilence? Isn't that one of the Four Horsemen?
Of the Apocalypse, yes. I'd guess that someone has taken its name and recruited followers.
The Plagued or the Contagion would have been a much better name.
Exactly! A name that strikes fear. A name with gravitas!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_UndercoverOperations_QuestLongD: An underground military base is under attack and calling in all their Wasteland patrols. Could it be the Pests again? We need to stop them! But we'll need Military Fatigues to pass as one of the patrols and get into the base...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_UndercoverOperations_QuestShort: Infiltrate a military base to stop the Pest attack!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_UndercoverOperations_QuestObjec: Stop the attack on the military base.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_UndercoverOperations_Conversati: No I mean a magical voodoo army... Of course I mean Ghouls! Now go!
Next time a Feral Ghoul is in my face, I'll make sure to listen to what it's saying. Now go!
No, just the same rags every Feral Ghoul wears. Hmm, why is that? No matter, just go!
Did they say anything about Pestilence?
You think the Feral Ghouls might be infected? We'll call for medics. Now go!
The Hungry Horde? So you aren't Pests?
Those frauds aren't nearly hungry enough. But we are. Let our hunger consume you!
Famine? Like the Horseman of the Apocalypse?
The GREATEST Horseman to you. Now let our hunger consume you!
Fresh meat. Fresh meat. Rolls off the tongue. Thanks. Now let our hunger consume you!
You're very hungry and you follow Famine. Think there's a connection?
Don't be a wiseguy. No one likes a wiseguy. Now let our hunger consume you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_QuestLongDescription: Famine and Pestilence are out there, whoever they are, with followers to spare. War and Death are the other infamous Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Are they terrorizing the Wasteland as well? If anyone knows, it's Three Dog at Galaxy News Radio. Let's go talk to him.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_QuestShortDescription: Talk to Three Dog about the Horsemen of the Apocalypse.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_3_Team_1: Do you know where we can find any of the Horsemen's cults?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_3_NPCEnd: Nope. But the Pests are greedy for protective gear. You could use some to lure them into a trap...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_2_Team_1: None of them. We're Vault Dwellers and we'll stop the Horsemen.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_2_NPCEnd: With those cute little blue suits of yours that are *so* intimidating, right?
Oh no! The Pests have come to take our outfits! I'm shaking in my boots. Not.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_2_Team_3: Famine. Let our hunger consume you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_2_NPCEnd: You certainly don't look very hungry. Those Ghouls must be fattening you up for later.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_2_Team_4: Death. But we haven't picked a slogan yet.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogsofWar_Conversation_2_NPCEnd: Death finally makes a move and decides to send *you*? That's rather anticlimactic.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringingtheTrap_QuestLongDescr: At Three Dog's advice, we spread the word that a dozen suits of Power Armor were hidden in a particular cave. The Pests took the bait and are currently inside, searching for the suits. It's time to head in there and find out what we can about Pestilence and the Pests!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringingtheTrap_QuestShortDesc: Get answers from the Pests lured into your trap.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringingtheTrap_Conversation_3: So what's all this talk about being unworthy?
Cult logic, I guess. Just don't try telling them Pestilence's “blessing” would kill them.
No, I don't know why but it leaves the Pests alone while they're in fully enclosed outfits.
What makes this Glowing Radscorpion so special?
Nothing. As far as I can tell, it's just a regular beast. Beats me why they worship it.
Why call themselves Pests? The Unworthy would have been much better.
You're preaching to the choir, but they aren't exactly the sharpest tools in the shed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringingtheTrap_QuestObjective: Talk to the first group of Pests.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringingtheTrap_Conversation_1: The blessing would be nice. Where is Pestilence?
Roaming the Wasteland, unfortunately. For now, you can help us find Power Armor down here.
A true believer would already know, heathen!
Pestilence's blessing is radiation? Doesn't that harm his followers?
Harm?! How dare you insult Pestilence, you heretic!
That works! And it's even true. He's always covered in bits of earth. Thank you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringingtheTrap_QuestObjective: Talk to the second group of Pests.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SpringingtheTrap_Conversation_2: No luck either. Remind me, why are we looking for these suits?
So no one can avoid Pestilence's blessing, of course! But a real follower would know that...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_QuestLongDescript: A reporter for the Weekly Exposition newspaper, undercover as a Pest, told us about Pestilence and asked us to relay a message to his editor. He also said there are reporters hidden among the Hungry and the Warshippers, so let's go to the Exposition's offices and find out what they know!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_QuestShortDescrip: Visit the offices of the Weekly Exposition.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_1_Te: One of your reporters discovered that Pestilence is a Glowing Radscorpion.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_1_NP: Excellent news, thanks! If you want to keep helping, just go on in and talk to my people.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_2_NP: He's been around long enough to be a legend to children and veterans alike.
Maybe the hunger comes with age? No known Glowing One is as old.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_2_Te: Is the Hungry Horde made entirely of Ghouls?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_2_NP: Absolutely. The non-feral ones makes the decisions for the whole pack.
Yes. He probably has no idea he's gathered such a following.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_3_Te: Why do you think he's in over his head?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_3_NP: He's trying to be the War people expect, but it seems he's not very good at it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_3_Te: What feats do the rumors say he performed?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_3_NP: Killed six Deathclaws with his bare hands, for one, but it's a myth! The truth is long gone.
Conquest. Everyone can join the Warshippers, at least, but those who don't are attacked.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_3_Te: Why did they start calling him War in the first place?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_3_NP: That's a good question, but no one knows. Same for the other Horsemen. It can't be coincidence...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_4_Te: We're Vault Dwellers trying to help. Is there any way to identify your reporters?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_Conversation_4_NP: They'll mention Nuka-Cola. If you reply with “eagle,” they'll know you're a friend.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BeatReporting_QuestObjective_1: Visit the offices of the Weekly Exposition.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MatterstoSettle_QuestLongDescri: Three Dog reports that the Pests and the Hungry are about to face off right where a settlement stands! We need to stop them and save as many Settlers as possible. Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MatterstoSettle_QuestShortDescr: Save a settlement caught between the Pests and the Hungry.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MatterstoSettle_Conversation_1_: Yes! We've come to stop this madness. Are there any more Settlers trapped in here?
Only a few. Most people got out in time thanks to Three Dog's warning. Please save them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MatterstoSettle_Conversation_2_: The Vault always needs extra hands. You'll fit right in.
Alright then. I'll see you back at your Vault.
The offer is appreciated, but you belong here, protecting the other Settlers.
That's mighty kind of you to say. I won't let you down.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MatterstoSettle_Conversation_3_: Leave this settlement now and things won't have to get ugly.
No problem, no problem! I was just on my way out.
Yes... exactly. And then I'd still be hungry. Silly me.
The eagle flies over the brahmin herd.
Oh good, I can finally stop talking about hunger. Here's a gun I found. I hope it helps.
The quail rustles in the bushes.
That's... nice. How about we each just go on our way?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MatterstoSettle_Conversation_4_: It is not. The Warshippers will be very upfront about trying to kill you on the way to War.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MatterstoSettle_QuestObjective_: Search the settlement for Pests and Hungry.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_QuestLongDescription: The Horseman, War, has invited us to discuss matters of common interest. His messenger told us the Warshippers would try to kill us, but it's worth the risk to find out what he wants! Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_QuestShortDescriptio: Meet with War, who invited you to talk.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_Team_: That's fine, but you should reconsider your warring ways.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_NPCEn: Absolutely. Whatever you say. I'll get right on that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_Team_: The eagle has landed. Now what does War want with us?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_NPCEn: The codeword! Well he really just wants to talk, believe it or not, and set up a truce.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_Team_: The eagle soars on the wind. How did War get that name in the first place?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_NPCEn: The codeword! Some Raiders just started using it one day, but I think someone gave them the idea.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_Team_: The beagle runs after the ball. Does War have any weaknesses we can take advantage of?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_2_NPCEn: Beagle? Eh, close enough. His confidence is easily shaken, so make him doubt himself.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_Team_: Sure, but keep your Warshippers away from innocent Settlers.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_NPCEn: I DON'T TAKE ORDERS FROM Y... Sorry, I got caught up. No problem, we'll leave 'em alone.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_Team_: Absolutely. You are, after all, the most powerful Horseman.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_NPCEn: Thank you. I try really hard, and it's nice to know the effort isn't wasted.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_Team_: Okay, but are you *really* War? We were expecting more intimidation.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_NPCEn: Drat. I try, I really do. Here, I'll give you this if you tell the Warshippers I awed you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_Team_: Yes, it's a deal. What else can you tell us about Death?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ParleyTime_Conversation_3_NPCEn: Only that... Sorry... ONLY THAT I WILL KILL HIM AND REIGN SUPREME.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrimeSceneInvestigation_QuestLo: Huzzah! We now have a truce with War until the other Horsemen are dealt with! To that end, War claims that the servants of Death attacked Vault 672. So we're off to investigate and look for any clues they may have left behind...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrimeSceneInvestigation_QuestSh: Search for clues about Death in Vault 672.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrimeSceneInvestigation_Convers: Wait a sec! Can we just talk about th-
I said “Let our hunger consume you”!
But your entire philosophy makes no sense! And “Pests” is a stupid name!
Your lies can't be heard over the sound of how unworthy we are!
Have you heard of the Horsemen? We were told it was Death cultists, so we're looking for clues.
We know Death well. In fact, our Overseer might be able to help you. We'll be in touch...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathRevealed_QuestLongDescript: In Vault 672, we met Dwellers from Vault 144 who are familiar with Death, the mysterious fourth Horseman. As promised, their Overseer contacted us and set up a meeting where she'll tell us what she can! But she doesn't want to reveal the location of her Vault, so we'll be joining her in an abandoned building...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathRevealed_QuestShortDescrip: Learn the truth about Death from the Overseer of Vault 144!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathRevealed_QuestObjective_1: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 144.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathRevealed_Conversation_3_Te: The Death cultitsts are Dwellers from Vault 144? I did not see that coming.
Can you at least tell us where Death is first? You know we'll find out eventually.
So Death is sleeping and you're killing people to wake him up. That isn't insane at all.
You're about to shout out your cult motto, aren't you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathRevealed_Conversation_3_NP: No, not at all. I was going to say... uh... oh, whatever. We are Death's wake-up call!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GivemeLibertyandorDeath_QuestLo: It was a trap! Whoever Death is, he's sleeping... and the Vault 144 Dwellers believe that killing people will wake the Horseman up! We killed their Overseer, but we still need to find their Vault. If we're lucky, the Vault-Tec Archives will have its location...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GivemeLibertyandorDeath_QuestSh: Discover the location of Vault 144, home of the Death cultists.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GivemeLibertyandorDeath_Convers: *All* the records? Even the triplicate backups? This is Vault-Tec, after all.
What? Triplicate backups? We'll just get those after we kill you.
We won't even need to find your Vault if you all keep coming to us like this.
As if! We are legion! The Article 44 breeding program has been very effective.
What is this Manual you all keep harping on about?
The Vault 144 Overseer's Instruction Manual. Its hallowed guidance is sacrosanct!
Yes, but what about Article 174, Subsection b?
That's a directive about wearing toupees while on duty!
In every article about Dweller demise... “Death” is always capitalized.
Exactly. Generations have been waiting for and worshipping Death because of a typo.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OperationSandman_QuestLongDescr: Despite the best efforts of the Vault 144 Dwellers, we discovered the location of their home and that they only worship Death because “Death” was incorrectly capitalized in their Vault's instruction manual! We must now infiltrate Vault 144 and stop them from waking Death...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OperationSandman_QuestShortDesc: Infiltrate Vault 144 to stop the Dwellers from waking Death.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OperationSandman_Conversation_1: Cultists sure run a tight ship. The Overseer never gave *us* any maintenance training.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OperationSandman_Conversation_2: Hundreds of Settlers and Raiders have already been killed!
Wonderful! The day we've all worked toward is close at hand!
Thousands of Settlers and Raiders have already been killed!
Thousands?! But Death is still sleeping... Hold on a minute... Get them!
It's hard to say. What, exactly, is the quota again?
401k, according to the Manual. The “k” stands for “kills.” You need to study more.
We've discovered the truth. The Manual is wrong. The capitalization of “Death” is a typo!
That's... that's blasphemy! You aren't from here, are you? Get them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OperationSandman_Conversation_3: Intruders tricked into revealing themselves? Got it.
An Article 12, but it's taken care of.
Thank goodness. I'm allergic to marshmallows.
Brave Dwellers are sacrificing themselves to help meet the quota.
That's a great idea! We want to be next!
Some refuse to accept the truth. The Manual is a lie. There is no “Death.” It's just a typo!
Hahaha! A typo! That's really funny. You almost had me going there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OperationSandman_Conversation_4: Isn't it more plausible that generations of Dwellers based their lives on a miscapitalization?
Then why even tell us about the secret cave?
Since you're about to kill us anyway, why don't you tell us where the cave is?
We could, but to be honest, I'm not really sure we can beat you.
Suppose you wake Death up. What then?
No idea, but it's bound to be awesome! Why else would Vault-Tec have given us the Manual?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReleasetheRaiders_QuestLongDesc: Death wasn't in Vault 144. He's in a cave somewhere, and Vault 144 Dwellers are still out there trying to wake him up. It's time to meet back up with War to give him a status report! And while we're at it, we can keep the Warshippers out of trouble by asking them to find the cave...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReleasetheRaiders_QuestShortDes: Get the Warshippers to look for Death's cave.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReleasetheRaiders_Conversation_: You're undercover for the Weekly Exposition, aren't you?
