Under the covers?! We only just met!
Isn't it? And if things don't work out, we can always go back to fighting. Win-win.
It is? Okay. Whatever you say...
The Pests are after War's Power Armor?
Exactly, but he really, really loves that thing!
But what about our truce? What about Death?
DEATH? I AM BECOME DEATH! AND THE WASTELAND WILL BURN!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ReleasetheRaiders_QuestObjectiv: Search the building for Warshippers and Pests.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpPestilence_QuestLongDesc: The truce forgotten, War is now out for blood, ready to tear the Wasteland apart looking for Pestilence! The longer it takes, the more innocent Settlers will die, so let's dress as Warshippers and convince the Pests to bring Pestilence to War. Vault 226, abandoned and in the mountains, will make a great arena for their apocalyptic faceoff!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpPestilence_QuestShortDes: Lure Pestilence to the abandoned Vault 226.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpPestilence_Conversation_: We're already here, actually, and we have a message for whoever's in charge.
Just as well. I don't actually have a parlor.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpPestilence_QuestObjectiv: Talk to the Weekly Exposition reporter.
Get the Pests to lead Pestilence to Vault 226.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpPestilence_Conversation_: Sure, but War, may he live forever, is calling Pestilence out. One-on-one in Vault 226.
Fine by us. Pestilence will be there to start culling the herd... of Horsemen!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_QuestLongDescript: The Pests will bring Pestilence to Vault 226, so War is sure to follow. If we could get Famine there as well, the Horsemen and their cultists might all take care of each other! We need to dress as Pests and speak to the Hungry Horde's non-feral leaders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_QuestShortDescrip: Lure Famine to the abandoned Vault 226.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_Conversation_1_Te: We don't want to fight. We just have a message for the leaders of the Hungry.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_Conversation_2_Te: No, it could be anywhere. Meanwhile, Vault 144 is still busy trying to wake Death up.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_Conversation_2_NP: Well don't give up! You're the only ones left who can stand up to the Horsemen!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_QuestObjective_1: Get the Hungry to lead Famine to Vault 226.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_Conversation_3_Te: Hold it! Pestilence will soon be fighting War in Vault 226. Can Famine make it to the party?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SetEmUpFamine_Conversation_3_NP: Oh, he'll make it all right, and he'll be eating *all* the food!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_QuestLongDescrip: All this time, Three Dog has been saving lives, helping Settlers evade the Horsemen's followers, but it's put him on Vault 144's hit list! His last broadcast has him on the run from Death cultists. We need to get to him before they do, and one of his pursuers might know the location of Death's cave!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_QuestShortDescri: Save Three Dog from the Death cultists chasing him.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_2_T: You're all psychopaths! The Manual is wrong and killing *will not* wake up some mythical Horseman!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_2_N: If I had my *very much correct* Manual, I'd beat you over the head with it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_3_T: Come to our Vault! Our radio workers will be happy to give up their easy jobs for a radio legend.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_3_N: Work for an Overseer? Eh, could be worse.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_QuestObjective_2: Talk to the Weekly Exposition reporter.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_1_N: It's a closely guarded secret, I'm afraid, and Dave isn't high enough up the chain of command.
They keep talking about “the claws of Death” or “Death's claws,” but I'm drawing a blank.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_1_T: How close are they to meeting their quota?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_1_N: Very. Three Dog might be the last kill they need.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_1_T: How is killing people supposed to wake Death?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RunThreeDogRun_Conversation_1_N: It's just “all there in the Manual.” You just can't make this stuff up.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KnockEmDown_QuestLongDescriptio: War vs. Pestilence vs. Famine. Warshippers vs. Pests vs. Hungry. Everyone's arrived at Vault 226, ready to fight, but we shouldn't leave anything to chance. Let's wade through the carnage and make sure none of the Horsemen survive!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KnockEmDown_Conversation_1_Team: You could say they were terminated for tardiness.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KnockEmDown_Conversation_1_NPCE: Ha! Anyway, the Horsemen are down below. Go get 'em!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KnockEmDown_Conversation_2_Team: Never! Leave the Wasteland in peace... or stick around in pieces!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_KnockEmDown_Conversation_2_NPCE: YOU DECLINE WITH MEDIOCRE WORDPLAY? SO BE IT.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AtDeathsDoor_QuestLongDescripti: Three down, one to go, and thanks to Three Dog, we know where Death's cave is. But will he be awake? Only one way to find out!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AtDeathsDoor_Conversation_1_Tea: Go! Get out of here! But if you ever make trouble again...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AtDeathsDoor_Conversation_1_NPC: We swear! No more trouble. No more Manual. Thank you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AtDeathsDoor_Conversation_1_Tea: After all you've done, we can't let you leave.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AtDeathsDoor_Conversation_1_NPC: We understand. But we prefer to take our chances with you than with Death!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JustDeserts_QuestLongDescriptio: The Vault received an anonymous message promising to reveal the secret origin of the Horsemen. The location it gives is far into the Wasteland, but it's worth the risk to find out what this person has to say.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JustDeserts_QuestShortDescripti: Discover the origin of the Horsemen.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JustDeserts_QuestObjective_1: Discover the origin of the Horsemen.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JustDeserts_Conversation_5_NPCE: Excellent choice! The inner lining is made from Famine's rags!
Excellent choice! Not much can get through a Radscorpion's exoskeleton!
Excellent choice! You might want to disinfect the inside before wearing it, though.
Excellent choice! Mole rat hide makes for great substitute leather!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestLongDescriptio: The anniversary of our first entering the Vault is approaching and it is a good opportunity to improve Vault morale by throwing a celebration! We've got food, we've got music, but it seems when VaulTec stocked our initial supplies, they forgot to include party decorations! We are going to have to send a team to the nearby Super Duper Mart to find some...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestShortDescripti: Find party decorations in the Super Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestLongDescriptio: We didn't find any party supplies at the Super Duper Mart, but our team discovered that a large number of streamers and balloons had been purchased by a government employee shortly before the bombs fell. We have traced the employee to a nearby government building. We are going to send a team to the facility to find and retrieve the missing party supplies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestShortDescripti: Search for the missing party supplies in the government building.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestLongDescriptio: While looking for decorations, our team discovered something at the old government building that was a surprise to us all. We have since sifted through the data in all of our logs and found reference to a government facility that may hold more revelatory information. This may lead us to some tech that could help us improve the Vault leaps and bounds beyond what was planned. We need to send out a team as soon as possible!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBotQuest03_Conversation_2_: Looks like they ran security here. I doubt we'll find any locked doors in this place.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestLongDescriptio: We stumbled on something unbelievable at the government facility. When we took a further look into the research data, we found records of a field research lab at a so-called "crash site" where they were conducting experiments on "the object." Let's get to this crash site and see what we can scavenge!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestShortDescripti: Go to the crash site field lab and find the alien tech.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_Quest04_Conversation_3: Ugh whatever. Prepare to meet your maker, you walking toaster!
We went through a lot to get here. We are not leaving empty handed.
Unauthorized personnel. Intruder alert. Activate Security Protocols!
Did you say Vault-Tec? But uh, we're from Robco... yeah! RobCo! Here's my ID!
Scanning... Robco personnel positively identified. Welcome to site X 71 A. Please enjoy your stay.
Ok ok, we're going. Just let us... uh... grab this computer we definitely brought and we'll go!
Assessing... yes that is reasonable. Collect your items and be gone.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_QuestObjective_05: Discover where RobCo is keeping their research
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestLongDescriptio: We've been churning through the data that came back from that UFO lab we scouted a while back. Turns out, the old government turned over most of their specimens to RobCo. We found a holotape among the junk you brought back from the UFO Crash Site mentioning something about the next step in the development of advanced AI. Luckily, the nearest RobCo factory is pretty close to our vault. Let's send some dwellers there and see if we can find that research data. It could make a big difference for our vault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestShortDescripti: Search the RobCo factory for extraterrestrial technology.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestLongDescriptio: We cracked the executive's logs from the RobCo factory and discovered the location of a secret RobCo R&D facility. It occupies a series of secret levels below a retail store at the local mall. RobCo was using alien technology to advance their robotics research. They were trying to build something big. If we can figure out what they knew, we should be able to use it to make major improvements to the Vault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_01_QuestShortDescripti: Get into the secret RobCo R&D facility and track down their research data.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBotQuest06_Conversation_2_: Cmoon! I can help your vault. And it's so BORING here... Go get what you came for! I'll help haul it back!
Hmm, you seem alright. Sure thing!
Oh Thanks! I'll meet you outside when you're done. I can't wait to talk to people who can talk back!
Ugh, no way. We'll be fine on our own.
Suit yourself. See you around I guess.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AlienBot_QuestObjective_06: Enter and explore the UFO lab.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_QuestLongDescription: We have recently made contact with some Traders who say they were waylayed on the road by a mysterious bandit. They claim the thief was shouting something about fighting human oppression, and made off with a significant portion of the Traders' goods. We need you to go out there and track this bandit down. See if they can be reasoned with, and deal with them otherwise. We need to keep the trade routes safe and clear!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_QuestShortDescription: Track down a strange bandit and stop them from accosting traders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_Conversation_1_Answer: You're nothing but a deranged Raider. It's time to put you down!
Whatever. Just give us all the stuff you stole and we'll let you live.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_Conversation_1_NPCEnd: Never! I shall never give in to the human oppressor!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_Conversation_1_Answer: Uh, you realize YOU are just as human as we are, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_Conversation_1_NPCEnd: So? I'm using my privilege as a human to help out my merry manufactured friends.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_Conversation_1_Answer: Hey, we're all for that! We've got some robots back at the Vault and they're basically family!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotHood_Conversation_1_NPCEnd: Really? You also believe in my righteous cause?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BrotherhoodOfFeels_QuestLongDes: Travellers have told us of a small squad of ex-Brotherhood of Steel types setting up some kind of commune in the area. Apparently they've got survivors, Ghouls, and raiders all living in supposed harmony together. Go investigate this community and see if the rumors are true. These people could make good allies and trade partners.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_BrotherhoodOfFeels_QuestShortDe: Make contact with the strange group of survivors.
resolvedText.BrotherhoodOfFeels_ConversationAnswer_01: You can hand over your gear and supplies. We'll be taking everything.
No. We've fought too hard to build this place. You'll have nothing.
Who are you? Why were you living with a bunch of raiders?
We used to be in with the Brotherhood of Steel, but we're all more interested in helping people than things. So, how can we help each other?
We come from a vault nearby. Maybe we can look out for each other, trade supplies?
We'll take all the help we can get. You've got a deal.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OnlyHuman_QuestShortDescription: Find the lone human in the vault ruins.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OnlyHuman_Conversation01_NPC05: Unfortunate. I suppose I can wait for other fellow humans to take me in. Farewell!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OnlyHuman_Conversation01_PC03: We can always use a good cook!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OnlyHuman_Conversation01_NPC06: Wonderful! Shall I join you in your bipedal ambulations?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OnlyHuman_Conversation01_PC05: We're going to look around some more first.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OnlyHuman_Conversation01_NPC08: Ah yes! Look and learn with your seeing orbs!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DearthOfClaws_QuestLongDescript: Some of our foragers talked to a traveller recently who claimed he was looking for a colony of death claws in the area on which he planned to conduct "social experiments." They're worried he might be just taking a circuitous rout to getting himself eaten. Go to this area nearby where Deathclaws are known to gather and see if you can save the poor fool from himself.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DearthOfClaws_Conversation01_PC: You can't tame a deathclaw. Get out of the way, we'll take care of them.
Wow. They really are just kinda chilling out!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DearthOfClaws_Conversation01_NP: They are! And I hope to convert more to such behaviour. Please see yourselves out, I have much more work to do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DearthOfClaws_Conversation01_PC: Aren't you afraid they might turn on you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DearthOfClaws_Conversation01_NP: Of course! My chance of survival would be utterly infinitesimal! But I trust science! And my two friends here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_QuestLongDescriptio: A swarm of malfunctioning security robots has taken over some ruins downtown. If they dig in there, they could be a threat to us and other survivors. Get some guns, go in there, and clear them out. Don't underestimate them, they may be slow and simple minded but they are relentless, and heavily armed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_QuestObjective: Destroy the Attacktron and its minions!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_Conversation01_PC02: Wait! Can't we talk this out like civilized beings?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_Conversation01_NPC0: We do not recognize humans as civilized, but so be it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_Conversation01_PC04: Hey how about we just go and leave you alone, then you leave us alone?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_Conversation01_NPC0: Surprisingly reasonable. Leave this place and never return.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_Conversation01_PC03: I think we can all get along! We can help each other!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RoboRampage_Conversation01_NPC0: We would not accept aid from a simian. DIE HUMANS.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ExtremeOuterference_QuestLongDe: Some strange signals are interfering with our radio transmissions out in the waste. Take a squad with you and triangulate the interference. Once you know where it's coming from, investigate the site and disable whatever is blocking our Radio.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_QuestLongDescription: A band of well-armed raiders attacked a caravan a few days back and made off with a number of settlers, we're assuming to use as slaves. We've got their last known co-ordinates and direction of travel, but no one was able to track them. We should send some good people out to track down and free the abductees, and eliminate these slavers. They're the last thing we need lurking around in our back yard.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_QuestShortDescription: Rescue abducted settlers from the slavers.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_QuestObjective: Find the band of slavers and free their captives.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_Conversation01_PC01: That's why we're here. Let those people go, they're not yours.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_Conversation01_NPC03: Not yours either. Nah, we'll be keepin em, thanks!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_Conversation01_PC02: Hey, we're just passing through, no need to get rough.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_Conversation01_NPC04: You're passing through the wrong place. More fresh meat for the Pitt!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_Conversation01_PC03: Fine, take your workers, but give us a sample of your gear to show our people.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PittStop_Conversation01_NPC06: Trade huh? Yeah. Maybe... Here. Take this and get out of here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PerfectSpecimens_QuestShortDesc: Talk to the inhabitants of the mysterious vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PerfectSpecimens_Answer01_NPC02: Much the same as you, I presume! Come, let us be allies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PerfectSpecimens_Answer01_PC05: I know someone who would love to meet you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PerfectSpecimens_Answer01_NPC08: We would be glad to meet them! Please, go tell them of us. We would like more human friends.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PerfectSpecimens_Answer01_PC08: No, you're too dangerous. You have to go.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PierIntoFuture_QuestLongDescrip: Woah! What's that? This festive waterfront has suffered a ruinous fate in some kind of ill-founded fracas! Get in there and dig around, who knows what you'll find!?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PierIntoFuture_Answer01_PC01: What are you doing out here? You ok?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PierIntoFuture_Answer01_NPC01: Ugh, yeah. Been out here for a while. If you go that way, look out for the monsters.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PierIntoFuture_Answer02_PC01: Sure. The more the merrier. But you're carrying the loot.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_QuestLongDescripti: There's a ruckus in the nearby graveyard. Maybe someone needs your help, or there is something useful for you to scrounge up. Scoot on over there and check it out.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_QuestShortDescript: See what's causing a ruckus in the graveyard.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_Answer01_PC01: Easy now, we're just passing through.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_Answer01_NPC01: Bull! They're after the Ghoul! Smoke 'em!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_QuestObjective: See what's causing a ruckus in the graveyard.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_Answer02_PC01: Hey no problem! If you need a spot to hole up, we've got one.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_Answer02_NPC01: Well, I've a few things to take care of, but I just might.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_Answer02_PC02: They were in my way. Man, you might wanna stick to the shadows…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulInBlack_Answer02_NPC02: Yeah I know. I ain't really camera ready these days. I'll see you around, friendly stranger.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_QuestLongDescription: The brotherhood has a pretty large base set up nearby. As quasi-religious orders of militants go, they're generally not awful. Maybe we should stop in and say hello.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer03_PC01: Oof, sure. I guess we can handle it. Uh, stand back.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer03_NPC01: Thank you! Here, take this, it might help.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer03_PC02: What? In there? Are you nuts? No way!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer03_NPC02: Well, there's only one way through and I'm not fighting that thing. Good luck.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer05_PC01: No way! We're not letting you scumbags get away with any Brotherhood tech.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer05_NPC01: Don't say I didn't warn ya.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer05_PC02: Alright alright, just calm down. We were never here, we didn't see anything…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer05_PC03: No problem. As long as you share some of those whatsits with us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer05_NPC03: Hmm, you're lucky we gotta keep this quiet. Here. Get lost.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_QuestObjective: Learn what you can about the Brotherhood of Steel.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer04_PC01: Your secret is safe with me.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OBrother_Answer04_NPC01: Phew, thanks. Hey, you ever need anything, you know who to ask.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Filly_QuestLongDescription: You've stumbled across a slipshod settlement called Filly, offering welcome to other wastelanders. Unfortunately, it seems to be occupied by a gang of raiders who have different ideas...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Filly_02_Answer02_PC01: As long as you can afford it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Filly_02_Answer02_NPC01: I think we can work out some kind of deal. Get it done and we'll talk.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Filly_02_Answer02_PC02: That's awful. I will do whatever I can! Those raiders have it coming.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Filly_02_Answer02_NPC02: Oh! Thanks, you're good people. Go get em!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Filly_QuestObjective: Clear out the Raiders for Ma June.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Snipping_QuestLongDescription: Ma June has asked you to head to the nearby Super Duper Mart for supplies. Keep an eye open. You never know who or what you might run into there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Snipping_01_Answer01_NPC01: I am Mr. Snip Snip! I have discovered some corn! Please, allow me to accompany and it is all yours!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Tonics_QuestLongDescription: The people of Filly are in dire need of medicine. There are rumours of a traveling chem-merchant wandering nearby. You should have no trouble tracking them down.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Tonics_Answer01_PC01: We've got injured, in the junk town back there. We need a lot of meds.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Tonics_Answer01_NPC01: Ooh! Good thing you found me! I better come with you to see what you need. You've got caps, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Tonics_Answer01_PC02: Filly was attacked by raiders! A lot of people are injured!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Tonics_Answer01_NPC02: Oh no! What are we standing around for? Grab my things and let's go!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Dog_QuestLongDescription: You passed by a run down refueling station on your way back to Filly and you heard odd noises coming from inside. What could it be? You won't know until you find out!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Dog_QuestShortDescription: Investigate strange sounds at the Red Rocket.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Dog_Answer01_PC01: I think we'll stick around. You don't look like you'd make the best pet owners.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Dog_Answer01_NPC01: Looks like we need to correct your behavior!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Dog_Answer01_PC02: No need for that. We can help you look for... what was it, a dog?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Dog_Answer01_NPC02: The Brotherhood sent you, didn't they? The mutt's ours! They can't have him!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Astronomical_QuestLongDescripti: The Brotherhood is attacking the Griffith Observatory to recover a deadly weapon from the NCR. We don't know what it is, but it could be disastrous in anybody's hands. Go, take care of it for everyone's sake.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Astronomical_QuestShortDescript: Stop the NCR leader from using the weapon.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Astronomical_Conversation1_Answ: We're here to help! Please, let us pass! Your leader is making a big mistake!
She has seemed strange lately. If you're here to help, then go help.
We're here to stop you and your crazy leader!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Astronomical_Conversation2_Answ: We know about the weapon. We're here to help!
Go, then. It should be clear past here. We'll hold this point. Oh! We found this. You might be able to use it for your vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Astronomical_Conversation4_Answ: We don't want anyone to get hurt! We just need to talk some sense into your leader!
She doesn't need to hear anything from you!
Bring it on then! I love a good scrap!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Astronomical_Conversation3_Answ: Rebuild? You're about to cause irreparable damage.
This is the only way back to something good. I won't let anyone stop that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NukaColaQuantumRun_QuestLongDes: We think we know where a rare Nuka-Cola Quantum is located!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_NukaColaQuantumRun_QuestShortDe: Search for the lost Nuka-Cola Quantum.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RobotRetrieval_QuestLongDescrip: We think Vault-Tec delivered a Mr. Handy Box to this building. Pip pip cheerio!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JunkRun_QuestLongDescription: The Wasteland is full of junk, but sometimes that's just what you need...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JunkRun_QuestShortDescription: We need more junk. Go get it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_JunkRun_QuestObjective_1: Recover the main stash of Junk.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueOperation_QuestLongDescri: You've received a distress call from a settlement! They're willing to leave and join your Vault if you save them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueOperation_QuestShortDescr: Rescue any settlers that you can.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AnimalRescue_QuestLongDescripti: You're not going to leave adorable animals trapped in that building, are you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_LunchboxRun_QuestLongDescriptio: You've found the location of a Vault-Tec Lunchbox! Now we just need to send some volunteers to retrieve it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CapsRun_QuestLongDescription: There's a large stash of Caps out there in the Wasteland with your name on it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CapsRun_QuestShortDescription: Find the hidden stash of Caps.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CapsRun_QuestObjective_1: Recover the main stash of Caps.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GuardianoftheWastes:Radroaches_: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
Clear out the nest of Radroaches.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GuardianoftheWastes:MoleRats_Qu: Guardian of the Wastes: Mole Rats!
Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
Get rid of those pesky Mole rats.
Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GuardianoftheWastes:FeralGhouls: Guardian of the Wastes: Feral Ghouls!
Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
Show the Feral Ghouls no mercy.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GuardianoftheWastes:Radscorpion: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GuardianoftheWastes:Deathclaws_: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PestControl_QuestLongDescriptio: Watch out! While exploring near a Red Rocket fuel station, one of your Wasteland explorers has stumbled across a nest of radroaches! Ewww!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PestControl_QuestShortDescripti: There's a nest of nasty Radroaches at a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PitStop_QuestLongDescription: Opportunity knocks! One of your Wasteland explorers has discovered a Red Rocket fuel station that looks uninhabited. There might be something useful inside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PitStop_QuestShortDescription: Search the Red Rocket Truck Stop for supplies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PitStop_QuestObjective_1: Investigate the Red Rocket Truck Stop.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MiseryLoathesCompany_QuestLongD: A tough Raider boss is holed up in a Red Rocket fuel station, and he's using your Wasteland explorer for target practice. Take him out before someone gets hurt!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MiseryLoathesCompany_QuestShort: Challenge a Raider Boss holed up in a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PestCaseScenario_QuestLongDescr: Mole rats have infested a Super-Duper Mart nearby. The location is a vital source of supplies for travelers. Kill the brood mother to make the location safe once again.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PestCaseScenario_QuestShortDesc: Kill the Mole rat brood mother at the Super Duper Mart.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_PestCaseScenario_QuestObjective: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OneGhoulCustomer_QuestLongDescr: Sierra Petrovita has been trapped by Ghouls at the local Super-Duper Mart. Rescue her before they make her their next meal.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_OneGhoulCustomer_Conversation_1: Here, maybe you should have the Quantum for safe keeping.
You're crazy, lady. They were after you, not your Quantum.
Oh, well maybe you should have it for safe keeping.
Maybe I should hang on to that Nuka-Cola Quantum so you'll be safe.
Oh, what a good idea. Here you go!
You care more about the Nuka-Cola Quantum than your life?
Of course! It's the ultimate refreshment. Here, try one.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_QuestLongDescript: Star-Paladin Cross was collecting technology from a Super-Duper Mart when he was accosted by a Deathclaw. Lend him a hand.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_QuestShortDescrip: Provide fire support for Star-Paladin Cross.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_QuestObjective_1: Provide fire support for Star-Paladin Cross.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_Te: Maybe one day, but I don't think I'm ready yet.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_NP: That's too bad. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_Te: Heck no! I'd rather stay in my Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_NP: Suit yourself. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_Te: I was never cut out to be a soldier.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_NP: You could have fooled me. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_Te: No way! Soldiers caused this mess in the first place.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CrossingPaths_Conversation_1_NP: Sorry you feel that way. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AnybodyHome_QuestLongDescriptio: You came across an old cabin while adventuring in the Wasteland. Perhaps you should see what's inside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_AnybodyHome_QuestShortDescripti: You found a Cabin in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_UninvitedGuests_QuestLongDescri: You can across a small cabin out in the Wasteland. Time to investigate!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_UninvitedGuests_QuestShortDescr: You've discovered an old Cabin out in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_UninvitedGuests_Conversation_1_: It's called dinner, and guess who just got added to the menu!
I guess we can always add “Dweller” to the menu!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FamilyMatters_QuestLongDescript: You came across a small cabin out in the Wasteland. Maybe someone still lives here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FamilyMatters_QuestShortDescrip: You've discovered an old Cabin out in the Wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FamilyMatters_Conversation_1_NP: She's my grandma, but careful, she's a biter. Papa was too until he lost his dentures. They both mean well! Call it tough love.
Sure is, but careful, she's a biter. Papa used to be until he lost his dentures. But they both mean well! I call it tough love.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FirstDown_QuestLongDescription: A frantic voice comes in over the radio. There's a settler out in the Wasteland who's in serious trouble! The clock's ticking...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FirstDown_Conversation_1_Team_1: Do you know where they went?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_FirstDown_Conversation_1_NPCEnd: They were heading for a nearby building. I think they were searching for something.
Something to do with impressing their leader. Can you ask them yourself when you rescue my sister?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SecondStringers_QuestLongDescri: A gang of Raiders has taken a settler hostage. Rescue the captive and solve the mystery of the Super Cup!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SecondStringers_Conversation_1_: It's a contest. The Commish gives it to the nastiest Raider, and there's nobody nastier than me!
He's the big, bad boss who awards the Super Cup to the nastiest Raider. Like me!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThirdandGoal_QuestLongDescripti: You've tracked the kidnapped settler to the lair of the Commish. Time to put an end to this football flunky's Super Cup contest!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThirdandGoal_QuestShortDescript: Rescue the hostage and confront the Commish.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThirdandGoal_Conversation_2_Tea: There's a Vault nearby. You'll be safe there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThirdandGoal_Conversation_1_Tea: What's wrong, Commish? Feeling a little... deflated?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThirdandGoal_Conversation_1_NPC: Hah! You know who gives us the best chance to win? Me!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThirdandGoal_Conversation_1_Tea: Your little Super Cup contest is over, Commish.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ThirdandGoal_Conversation_1_NPC: My playoff run is only getting started, and I will go all the way!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_QuestLongDescrip: There's a new Vault in the Wasteland, and it's run by Raiders! Vault-Tec is long gone, so who could have possibly constructed Vault R41D? Time to investigate...
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_QuestShortDescri: Investigate a mysterious, brand new Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_3_T: Sure thing! Glad to have you aboard!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_3_N: Oh, great! And uh... can we just forget this place ever existed?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_3_T: No way! You've caused enough trouble!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_3_N: Oh... I guess I'll just wander then. Probably get eaten alive out there. No worries! Bye forever!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_2_T: Bring it! I'm ready for a fight!
I've already beaten up most of your guys. What's one or two more?
I'm from a real Vault! You've got it all wrong!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_2_N: Huh, really? Maybe you should go speak to the Overseer then.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_2_T: Wait, maybe we can do this without any more fighting.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_APaleImitation_Conversation_2_N: Well, the Overseer did say to try talking to outsiders first. He's down the hall.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WeddingCrashers_QuestLongDescri: The notorious Raider, Sally Switchblade, is getting married to the infamous Marcus Hammer. But they're both having second thoughts, because neither wants to live the Raider lifestyle anymore. If only they'd communicate! Bust in and solve their problems for them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WeddingCrashers_QuestShortDescr: Help an engaged Raider couple work through their problems.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WeddingCrashers_Conversation_2_: Sally, you're too good for Marcus. Come live with us at the Vault.
Yeah, you're right. Marcus, I'm leaving you forever. Goodbye!
Marcus, Sally doesn't appreciate you enough.
Is that how it's going to be? Fine, go live with the Vault Dwellers for all I care, Marcus.
Neither one of you is cut out for Raiding anymore. Why not give it up and elope?
You're right! Honeycakes? Let's run away together!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_WeddingCrashers_Conversation_1_: Great! Oh by the way, no one else is expecting you here, so you'll probably get shot at. Good luck!
Are you sure about this? Shouldn't love just run its course?
No. The bosses ain't thinking straight. Go deal with it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MonsterUndertheBed_QuestLongDes: One of the Vault youngsters was playing outside when a terrifying monster stole their teddy bear. Now they refuse to sleep, claiming the monster comes back every night to hide under their bed! We've got to track the beast down to end the kid's fears - permanently.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_MonsterUndertheBed_QuestShortDe: Track down and kill a teddy bear-stealing monster!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TimetoWakeUp_QuestLongDescripti: Someone made the mistake of activating a Wakemaster prototype alarm clock in a building not far from the Vault. Now the alarm is blaring non-stop and it's keeping everyone up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TimetoWakeUp_QuestShortDescript: Stop the incessant beeping of the world's loudest alarm clock.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TimetoWakeUp_Conversation_1_Tea: We'll help you break it! Then we'll go our separate ways!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TimetoWakeUp_Conversation_1_NPC: Yay! Teamwork! Here, I'll even split some of Caps I found in this place.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TimetoWakeUp_Conversation_1_Tea: There's got to be an off switch. Have you looked on the back?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TimetoWakeUp_Conversation_1_NPC: Oh, there it is. Tricky! Thanks!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_QuestLongDescription: A hastily written and grammatically incorrect note was left outside the Vault door: “IF U EVAR WANT TOO SEE YOU'RE DOG AGAN, COME TWO ARE BIG BILDING AND BRING GUNZ, CAPS, AND SNAX.” It must've been written by some really stupid Raiders, because we don't even have a missing dog. But if those jerks really do have a kidnapped canine, it still needs rescuing!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_QuestShortDescription: Save a kidnapped pooch from a band of Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_QuestObjective_1: Teach the Raiders a lesson and rescue the missing dog.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_Team_1: We don't have any of those things, moron. Now hand over the dog!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_1: We'll find out what you have when we kill ya!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_Team_2: I've got your guns right here!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_2: Well darn. I really wanted the snacks!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_Team_3: We bring something better: the gift of knowledge. Give us the dog, and we'll teach you to write.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_3: Huh, then we could write better ransom notes! You got a deal!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_Team_4: You're gravely mistaken. That isn't even our dog.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_2_NPCEnd_4: It isn't? Well, shoot. I guess you can just have him, then. He's been eating too much food anyway.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DogGone_Conversation_1_Team_1: Well, we forgot the Caps and snacks... but here are the guns!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_QuestLongDescripti: A group of Raiders is holding a rowdy shindig while their Boss is away. Now's our chance to infiltrate them while they're partying. If we can turn them against their Boss, the whole gang will be destroyed from within!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_QuestShortDescript: Infiltrate the Raiders' hideout and sow the seeds of distrust.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_QuestObjective_1: Spread lies among the partying Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_3_Tea: Oh nothing. The Boss just said to take note of anyone who laughs at that story.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_3_NPC: Uh oh. We better make ourselves scarce before he comes back!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_3_Tea: Sorry, I was thinking how funny it'd be if you stole all of his underwear while he was gone!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_3_NPC: Hah, you're right! There's no way that could ever backfire! Great idea!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_QuestObjective_2: Spread lies among the belligerent Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_1_Tea: I don't think you want to do that. I'm the Boss' new second-in-command.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_1_NPC: What? I was up for that promotion! I'm gonna give him a piece of my mind!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_1_Tea: The Boss already knows what you've been doing. Better get him before he gets you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_1_NPC: If he does, I can't take any chances. Thanks, newbie!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_QuestObjective_3: Spread lies among the drinking Raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_2_Tea: The Boss is holding out on us. I saw a huge stash hidden in his room!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_2_NPC: Are you serious? Then why am I drinking this swill?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_2_Tea: I know, and the Boss was saying he wanted to take away what little you had!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RaidingParty_Conversation_2_NPC: Not if I can help it! Here, hold this. He's gonna have a conversation with my fist!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSpiritofTaking_QuestLongDesc: So much for the spirit of giving! Some heartless Raiders have robbed a Wasteland Settler and stolen a gift meant for his friend.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSpiritofTaking_QuestShortDes: Confront a gang of Raiders that stole a gift from a Wasteland Settler.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheSpiritofTaking_Conversation_: That's no ordinary loot - it's a gift for someone's best friend. Now hand it over!
Oh... fine! Take it! Now get out of here before I change my mind.
If it's a fight you want, it's a fight you'll get!
You're safe now. You should get home.
You're right. I'll find another gift. Here, take this.
You should come to our Vault.
Really? Thanks! I've always wanted to live in a Vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ToGrandmothersHouseWeGo_QuestLo: An old woman living near your Vault was expecting Holiday visitors, but they haven't arrived and she fears the worst!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ToGrandmothersHouseWeGo_QuestSh: Help some Wasteland Settlers who got lost while traveling for the Holidays!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ToGrandmothersHouseWeGo_Convers: You've earned them! Now it's time for us to get back on the road.
The Lunchbox sounds great! Thank you.
Here you go. I hope there's something good inside!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDoorBuster_QuestLongDescript: Across the Wasteland, rumors swirl of a treasure called the “Door Buster.” The race is on to claim this mysterious prize!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDoorBuster_QuestShortDescrip: Be the first to claim the Door Buster!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDoorBuster_Conversation_1_Te: Do you know what it is?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDoorBuster_Conversation_1_NP: Probably a trap. This place is crawling with Raiders. Good luck.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDoorBuster_Conversation_1_Te: Back off, we were here first!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_TheDoorBuster_Conversation_1_NP: Fine. This is probably just a Raider trap anyway.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_QuestLongDescript: Santa's gone missing, and we can only bring him back by spreading some Christmas cheer!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_3_Te: We want the best weapon your Vault's got.
All this holiday cheer means we could use some new outfits.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_3_NP: Money makes the world go round, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_3_Te: Giving is its own reward. We don't need anything!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_3_NP: Such generosity! Good luck out there, Santa's Helpers!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_2_Te: Santa's coming, but you gotta believe in him, or he won't show!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_2_NP: We believe in Santa! Here. Give him this if you see him!
Santa's Helpers are mean! Get out of our Vault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_1_Te: We're Santa's Helpers! Now come on, sing some carols with us!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_1_NP: All right! “We wish you a Merry Christmas... We wish you a Merry Christmas...”
resolvedText.QuestLoc_SantasHelpers_Conversation_1_Te: You know what? We're telling Santa you belong on the naughty list.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ChristmasattheRaiderCamp_QuestL: Yes, even Raiders need a little Holiday spirit!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ChristmasattheRaiderCamp_Conver: How about some fancy new clothes?
How about cash? Lots of cash.
You're still on the naughty list, McScrooge. Time to die!
All we have is holiday cheer! Now let's sing some songs!
You know what? Why not? “Twinkle twinkle little star...”
The only thing we're giving you is a fist to the face!
Santa's watching you. Be nice or he won't give you presents!
He'll give us free stuff? All right. You Dwellers can pass.
Santa sends the gift... Of death! Eat lead!
You're dead, and the North Pole is next!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheerfortheGhouls_QuestLongDesc: Everyone forgets those poor Ghouls need holiday cheer, too!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CheerfortheGhouls_Conversation_: Think we got something right up your alley.
We're fashion nuts. Some new outfits, please!
We don't need anything. We just enjoy helping out!
Well, all right, maybe the holidays aren't dead after all!
You can't kill us! What would Santa think? That's permanent naughty list stuff.
Hmph. Fine. But tell Santa we deserve more next year!
No one's stealing Christmas this year! En garde!
Of course! He'll be here real soon with a “Ho ho ho!”
Hurray! Here. We saved up and want you to have this present!
Sorry, all Ghouls are on the naughty list this year. You get nothing.
We see how it is, smoothskins! Get out of here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueSanta_QuestLongDescriptio: While we were spreading Christmas cheer, someone managed to track down Santa Claus. He's in trouble. Let's go!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueSanta_Conversation_1_Team: We've been very good this year, Santa. How about some firepower?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueSanta_Conversation_1_NPCE: Well, all right, but don't shoot your eye out! Ho ho ho!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueSanta_Conversation_1_Team: Santa, we dig your style. How about some new threads?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueSanta_Conversation_1_NPCE: Always happy to share my fashion sense! Ho ho ho!
Well, I have this Giddyup Buttercup. Merry Christmas!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueSanta_Conversation_1_Team: We don't need anything, Santa. We just like doing good!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_RescueSanta_Conversation_1_NPCE: Ho ho ho! Looks like my Nice list just got a few entries longer!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_QuestLongDesc: The Dino Dee-Lite motel in Novac was once a bustling hub, now overrun with raiders who call themselves Khans. We're going to turn it back into a motel.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_QuestShortDesc: Get the Khans out of the Dino Dee-Lite motel in Novac.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question1_Choice: Could it maybe not be Khan territory?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question1_Answer: That sounds like a challenge! Let's fight!
No, it's not. It's Khan territory. We stole it! If you want it back, fight us for it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question1_Choice: Let me talk to your boss, please!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question1_Answer: Very well, you may pass. Sorry if you get attacked on the way.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question2_Choice: We're really nice! Also you can't kill us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question2_Answer: Hahahaha! Sure we can. But we won't, because you're so nice.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question2_Choice: That's not a very welcoming attitude.
I wonder if the Crazy Khans like the Crazy Khans.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question2_Answer: Don't make the Crazy Khans think! Philosophy is for the boss only!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question3_Choice: We want this to be a motel again. You in?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question3_Answer: Hmph. No, I am not in. If you want to take the territory, then take it by force as we did!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question3_Choice: You're killing the vibe in Novac.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question3_Answer: Novac has never been so strong and free. Here, I'll show you just how free you can be!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question3_Choice: I hate to say this, but… you're all too smelly.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_EvictionNotice_Question3_Answer: Give it a few days, and you will smell much worse than we do!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_QuestLongDesc: The motel is almost ready! But those Khans left a mess and it attracted a bunch of vermin. Let's get them out before we open the doors.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_QuestShortDesc: Clear the motel of dangerous creatures before opening.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question2_Choice1: WE did? What did you do?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question2_Answer1: Oh, you know. Managed things. Look, we're all part of the team. Let's stop sweating the details!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question2_Answer2: Now that's what I like to hear. I'll go get the chems!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question2_Answer3: Of course! I mean, look, I'm resourceful, I'll figure it out. Don't worry. Come on, we've known each other for days!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question1_Answer1: What? They can't? I've been living a lie!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question1_Choice2: You can stay if you pay your bill.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question1_Answer2: Oh! Uh, I hope this is enough.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question1_Choice3: We're just here to clean up.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_CleaningHouse_Question1_Answer3: Oh… okay! I'm outta here! He's just going to grab our stuff and follow after. Promise!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_QuestLongDesc: We have a space for our new motel, but now we need stuff to put in it. Apparently, there's a Ghoul salesperson around who can help us out.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_QuestShortDesc: Find the Ghoul salesperson to help furnish our new motel.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question1_Answer1: There should be one of our Ghoul staff who is not feral. Good luck finding them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question1_Answer2: Okay, take your time. But do be wary, as some of our sales staff has gone feral.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question1_Answer3: Absolutely! Please make your way to our sales office. Be careful on your way up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question3_Choice1: Follow the Ghoul corpses, you'll be okay.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question3_Answer1: Thank goodness. Take this gun I was going to use to barter!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_QuestObjective2: Strike a deal with the salesperson
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question2_Answer1: Wonderful! I, too, love to roll in bottle caps. Well, not really, they get stuck in my skin if I do that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question2_Answer2: Oho, how convenient! For enough rad-away, I will help you in any way I can.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GhoulSupplies_Question2_Answer3: Yowza! Now there's an offer! I'll be right over with all the furniture and appliances I can find.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_QuestLongDesc: Apparently there's someone with some administrative skill who was kidnapped by raiders. Let's get him out of there, and maybe in return he'll help us run our motel!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_QuestShortDesc: Rescue a manager from a group of raiders.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question1_Answer1: You must mean Mr. Manager. He's staying with us! He tells us stories! And now you die!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question1_Choice2: You have a hostage, we have a ransom.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question1_Answer2: We'll die before we give up Mr. Manager! He tells us stories!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question1_Choice3: Would you like to manage a hotel?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question1_Answer3: Manage? So you're here for Mr. Manager. You will never take him away! He tells us stories!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question2_Choice1: I'm from the vault, I'm here to rescue you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question2_Answer1: Aren't you a little short for a vault dweller? Whatever, I'm done with bedtime stories.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question2_Answer2: Oh, uh, sure. So does that mean I'm off the hook for bedtime stories?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_Headhunting_Question2_Answer3: Yes, please! I'd do anything if it means I'm done telling these weirdos bedtime stories.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_1_QuestLongDes: Our new dog is acting worried. What is it, boy? You want us to follow? Maybe it's delicious food, like Cram, or Brahmin steak, or… Deathclaw meat!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_1_QuestShortDe: Follow the dog back to Novac… what could be waiting for us there?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_1_Question2_Ch: That'll be our Alpha. Nobody get beheaded!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_1_Question1_Ch: Maybe they just wanted a room.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_1_Question1_An: Well, they're no good for business. Gotta kick em out.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_1_Question1_Ch: I wonder if they would pay rent.
I hope they didn't eat any clients.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_1_Question1_An: Gee, that would be bad. At least let's go check their intestines for keys.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_QuestLongDes: Something will have to be done about those Deathclaws! Apparently there's a doctor who can make a strong poison that will keep them away for good. Let's go talk to her!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_QuestShortDe: Talk to a doctor about a Deathclaw pesticide.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question1_Ch: We'll take care of it. If you take care of us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question1_An: Oh, thank you! Our doctor is upstairs somewhere… please hurry!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question1_Ch: Those raider scum! In a house of science?!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question1_An: I know, right? Please do what you can! Our doctor is upstairs somewhere!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question1_Ch: Don't worry. We'll take them down.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question1_An: Oh, yeah, you look tough! Go get 'em!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question2_Ch: You got anything to deal with Deathclaws?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question2_An: Oh, sure. Just use this poison on every egg you see and kill the adults. Should be easy for you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question2_Ch: Doctor, we've got a case of the Deathclaws.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_2_Question2_An: Oh, dear. Sounds serious. You'll have to kill the Alphas, and use this poison on their eggs. Good luck!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_QuestLongDes: Now we have some Deathclaw poison. I guess we should spray the nest near the motel to get rid of the problem, rather than the motel itself.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_QuestShortDe: Spray the Deathclaw nest with poison.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_Question1_Ch: Your, uh, brethren attacked our motel.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_Question1_An: And you are here to exterminate them, no doubt. I do not begrudge you. They could not be reasoned with.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_Question1_Ch: Killing your family and poisoning your eggs?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_Question1_An: Do not fret, I will not stop you. I will look for more like me, who seek peace, and likely die alone.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_Question1_Ch: Dealing with pests, and you're one of them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_3_Question1_An: Ah. Humans are no different, after all. I am the last of your foes. Now perish!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_QuestLongDes: Apparently our anti-Deathclaw spray is like honey to feral Ghouls. Clear them out so we can get running again!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_QuestShortDe: Clear feral Ghouls out of the motel so it can run again.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_Question1_Ch: I saved you. You should pay me.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_Question1_An: What?! I… well, you make a good point. Here, it's all I've got on me. Let's call it even.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_Question1_Ch: What do you want? It's the wasteland.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_Question1_An: Ugh. You're right, of course. All right, back to work, I suppose…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_Question1_Ch: Nah. Go find another job if you want.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_Question1_An: Fine! I will! … Ah, who am I kidding? I got nowhere else to go.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_DeathclawDeeLite_4_Question2_Ch: You want A mate? Fine, just get out!
You want TO mate?! Fine, just pay up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_QuestLongDesc: We need some supplies. Why not see what the local commercial hub, Freeside, has to offer!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question1_Choice1: Make me look as cool as possible.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question1_Answer1: No problemo. Nothing cooler than an NCR ranger, right?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question1_Choice2: I need something I can move in easily!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question1_Answer2: Pfft. Whatever, just take this dress I used to wear when I was younger.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question1_Choice3: Something nice to wear to bed, please.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question1_Answer3: Now you're talking. Try these, you'll sleep better than ever.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question2_Answer1: What? Not even the prairie oysters? These things are hard to come by! Oh well, suit yourself.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question2_Answer2: It may be gross, but it beats eating Cram every day!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question3_Answer1: Snap! Ah, who am I kidding? This thing doesn't work.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question3_Answer2: I'm taking your picture. Well, I'm pretending, anyway. This thing's broken…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question3_Answer3: Nope! Here, you can have it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question4_Choice1: Buddy, the fall happened already. We fell.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question4_Answer1: That's just what they want you to think! It's still coming! Only the heavily armored will survive!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question4_Choice2: You mean, I'm going to trip? I'll watch my step.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question4_Answer2: It's the eyes… aliens! Eyes in the sky! They're watching all our steps!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question4_Choice3: Uh-oh. You'd better give me your caps for safekeeping.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question4_Answer3: Money has no meaning in the end of days! Only in experiences do we enrich ourselves!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question5_Answer1: You won't regret it! And that's guaranteed, or your money back! If you can find me.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question5_Answer2: Nope, no, ah, I mean, it's much more suitable to drink at home. Farewell!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_1_Question5_Answer3: That's the spirit. Off you go, now!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_QuestLongDesc: That “Miracle Serum” we were sold in Freeside got a bunch of us sick! Time to track down the one who sold it to us and get an explanation.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_QuestShortDesc: Find the one who sold us the so-called “Miracle Serum”.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question1_Answer1: Wonderful! Feel free to stay longer than you'd like to.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question1_Answer2: There's nothing at all suspicious here, I assure you. See for yourself!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question1_Answer3: No, I don't think I did. We're selling used clothes, silly! Please go right on in.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question4_Choice1: So what if I am the manager?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question4_Answer1: I'll... well, I... I'm not coming back!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question4_Choice2: No, but I'll tell them what you said.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question4_Answer2: Thank you. Here, take this. It's the best thing I found in this dump.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question4_Choice3: I'm just an employee. Are you going to pay for that?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question4_Answer3: Ugh, fine. Then I'm out of here! After I look in one more room. I love shopping.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question2_Answer1: You don't want to be a slave? But you already are! How awful!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question2_Choice2: Did you make the “miracle serum”? I have a complaint.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question2_Answer2: Stop changing the subject! Are you even listening?!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question2_Choice3: Who cares? You'll be dead soon anyway.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question3_Choice1: You can go if you tell me where they are.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_2_Question3_Answer1: I don't know where they are, we made the serum in a slapshod lab in Westside. Bye!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_QuestLongDesc: The Snake Oil Salesman sent us to a rickety building in the so-called Westside of New Vegas. They won't be making any more “Miracle Serum” when we're done with them.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_QuestShortDesc: Stop the production of “Miracle Serum” in Westside.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question5_Choice1: Yeah, yeah, you can stay with us.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question5_Answer1: Oh! Vault folk really are the kindest around.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question5_Choice2: You better apologize when you get there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question5_Answer2: Oh, of course! I'll even bring them an antidote!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question5_Answer3: No, but isn't choice just an illusion anyway?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question1_Choice1: We're here from headquarters to inspect the lab.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question1_Answer1: Oh. Huh. Okay… Go ahead then.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question1_Choice2: We're here to destroy the serum lab.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question1_Answer2: No way! I'll lose my job!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question1_Choice3: Just passing through. Hoping to take a walk… upstairs…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question1_Answer3: No way! That place is off limits!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question2_Choice1: Tell us where the slavers are and you can live.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question2_Answer1: I don't know where they are! Seriously, I'm just an apprentice! Please don't shoot!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question4_Answer2: A little poison for the road?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_QuestObjective2: Find out where the slavers are
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question3_Choice2: We just want to kill your boss.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_3_Question3_Answer2: You can't kill my boss. And then he'll kill me. So I'd rather just die now!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_QuestLongDesc: We've discovered the base of the raiders who have been enslaving hapless folks in Freeside, in a vault near New Vegas. But where are the slaves going?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_QuestShortDesc: Confront the slavers at their base near New Vegas.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question2_Choice1: Yeah! Come live in our vault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question3_Choice1: You're free. Why not come live in our vault?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question3_Answer1: I guess so. I'm good anywhere, really.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question4_Choice1: You're slavers. That's enough for me!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question4_Answer1: Leave them alive! They'll be good slaves when they recover.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question4_Answer2: What?! Do you live in a vault or something?!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question4_Answer3: They sure as hell scare me!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question5_Choice2: Our wrath will destroy you now!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question5_Answer2: Not a chance. I'm too important to die!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question5_Choice3: Can you just stop with the slave stuff?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_GoingToTown_4_Question5_Answer3: You must be joking. Inferior beings are meant to serve the strong. You'll see… some day…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_QuestLongDesc: We're throwing a party for Mr. House, and we want all the most interesting people there. The only invite left to deliver is to Maximus! Find him on the Strip!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_QuestShortDesc: Deliver Mr. House's party invitation to Maximus.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question1_Choice: We've got an invitation for Maximus.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question1_Answer: Maximus, let's see… Yes, he's here. Hope you find him! Watch out for angry gamblers!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question1_Choice: Seen anyone in a Brotherhood uniform?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question1_Answer: Oh, yes, I remember. He'll be in there somewhere, hopefully he hasn't been shot!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question1_Choice: Just looking for a good time.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question1_Answer: Excellent. You look tough, so maybe you'll even live to tell the tale!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question2_Answer: Ahh, nope, better luck next time.
Eugh, what a gross number! Take what you deserve!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question3_Answer: And it lands on…! RED! You won! Well done.
And it lands on…! RED! You lost! Too bad. Better luck next time.
That's not… uh, well, it was red. Sorry!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question4_Answer: The only way to win is not to play… well done!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question5_Choice: None of my beeswax! Come to Mr. House's party!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question5_Answer: Oh. Phew! Cool. Yeah, I like parties. I'll uh, see you there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question5_Choice: We have this invitation to Maximus for Mr. House's surprise party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question5_Answer: Invitation? For… for me? Is it a trap? No, vault people wouldn't do that. Okay. I'll be there.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question5_Choice: Mr. House is itching to make your acquaintance.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_1_Question5_Answer: Mr. House? Who's… uh, I mean, of course. Why wouldn't he want to meet me? I'm important! And talented!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_QuestLongDesc: Securitrons are supposed to be excellent guards. Go see Victor at RobCo headquarters and discuss security for Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_QuestShortDesc: Organize security for Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question1_Choice: Can you handle security for Mr. House's party?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question1_Answer: Well, shucks! Of course we can! Please take the time to peruse and test out our Securitrons.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question1_Choice: We're just here to test out the Securitrons.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question1_Answer: You're in the right place, friend. Take a tour of our fully-automated defense demonstrations!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question1_Choice: We're having a secret party for Mr. House. Don't tell anyone!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question1_Answer: Well, ain't that sweet. Say no more, friend. We'll help keep it secret, and keep it safe.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question2_Answer: Yes, the sun is in the sky and there is temperature.
Logic loop detected. Rebooting system. Combat systems initiated.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question2_Choice: I'll test out your aggression response. Put 'em up!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question2_Answer: Aggression will be met with lethal force.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question3_Answer: How else could ya tell they were good enough? I knew you could do it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question3_Choice: They're perfect. See you at the party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_2_Question3_Answer: I can be any Securitron I like. And you can bet your bottom dollar I'll be at the party!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_QuestLongDesc: They say there's a big Ghoul party happening nearby. Could be a good place to scout staff for Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_QuestShortDesc: Find folks to staff Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question1_Choice: Funny. Want to tell jokes at our party?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question1_Answer: Honey, the audience could be literally dead and I would be happier than I am here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question1_Choice: We need a comedian for Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question1_Answer: Yeesh. If he needs a comedian, he's got worse problems than me! I'll take the gig!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question1_Choice: You'll make a killing at Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question1_Answer: To kill someone with laughter… truly a comedian's highest praise!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question4_Choice: Maybe they turned feral at the party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question4_Answer: Woah. That's like slasher movie material!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question4_Choice: Maybe they're angry because the dip was off.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question4_Answer: Let's hope not since we want to hire their kitchen staff.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question2_Choice: Our party will have zero Feral Ghouls. Promise.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question2_Answer: We don't care either way. A job's a job. See you there!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question2_Choice: We need your skilled hands for Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question2_Answer: My skilled hands are busy! But they'll be free for your party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question2_Choice: This is hell's kitchen. Come work for me.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question2_Answer: I knew I was better than just a home chef. Now I hit the big time!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question3_Choice: I've heard enough. You're hired for Mr. House's party!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question3_Answer: Mr. House? Oof, that sounds like a whole different kind of dangerous. But yeah, sure.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question3_Choice: Want to play at a party that isn't in a graveyard?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_3_Question3_Answer: Uh, sure. We're still on the clock for two more hours, though. You should get out, it's dangerous in here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_QuestLongDesc: The time has come for Mr. House's party! But… what's that sound? Radroaches! Squish them all before the rest of the guests arrive!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_QuestShortDesc: Squish the Radroaches that have crashed Mr. House's party.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question0_Choice: Radroaches? At our party!? The party organizer's job is never done.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question1_Choice: Look, don't get smart. We're dealing with it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question1_Answer: It never hurt to be a smartass in my business. So far. Everyone who's shot has missed.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question1_Choice: If you want to help, tell them some of your jokes.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question1_Answer: Ooh, that's rich. Maybe the roaches will be a bit more grateful.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question2_Answer: Yes, to get the blood pumping! Go get them, boss!
Ah, the poor roaches. They can't help the way they are.
Ignore the vermin and honor the man of the hour. I like it!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question7_Choice: Weather's fine, no thanks to you.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question7_Answer: Sass detected. Ending conversation. Move along.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question7_Choice: Why aren't you helping deal with the Radroaches?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question7_Answer: Cannot comply. Radroaches are not attacking Mr. House.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question3_Choice: Best I can offer is Radroach eggs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question3_Answer: Ah. Right, well. Not the same appeal, you know? I'll look around.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question3_Choice: Quit looking sorry for yourself and squash some bugs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question3_Answer: Oh! Sure, yeah. I can do that. Sorry.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question4_Choice: Make new ones. Out of Radroach meat.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question4_Answer: Oh. Are you sure? I mean, we can, but what will Mr. House think?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question4_Choice: Forget it. As long as we still have a spread.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question4_Answer: Yeah… but they're not even savoring them! What a waste.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question4_Choice: Run for supplies. We'll take care of things here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question5_Choice: Keep it. Just go squish some bugs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question5_Answer: I sure am sorry, pardner. At least there's no Deathclaws crashin' the party!
This oughta set you up nice in that vault o' yours!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question5_Choice: Actually, all this squishing made me thirsty.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question5_Answer: Well, how's this to wet your lips?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_HouseWarming_4_Question6_Answer: A pragmatic choice. Bottle caps make the Wasteland go 'round!
Wear it, and take the glory of New Vegas with you anywhere you go.
Hold in your arms the power of the god of destruction.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_1_QuestLongD: We've discovered the remains of a secret Enclave base. What strange and horrifying stuff will we find?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_1_QuestShort: Explore a ruined Enclave base nearby.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_1_Room2_Ques: Hey, those Mole rats have a nest made of old clothes. Let's take them!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_1_Room3_Ques: Gold is good for wires, not much else.
Beautiful and practical, truly the ultimate material!
Friendly reminder that the Enclave is a secret. Don't tell anyone!
I love gold! Can I have some of yours?
Take all gold to the National Gold Reserves, or face heavy prosecution!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_1_QuestObjec: Look for clues about the Enclave
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_2_QuestLongD: The first Enclave location on our list is an old Vault-Tec vault. They're probably doing something really sinister, sullying our pristine walls and morals.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_2_QuestShort: Investigate an Enclave training facility in an old vault.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_2_Room1_Ques: Great, we can learn from centuries old dead guys.
Bzzzt, hostile sarcasm detected. Lesson number one: respect pre-war America!
Actually, we're here to shut you down!
It isn't much, but it's what we've got! Please enjoy your stay.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_2_Room2_Ques: Sure, consider this your lucky day.
Oh, thanks! I sure hope I don't see you again!
Sounds like something an Enclave patsy would say.
Oh, no! But I used my pre-war deception training!
Liar. Pay up and you can go.
Oh, sure! Here, it's my rainy day fund!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_2_Room3_Ques: Water, of course. Food is a close second.
WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! With gold, you can buy tons of food and water!
Gold, of course. It's so shiny and useful.
WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! It's shinier and more useful than whatever you said.
Guns, of course. So I can take people's gold and food.
WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! With gold, you can buy lots of guns!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_2_Room4_Ques: Just the sound of their destruction, if you don't mind.
Scallywags! No! Stay away from our precious database!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_3_QuestLongD: Our metal detectors picked up a heavy signal of pure gold at a nearby megastore building. Could be worth checking out!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_3_QuestShort: Look for gold at an old megastore building.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_3_Room4_Ques: A fellow afficionado. Good to see a friendly face out here. Here, take this.
You found some gold? I'll take it.
Aw, I didn't want to fight. But you're not taking my gold.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_3_Room1_Ques: Of course I talk. I dress like this to fit in. Here, take my old suit.
If you're not feral, what are you doing here?
What does it look like? Scrounging for food. All I found was this useless metal. Here, take it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_4_QuestLongD: We've discovered an active Enclave base! Let's bring the fight to them, before they finish whatever horrible thing they're planning.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_4_QuestShort: Confront the Enclave at their nearby base.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_4_Room1_Ques: Let me to talk to your boss.
Colonel [REDACTED] has no meetings. Please wait for him in the afterlife.
Want to help fight the Enclave?
Impossible! It's against my programming. And now, I'll fight you!
Just clocking in for today's shift.
Your ID card is… non-existant! Die, fraudulent heathen!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_4_Room4_Ques: Y-yeah, well, we also know lots of stuff! Like how to deal with intruders!
You really are all super delusional. It's pretty sad.
If you think we're delusional, then you're the ones being, uh, diluted!
You may have gold, but we have friendship. And friendship is magic.
Stop bragging about having friends! The colonel says it's overrated!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_4_Room2_Ques: No! Our leader says genocide is bad! Stop making me confused!
Justice? Like with an impartial judge?
Yes! And no one is more impartial than our autocratic leader!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_4_QuestObjec: Deal with the Enclave Remnants' leader
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL1_LoveOfGold_4_Room3_Ques: I'm about to ruin a lot more than your day.
You'll regret this. We're always watching! We'll never die!
Leave the cleanup to the Mole rats.
If you kill me, the Enclave will be back for my corpse. And for you!
