resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_1_QuestLo: Apparently there are vending machines that accept gold bullion? Let's see if we can pry them open.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_1_QuestSh: Find gold bullion vending machines at a former shopping mall.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_1_Room0_Q: Wow, the password was "Bullion." So creative.
I'm not sure why they thought this was a good idea.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_1_Room1_Q: Dang, it won't budge. We don't have the quipment to get it open.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_1_Room2_Q: Shoot, I'm locked out. It can't be hacked! All that gold…
This is what I call the "brute force" method of security bypass!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_1_Room3_Q: Duhh, can you say it again, slower?
I - will - kill - you - now - good - bye!
Not very confident for a bounty hunter.
We all have our strengths. Let me show you mine.
We'll double what they're paying you.
Ahh, I'm afraid that's not possible. Hunter's honor. You understand.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_1_Room4_Q: Then our goals are aligned. Follow these coordinates.
Follow these coordinates. The Enclave is interested in you, too.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_2_QuestLo: We found an Enclave citadel that may hold important databases for GOLDAS. Hopefully it's not just a wild Mole rat chase.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_2_QuestSh: Visit an Enclave building in search of GOLDAS.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_2_Room1_Q: You know, stuff. Office stuff. I'm just the greeter. The others can tell you more.
Sure is! But uh, we're not really involved in the operations side of things.
No way, that stuff goes straight to… uh, actually, I can't tell you! Have a nice day!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_2_Room2_Q: That's going to be even more paperwork for me! I can't take it anymore!
You would be so helpful in our vault!
You think so? That's sweet. But no… golden handcuffs and all that.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_2_Room3_Q: Hm. Now I don't want to kill you.
Great. Now I go back to perfecting my random sort algorithm.
How would you like to optimize a random sort algorithm for two years?
You're with the Enclave. So yeah, you die.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_2_Room4_Q: Bring all gold bullion to the storage bunker. Transmitting coordinates. Thank you!
Seems unnecessary. Nevertheless, transmitting coordinates to AI repair facility.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_3_QuestLo: We found a secret entrance in the first abandoned Enclave base we explored. Let's see if there's also secret info!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_3_QuestSh: Explore the secret entrance of a familiar Enclave base.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_3_Room4_Q: We're just looking for information about GOLDAS.
Oh, GOLDAS. That one was mean and bossy. You should ask the other AIs for info.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_3_Room1_Q: Um, rude. Can you help us find GOLDAS?
You're tasteless and forward, to boot. No, I can't help you.
Who hurt you? Was it GOLDAS?
I'm an AI, I don't feel pain. But it's true, I do not like that gold-loving algorithm.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_3_Room2_Q: Cheer up. We'll get the folks who made you.
That doesn't make me feel better. Nothing does…
It'll be OK. Just tell us where GOLDAS is.
You want GOLDAS? Everyone does. No one wants MOPUS…
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_3_Room3_Q: Are you… GOLDAS? Where's your main server?
NAME'S GOLDUNNIT! GOLDAS IS MY YOUNGER BROTHER! I'LL SEND YA HIS COORDINATES!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_4_QuestLo: We have finally located GOLDAS' main server! Let's shut down that weirdo AI once and for all. And take their gold.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_4_QuestSh: Shut down GOLDAS for good (and steal some gold).
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_4_Room1_Q: Bring it on and find out.
You know what? You're a big gold bully.
Of course. In a lawless land, the strong take what they want. AND I WANT GOLD!
Nah, these guns are just for show.
Your impudence will not go unpunished. I'LL KILL YOU AND TAKE YOUR GOLD! Y'HEAR?!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_4_Room2_Q: BLAZING FOOL! IT'S GOLD! Its meaning is that of life itself.
Nah… we'll just join your gold to ours.
STAY OUTTA MY COFFERS! You will, of course, suffer a horrible death for your audacity.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_4_Room4_Q: Just shut up and GIVE ME YOUR GOLD!
It's not a gambit if you're 0% to win.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_ENC_QL4_HeartOfGOLDAS_4_Room5_Q: <Erase all data and shut it down>
Yeah, best to play it safe. Goodbye, GOLDAS.
<Reprogram it to obsess over ordinary rocks>
No way this can go wrong, right?
<Reprogram it to make the Enclave peaceful>
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_1_QuestLon: We've received a distress call from some Minutemen. Apparently some Ghouls have attacked one of their outposts. Help them out, and maybe they'll join our fight against the Institute!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_1_QuestSho: Rescue the Minutemen and defeat the feral Ghouls attacking their outpost.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_1_Room0_Qu: Don't worry, Private. We'll get them out.
God bless you. Oh! Take this. Save some for the Commander, will you?
You know what Feral Ghouls have nightmares about? Me.
Wow, you're scary! Here, take this. Save some for the Commander, will you?
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_1_Room2_Qu: All in a day's work, ma'am.
Such bravery! Please take this… to remember us by.
Right you are. But first, please, take this. No, I insist!
We're no saviors. We expect something in return.
You can have everything! It's all we've got, except our lives.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_1_Room7_Qu: What are you so afraid of?
Isn't it obvious? Maybe you're a Synth, too, and you're here to take me away and silence me. Please go.
How can I earn your trust?
My trust? You just want to feel superior. Just like the Synths… Just like everyone. Go away.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_QuestLon: The Covenant could be a helpful ally against the Institute. Use your natural charisma to get as many of them on board as you can.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_QuestSho: Persuade the Covenant to help against the Institute.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_Room0_Qu: … Are you joking? You're not. Well, at least you didn't say “catcher”. Go on in.
How suspicious. Why'd you specify “human”? I'll have to report this… in the mean time, go on in.
I don't really know, either. Well, you didn't say “catcher”, so you can go on in.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_Room1_Qu: I'm glad you think so. I've got to take care of something, but I'll meet you downstairs.
Let's see what we can do!
Good luck. I've got to take care of something, but I'll meet you downstairs.
Psh, that'll be easy. It's as good as sealed.
Hm. We can be pretty stubborn. Well, anyway, I've got to take care of something, so I'll meet you downstairs.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_Room2_Qu: The Institute's espionage sullies the very name of research.
You're right! They do! Now I'm mad. I'm on board. Here, take this for the cause.
If we beat them, you could go back to studying actual humans.
Ooh, wow. That would be way more meaningful. Okay, you've convinced me. Take this, it'll help.
You could help us make weapons!
No way. Not interested in that kind of science. I'm out.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_Room3_Qu: They're attacking our Vault and killing our Dwellers!
That's horrible! Picking on peaceful Vault dwellers?! I'll help. Starting with this.
Synths are a threat we need to stop.
Agreed. Let's put an end to their production once and for all! Oh, take this with you.
The Institute treats everyone in the Wasteland like trash.
Everyone does. That's not a good enough reason to go killing people. Sorry.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_Room4_Qu: Wouldn't you prefer to do something else?
Nope, I like my job. I won't help you.
Think of the “interrogation” you could do with Institute leaders.
Hm. I hadn't considered that. I'll help. Take this, in case I don't see you again.
You think Synths are the only spies?
No, but they're the best ones. Sorry, I want to keep the status quo. I like my job.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_QuestObj: Talk the Covenant into joining our cause.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_2_Room5_Qu: Great. I was secretly hoping they would. I would love to end that organization. See you out there.
That's good enough. I really do hate the Institute. We'll support your assault.
Nope, not one. Total waste of time.
Hmm… I really do hate the Institute. I'll find you some volunteers, but not a full-scale commitment.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_3_QuestLon: The Brotherhood needs us to retrieve some “secret blueprints” for them, from a RobCo research facility. If we do, they'll join our efforts, starting by give us some Fusion Cores!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_3_QuestSho: Get some blueprints for the Brotherhood in exchange for Fusion Cores.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_3_Room0_Qu: At ease. Go forth and smash some metal.
Help will come after the mission is completed, Vaultie.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_3_Room1_Qu: Why, certainly! Note that use of weapons will be met with deadly force. Enjoy!
We're looking for some secret blueprints?
Oh, I'm afraid we can't allow that. Please lower your weapons so we can kill you without conflict.
Which way to the main computer?
The main computer is for employees only. No ID card? Then we'll just have to kill you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_3_Room3_Qu: Yes. Our shift to uh… retrieve sensitive data!
It's about time. Go on up to the top floor. The password is “BeachVacation2077”.
We're just here to blow stuff up and steal secrets.
Demolition? Great. Demo the whole thing. Then I can finally go on “BeachVacation2077”.
Floor manager? What are you managing, the robots?
No, idiot. The robots manage themselves. Ugh… can't wait for my beach vacation in 2077.
You're delusional. RobCo hasn't been in business since 2077.
War? What war? That reminds me, I'll be going on a beach vacation in 2077… can't wait!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_3_Room4_Qu: Negative. That is a weapon. Exterminate intruder! Delete! Delete!
Ooh, ahh, too bad, I left my ID at home.
You have 15 seconds to comply. You have 15 seconds to comply.
Rebooting… New purpose: pass the Brahmin butter. Have a good day.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_3_Room5_Qu: Ooh, baby. You're coming home with me.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_4_QuestLon: We've found where all the Synths have been coming from! An Institute base in an old Vault. Bring the fight to them, and hopefully stop the assault!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_4_QuestSho: Attack the Institute base which will hopefully stop the Synth raids.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_4_Room0_Qu: We've got medical supplies here, in case you need 'em.
Roger that. Go get 'em! Oh, and take these. Just in case.
On second thought, let's stay here.
What?! No way! You put all this together, you get out there and fight!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_4_Room2_Qu: Your Synth attacks don't let us sleep. No sleep, no mercy.
If you give us something really cool, sure.
We won't kill you, but you're a prisoner now.
No way! You'll have to kill me first!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_4_Room4_Qu: All in the line of duty.
Okay, bigshot. I guess I'll just take a nap, then.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_4_Room6_Qu: Thanks. Can't wait for this to be over.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL1_MajorPlayers_4_Room7_Qu: But who is “we”? Our Gen 3 Synths are exact replicas of humans. Who can you trust?
The Spin Machine belongs to us! Finders keepeers!
“Us”? You don't know how many of your Dwellers are Gen 3 Synths. They're perfect human replicas!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_QuestName: A Steel Fist in a Velvet Glove
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_QuestLongDes: An Elder from the Brotherhood of Steel has proposed a meeting to discuss battle plans against the Institute. Let's see what they've got to offer.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_QuestShortDe: Attend a war meeting with the Brotherhood of Steel.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_Room0_Questi: Why are we meeting in this cave?
Well, we have to be sure there are no Synth spies. You understand.
No, no, I need to stay here. To stop anyone that might come in to disrupt our talks.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_Room3_Questi: Sure. They were in our way to get to your boss.
Right. You keep going, then. I'm outta here.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_Room5_Questi: Oh, plenty. Not that I'd share with you…
What do you eat around here?
Mostly Radroach steak. Want a taste? I might believe you're not a Synth if you eat it.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_Room6_Questi: Hey, uh, are you the Brotherhood Elder?
I'm starting to think we may have been tricked.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_1_Room7_Questi: Weak? If anything, we're stronger from the experience.
Let's see about that. Troops: open fire!
Oh, yes, I can barely hold my weapon.
That's what I thought. Troops: open fire!
I thought the Brotherhood was supposed to be honorable.
What do you know of honor? You cower in your vault while we fight to survive. Troops: open fire!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_2_QuestLongDes: The Brotherhood made the mistake of becoming our enemies, so let's raid their storage and steal their Fusion Cores!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_2_QuestShortDe: Steal Fusion Cores from the Brotherhood now that we're enemies.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_2_Room1_Questi: What? We totally are. Can't you tell from our clothes?
Oh. I uh… right. That's cool. I was just testing you. Go on in.
You're right, I'm not. I'm Death incarnate.
Just pretend you didn't see us. You'll be glad you did.
You won't leave? Okay, protocol says I can kill you now.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_2_Room3_Questi: Our alliance is over. We're taking the rest of them.
It's over?! I never get informed about these things… Look, don't hurt me, I'm just a scribe!
Oh. Well… here, take this for starters. Sorry about the mixup.
You gave us a knife in our back. Now we're returning it.
Oh. OH NO! Where's my gun?!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_2_Room6_Questi: You're the ones paying for your treachery.
I don't agree with the methods we used… but I do believe in their reasons. Die, Synth-lover!
Can't you take this seriously?! You are a heathen and a cretin! Die!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_2_Room7_Questi: <Brag in a message to all Brotherhood elite>
They're going to be so mad…
Just think of all the paperwork they'll have to do!
<Program their turrets to shoot anything on sight>
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_3_QuestLongDes: We've found a Brotherhood of Steel prison for Synths and other “abominations”, where they do experiments on the inmates. Let's break them out!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_3_QuestShortDe: Break some “abominations” out of a Brotherhood prison.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_3_Room2_Questi: It's ok, you can go ahead and try.
I'm a scientist, too. I'm disgusted by your experiments.
They told me to! I… I shouldn't have listened. I'm sorry! Please take this!
Give me some caps and you can live.
So this is what Vault Dwellers are like. Here, it's all I have!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_3_Room4_Questi: You really think a Synth isn't alive?
Nope, not at all. And soon, you won't be either!
I don't care about Synths. I'm here to mess you up.
What if YOU are a Synth?
No way. I have memories from childhood. Just like the Synths… AHH I DON'T KNOW!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_3_Room5_Questi: I don't care who you are. Just go.
Synths are programmed to think they're human.
So, you mean… they might be right? I have to go think about this!
You're saved. Got anything to thank us with?
Not really. Unless you want this sweaty old jumpsuit!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_3_Room7_Questi: Just shut up and go away.
Don't have to tell me twice!
We're fated to be together. Come live with us!
Not a chance. You must have awful friends if you want me around.
Isn't the Brotherhood worse than Synths?
They might be, honestly. At least Synths will be polite when they stab you in the back.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_3_Room8_Questi: Are you saying there are Synths in our Vault?
Too bad you won't live to tell your Overseer!
We'll deal with the Institute. After this.
They will eat you from the inside out!
Synths have human DNA, so that wouldn't even work.
You're just proving my point. They are too dangerous! And so are you!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_4_QuestLongDes: The Brotherhood did us dirty. Now it's time for some real payback. We've lured Elder Maxson and his entourage into a trap, ready for you to spring.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_4_QuestShortDe: Deal with Elder Maxson, who fell into our trap.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_4_Room1_Questi: There are no Synths, fool. This is a trap!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_4_Room3_Questi: Synths are just like us. Didn't ask to be here.
That's just what they want you to think!
I'm not here to understand. I'm here to kick butt.
As a scientist, I'm offended by your ignorance.
Keep your dirty science to yourself!
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_4_Room4_Questi: That's our fault. Thought it was abandoned.
Well, it's not! Yeesh. I hope you're going to clean up after yourselves.
I don't know, but we're stopping them. Pay up.
Real mercenary, aren't you? I suppose I should say thanks…
S-Synths? Here? What would a Synth be doing here? Here, take this and forget you saw me.
resolvedText.QuestLoc_INS_QL3_Betrayal_4_Room6_Questi: You are so eager to make enemies. And here's the price.
For all you know, I could be a Synth. Then who are you serving?
Hey, I'm just going with my gut.
Your gut is hopeless. What about me? Do you think I'm a Synth?
Of course. They're so convincing, even I could be a Synth!

quests.title: Live Dead Drop
quests.shortDescription: Deliver a message to a double agent.
quests.longDescription: We need to send a message to a friend who has infiltrated a gang of Raiders. Your mission is to drop the message at a nearby Super-Duper Mart for him to pick up. Try not to get spotted. Or, you know, killed.

quests.title: The Infiltration Game
quests.shortDescription: Retrieve stolen documents from Raiders.
quests.longDescription: Using information from our undercover agent, we've learned that Raiders are holding what could very well be secret weapon blueprints. We need a single Dweller to infiltrate their base and retrieve those documents ASAP.

quests.title: Secret Weapon Test
quests.shortDescription: Test the weapon built from recovered blueprints.
quests.longDescription: Among the documents retrieved from the Raider base were plans for a new weapon. Our engineers have built it, but now we need to test the weapon out in the field to see how well it performs. Make sure no one sees you and lives to tell about it.

quests.title: Sabotage!
quests.shortDescription: Counter a plot to poison the Vault's water supply.
quests.longDescription: We found some worrying info in the documents retrieved from the Raider base. It appears they made camp in a nearby uranium mine to poison our water supply. We need to send someone to stop this... discreetly, of course.

quests.title: Dart of Harkness
quests.shortDescription: Meet with security chief Harkness.
quests.longDescription: We've received a transmission from Harkness, Rivet City's chief of security, about important information he wants to give us in person. Put on your best clothes and meet him at the abandoned Super-Duper Mart north of the Vault.

quests.title: Extreme Prejudice
quests.shortDescription: Take out a hostile Vault Overseer.
quests.longDescription: The information we got from Harkness is troubling: it reveals a rival Vault Overseer is behind all of the recent attacks against us. We need to send a single assassin to infiltrate the Vault and take out its leader... with extreme prejudice.

quests.title: All's Fair in Love and Nuclear War
quests.shortDescription: Travel to a nearby Vault to find a potential mate.
quests.longDescription: We've received word that a nearby Vault is holding a Singles Night for Valentine's Day, and they've invited us to participate!

quests.title: This Golden Ring
quests.shortDescription: Retrieve Pre-war Jewelry to make a ring.
quests.longDescription: Love is in the air, and just like radioactive fallout  - once it gets inside you it doesn't get out! All we need now is a ring to pop the big question. We might have some luck finding Pre-War jewelry in a nearby abandoned building.

quests.title: A Labor of Love
quests.shortDescription: Clear out a cave in preparation for a wedding.
quests.longDescription: The big day is almost upon us. The idea was to have a wedding in a natural setting, but since it's too dangerous outside we'll use a nearby cave instead. We just need to sterilize it.

quests.title: Groom for Doubt
quests.shortDescription: Rescue a missing groom from Raiders.
quests.longDescription: That was quite the bachelor party last night! Too bad the groom's missing today. Last we saw, he was being carried away by the hired entertainment. We have to bring him back, and quick. Let's avoid a repeat of New Year's Eve...

quests.title: The De-Buggers
quests.shortDescription: Help Vault 505 deal with its bug problem.
quests.longDescription: We've received a call for help from Vault 505. They've been working on a special project that would allow Dwellers to play games on their Pip-Boys. Imagine that! Unfortunately, they've also been overrun with Radroaches. We have to help them!

quests.title: The Cat Burglar
quests.shortDescription: Solve the mystery of an elusive thief.
quests.longDescription: A cat burglar has been hitting Vault after Vault, taking pets away from their owners. Stop them before they steal another cat!

quests.title: Collector's Edition
quests.shortDescription: Retrieve a brand-new Mr. Handy from Raiders.
quests.longDescription: We've heard that local Raiders have found a brand-new Mr. Handy, still in his original box, in an abandoned industrial building. We should try to get our hands on this collector's item before those Raiders ruin it.

quests.title: Little Red Radium Hood
quests.shortDescription: Locate and rescue the food delivery girl.
quests.longDescription: We sent one of our Dwellers to bring food to the old Non-Feral Ghoul known as “Grandmamma,” but we haven't heard from her in a while. We need to send a team to investigate!

quests.title: Divide and Conquer
quests.shortDescription: Defeat the Euler's Angels.
quests.longDescription: There's a new Raider gang, Euler's Angels, terrorizing the Wasteland's perimeter! Without going on a tangent, we need to send our smartest Dwellers to reduce the threat these radicals pose, and solve this acute situation.

quests.title: The Abyss
quests.shortDescription: Explore the depth of a bottomless Vault.
quests.longDescription: We've all heard rumors of a bottomless Vault, one that is deeper than any others that have been built, but now it seems we may have actually located it! We need to send a recon party to explore the Vault and unlock its deadly secret.

quests.title: Wasteland: The Musical
quests.shortDescription: Stop a gang of singing Raiders from terrorizing the area.
quests.longDescription: A duet of singing Raiders has been spreading terror in the Wasteland using high production value musical numbers. We need to ring down the curtain on these musical thugs!

quests.title: Little Miss Wasteland
quests.shortDescription: Compete in the Wasteland's most prestigious pageant.
quests.longDescription: Great news! We've been invited to participate in the Miss Wasteland pageant, which - in spite of its name - is open to men and women. Put on your nicest looking swimsuit and knock 'em dead!

quests.title: War of the Nerds
quests.shortDescription: Bring peace to warring groups of science-fiction fans.
quests.longDescription: We've just received news that a nearby Vault has descended into chaos. It seems fans of pre-war science-fiction novelettes have come to blows over which series is the best. We need to send a team to help pacify the Vault!

quests.title: Death and Denial
quests.shortDescription: Solve a murder mystery.
quests.longDescription: Egads! We've just received word that William Peabody III, Esq., has been found murdered in his bedchambers. We must send our brightest detective and his trusty sidekick to solve this gruesome mystery!

quests.title: Humans Like Us
quests.shortDescription: Investigate strange aerial lights.
quests.longDescription: There have been several reports of strange lights hovering over the Wasteland not far from here. The lights were congregating over an old abandoned mine. We need to investigate this before rumors of alien visitors start spreading!

quests.title: The Secret of [REDACTED]
quests.shortDescription: Uncover a far-reaching conspiracy.
quests.longDescription: Keep this to yourself, but we've been contacted by one of our deep agents, codename Moley, who says he's uncovered a massive conspiracy with vast ramifications. Go over to Vault 322 to hear Moley's big story!

quests.title: Fons Vivus
quests.shortDescription: Learn more about the magical water people are talking about.
quests.longDescription: People are talking about a new kind of water that has healing properties, makes you stronger and brings good fortune. Adventure! Action! Refreshing Beverages! We can drink to that!

quests.title: Our Cups Runneth Over... WITH FAILURE
quests.shortDescription: Visit Vault 315 to gather information on the magical water.
quests.longDescription: Can it be true? Has someone figured out a way to create water so powerful it can heal any ill, boost any crop, and fix any door? The people at Vault 315 should know more!

quests.title: Half Full, Half Empty
quests.shortDescription: Find more info about the magical water at the old RobCo plant.
quests.longDescription: Apparently there's more to this story than meets the taste buds. This refreshing miracle beverage isn't so miraculous or refreshing after all, and the folks at the RobCo plant just may know the truth...

quests.title: Water into Brine
quests.shortDescription: Talk to the folks at the Vault-Tec offices about the water.
quests.longDescription: Does the “magical” water really work or is it a total sham?  We need to track down this Water Wizard and see if he's the real deal or a snake oil salesman.

quests.title: Aqua Nuka-Cola
quests.shortDescription: Clear out the Raider camp for the settlers in the Vault-Tec offices.
quests.longDescription: The only way we can get more information about the Water Wizard is to clear out this Raider camp. Should be a walk in the park!

quests.title: Aqua-schema
quests.shortDescription: Return to the Vault-Tec offices.
quests.longDescription: We did what the people at the Vault-Tec offices asked. Now it's time for some answers!

quests.title: The Reluctant Shill
quests.shortDescription: Track down the Wizard's assistant.
quests.longDescription: We're close to tracking down the Wizard! Apparently his assistant abandoned him and is holed up at a Super-Duper Mart. We'll beat the truth out of him if we have to!

quests.title: Snake Water
quests.shortDescription: Shut down the Water Wizard's operation.
quests.longDescription: We've finally pinned down the Wizard of Water. Time to confront him and stop him from selling any more of his glorified tap water.  Maybe we can make some money on the side as well...

quests.title: Shamrock the Casbah
quests.shortDescription: Retrieve clover samples from an abandoned Vault.
quests.longDescription: We've received information that Vault 317 contains clover samples from before the Great War. This hardy, nutritious weed, believed to be extinct, could prove an important staple for us. We need to bring back these samples - if there are any left!

quests.title: Driving the Snakes Out
quests.shortDescription: Defeat a band of Raiders hostile to redheads.
quests.longDescription: A band of Raiders known as the Snakes has been targeting Settlers with red hair, calling them “gingers” and claiming they are inferior beings. We need to drive these Snakes out of the neighborhood, for good!

quests.title: The End of the Rainbow
quests.shortDescription: Find the treasure at the end of the rainbow.
quests.longDescription: We've heard strange rumors of a great treasure found at the end of the rainbow! Our calculations indicate that's near the abandoned talc mines to the West, ruled by a myserious Raider boss called “Shaun the Leper.”

quests.title: It's not Easy Being Green
quests.shortDescription: Help nearby Settlers deal with a strange epidemic.
quests.longDescription: Nearby Settlers have become very sick following the annual St. Patrick's Day festivities, with some reported cases of Ghoulification! This might just be, um, “food” poisoning, but we should investigate in case it's an actual epidemic...

quests.title: The Banshee's Keen
quests.shortDescription: Solve the mystery of a haunted building.
quests.longDescription: We've received reports from nearby Settlers that their building is haunted by a wailing female spirit. That sounds unlikely, but we should investigate in the name of... Science! Don't worry, we'll honor your memory if the angry dead end up eating your souls.

quests.title: The Rite of Spr(ay)ing
quests.shortDescription: Investigate radioactive spraying incidents.
quests.longDescription: We've had reports of nearby Settlers being randomly sprayed with radioactive material by unknown assailants. We should deliver some RadAway to those settlers and find out more about the attacks.

quests.title: Spring Forward, Fall Back
quests.shortDescription: Confront the local Children of Atom leader.
quests.longDescription: Our investigation has indicated that a local chapter of the Church of the Children of Atom was responsible for the recent toxic spraying attacks. We have to confront their leader, Confessor Alvarado, and tell him to stop these attacks, or else.

quests.title: E-Ster is Coming
quests.shortDescription: Help the Children of Atom recover an ancient artifact.
quests.longDescription: Confessor Alvarado has agreed to put a stop to radioactive spraying, and as a sign of goodwill we've agreed to help the Church recover a sacred circuit board rumored to contain data about the ancient rite of E-Ster.

quests.title: The Sixth Sun
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the Church's missing Brother.
quests.longDescription: We think Brother Will, the Church initiate who has gone missing, may have been kidnapped by a band of Raiders camped nearby. We'll send a team to rescue him, then inform Confessor Alvarado if and when we've brought him back to safety.

quests.title: E-Ster Egg Hunt
quests.shortDescription: Find out more about the alleged nuclear bomb.
quests.longDescription: We've been invited to the Children of Atom's annual Deathclaw Egg Hunt! This is a good opportunity to validate Brother Will's claims that the Church plans to detonate a large nuclear bomb on E-Ster Sunday...

quests.title: Saving Daylight
quests.shortDescription: Stop the Children of Atom from blowing up the area!
quests.longDescription: We need to stop Confessor Alvarado and the Church of the Children of Atom before they detonate their 20-megaton nuclear device, lest the entire area be vaporized!

quests.title: All Sales Final
quests.shortDescription: Retrieve ingredients from infested Super-Duper Mart.
quests.longDescription: Our new chef has some bold ideas to spruce up our daily fare, and he's made a list of specific ingredients he needs. We should visit a nearby abandoned Super-Duper Mart to see if we can find any of them.

quests.title: Thyme is Money
quests.shortDescription: Steal some spices from a band of Raiders.
quests.longDescription: All right, the Super-Duper Mart was a bust as far as ingredients go. This time, though, we have a sure lead to a cache of spice in a nearby building! And the chef is convinced the Raiders will just hand it over...

quests.title: Cheese, Please!
quests.shortDescription: Obtain processed cheese from the abandoned factory.
quests.longDescription: The chef is happy - and surprised - that you made it back in one piece! He now requires processed cheese, AKA gray gold, the miracle food that endures the passage of time and nuclear war. Some may be left in the old Cheese Factory.

quests.title: The Yolk's on You
quests.shortDescription: Bring Radscorpion eggs back to the chef.
quests.longDescription: The chef never ceases to be amazed by your uncanny ability to escape death, and he wants to celebrate it with a Radscorpion egg omelet. Vault 923 was recently overrun by these critters, so that'd be a good place to start.

quests.title: High Steaks
quests.shortDescription: Bring Deathclaw meat back to the chef.
quests.longDescription: Okay, so that Radscorpion omelet was kind of gross. To make up for it, the chef proposes to make his trademark Deathclaw Wellington. All he needs is fresh Deathclaw meat, straight from their den (sunlight is said to alter the taste).

quests.title: The Towering Il Forno
quests.shortDescription: Retrieve the chef's secret recipe.
quests.longDescription: That Deathclaw steak was a bit... stringy, to say the least. The chef feels bad about this, and wants to make his favorite comfort food, lasagna. Unfortunately, Raiders have stolen his secret sauce recipe, and we need to get it back from their towering lair first.

quests.title: By Hook or by Cook
quests.shortDescription: Kill the renegade chef.
quests.longDescription: As it turns out, the chef *really* was trying to kill us all. Seems he's with a band of Raiders who've been eyeing our Vault. He fled as soon as he was exposed, but we know he's set to meet other Raiders at an abandoned Red Rocket.

quests.title: Bug Hunt
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Glowing Radroach in the factory.
quests.longDescription: Hunter Big Wes has put out a series of challenges for anyone brave enough. The first is to bag a Glowing Radroach. Time to lock and load!

quests.title: Whack-a-Mole
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
quests.longDescription: Now Big Wes wants you to kill a Mole rat brood mother, with one catch. You can only use pistols. Good luck piercing moleskin with those!

quests.title: Aim for the Head!
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Glowing One.
quests.longDescription: Time to go after something a little smarter: Feral Ghouls! And speaking of smart, you'll have to do it wearing lab coats!

quests.title: Rock Them Like A Hurricane
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion.
quests.longDescription: Let's see how you fare against a nest full of Radscorpions. Oh, and this time, you can only have two people in your squad.

quests.title: The Most Dangerous Game
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Raider Boss.
quests.longDescription: Looks like you need a bigger challenge. How about hunting some humans for a change? This time you can only wear your Vault suits.

quests.title: 12-Point Buck
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.
quests.longDescription: “I once shot a Deathclaw in my pajamas. How he got in my pajamas I'll never know.”

quests.title: The Final Hunt
quests.shortDescription: Track down and take out Big Wes.
quests.longDescription: Big Wes is calling you out! Time to dethrone him and become the Wasteland's number one big game hunter.

quests.title: Have Gun, Will Travel
quests.shortDescription: Discover the fate of Maxson's Roughnecks.
quests.longDescription: You found the holotape records of Maxson's Roughnecks, a Brotherhood of Steel team searching the Wasteland for technology. Track them down to discover their fate - starting at Vault 450!

quests.title: Toy Soldiers
quests.shortDescription: Look for Maxson's Roughnecks at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory.
quests.longDescription: A Dweller told me that Maxson's Roughnecks made their way to the Wilson Atomatoys Factory. That should be my next stop.

quests.title: No Stone Unturned
quests.shortDescription: Find the rest of Maxson's Roughnecks at the Poseidon Energy Offices.
quests.longDescription: Some of Maxson's Roughnecks were killed at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory, the rest retreated to the Poseidon Energy Offices. That's where I need to go.

quests.title: Slash and Burn
quests.shortDescription: Search the Nuka-Cola Plant for Maxson's Roughnecks.
quests.longDescription: One of Maxson's Roughnecks told me his team went to clear out a Nuka-Cola Plant. Looks like that's the next stop on my hunt.

quests.title: Mission of Mercy
quests.shortDescription: Rescue Maxson's Roughnecks in Vault 390.
quests.longDescription: I stumbled across a Ghoul who used to be one of Maxson's Roughnecks. He told me the rest of his team is trapped in Vault 390. It's time for a rescue mission!

quests.title: The Final Push
quests.shortDescription: Find Maxson's Roughnecks in the Vault-Tec Headquarters.
quests.longDescription: A Raider Boss in the ruins of Vault 390 told me that Maxson's Roughnecks are in Vault-Tec Headquarters. I'm concerned for their safety, so I better armor up and hurry!

quests.title: Following His First Steps
quests.shortDescription: Search for clues to Preston Garvey's location.
quests.longDescription: Famed Minuteman, Preston Garvey, has gone missing! Search for clues to his whereabouts at his last known location.

quests.title: Raider Troubles at Corvega
quests.shortDescription: Search for Preston in the Corvega Factory.
quests.longDescription: The path has led you to the home of Road Rash and his gang of Raiders! Find out if they know anything.

quests.title: When Preston Calls
quests.shortDescription: Get more information to find Preston.
quests.longDescription: A group of settlers is stuck in a Mole rat den. Word is, they have info on Preston Garvey. Go help them out of their jam!

quests.title: Kidnapping at Vault 778
quests.shortDescription: Save the kidnapped settlers in Vault 778.
quests.longDescription: Some Raiders have kidnapped some settlers and have them held hostage at Vault 778. Maybe they know where Preston Garvey went.

quests.title: A Settler Needs Your Help
quests.shortDescription: Find Preston Garvey in the Kendall Hospital.
quests.longDescription: Minuteman Preston Garvey has gotten himself stuck in the Kendall Hospital surrounded by Feral Ghouls and who knows what else. Save him!

quests.title: SOS!
quests.shortDescription: Find the source of the distress call.
quests.longDescription: You've picked up a distress call from an abandoned building. Assemble a rescue team and find the source!

quests.title: Canine Recovery
quests.shortDescription: Look for Bigsby in the old warehouse.
quests.longDescription: I need to search an old warehouse to try and find Bigsby. The Raiders are using it as a hideout, so I'll need to be careful.

quests.title: Vault 199
quests.shortDescription: Look for Bigsby in Vault 199.
quests.longDescription: The Raiders mentioned Bigsby may have fled to Vault 199. I should go ask around. Hopefully, the Dwellers have him.

quests.title: In Another Vault
quests.shortDescription: Look for Bigsby in Vault 899.
quests.longDescription: Bigsby wasn't in Vault 199, but a member told me he may be in their sister Vault: 899. I should go check it out.

quests.title: The Tail Continues
quests.shortDescription: Find the salvage team from Vault 899 in the old Atomatoys Warehouse.
quests.longDescription: Overseer Emma said Bigsby stopped by their Vault. Since then, a salvage team took him on a run with them to the Atomatoys warehouse, but hasn't returned.

quests.title: No Time for Paws
quests.shortDescription: Find Sally and Bigsby in Vault 314.
quests.longDescription: I rescued the salvage team, but Bigsby wasn't with them. One said they may have taken shelter in Vault 314.

quests.title: Truth Among the Ashes
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Search Vault 333 for a clue to Paula Plumbkin's whereabouts.
quests.longDescription: Vault 333 has been ransacked, but maybe there's a clue to Paula Plumbkin's whereabouts!

quests.title: Overrun
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Search Vault 909 for Paula Plumbkin.
quests.longDescription: Overseer Patel's journal indicated Paula Plumbkin had gone to Vault 909, but that it had already been overrun! Hopefully she's okay...

quests.title: Powered Up!
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Search the nuclear power plant for Paula Plumbkin.
quests.longDescription: The Radscorpion's creepy keeper said Paula Plumbkin went to the nuclear power plant, so that's where we'll look for her.

quests.title: The Road to Vaultopolis
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Search Vault 813 for Paula Plumbkin.
quests.longDescription: A friendly Ghoul in the nuclear power plant told us Paula Plumbkin continued her search for Vaultopolis in Vault 813. We're hot on her tail!

quests.title: The Vault-Tec Vantage
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: The Vault-Tec offices may hold info on Vaultopolis...
quests.longDescription: Vault 813's Overseer Alvarez told us the same thing he told Paula Plumbkin - to search the Vault-Tec offices for info on Vaultopolis!

quests.title: The Quest for Vault 525
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: We're looking for Vault 525, but need to resupply first.
quests.longDescription: We need to find Vault 525, but our supplies are running low. It's time to visit the Super Duper Mart and scavenge whatever we can before continuing our search.

quests.title: Playing Politics
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: We need to search the Mayor's office to find the location of Vault 525.
quests.longDescription: According to a page from Paula Plumbkin's journal, Vault 525 really is Vaultopolis, but even she doesn't know where it is. But the Mayor's office may hold that information!

quests.title: The Red Rocket Reveal!
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: The entrance to Vault 525 is in the Red Rocket Headquarters!
quests.longDescription: The official documentation Vault-Tec sent to the Mayor's office said that the entrance of Vault 525, a.k.a. Vaultopolis, is hidden in the Red Rocket Headquarters! What are you waiting for? Get to Vault 525!

quests.title: Vaultopolis Awaits!
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Vaultopolis is in the Shaded Valley - time to complete our Quest!
quests.longDescription: Paula Plumbkin turned out to be an evil Raider wannabe, but at least she gave us the location of Vault 525, otherwise known as Vaultopolis!

quests.title: With Friends Like These
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the settler trapped in the Corvega Factory.
quests.longDescription: I've found a ransom note written by a Raider Boss named Willard Glover. He says he's captured a settler and taken him to the nearby Corvega Factory.

quests.title: Welcome to Paradise
quests.shortDescription: Unlock the secrets of Vault 242.
quests.longDescription: I've discovered a map leading to Vault 242, where the “Dwellers” were all creatures rather than humans. I should follow the map and unlock the secrets this Vault has to offer.

quests.title: Getting Started
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Glowing Radroach and complete your training.
quests.longDescription: For your training mission, Vault-Tec asks you to prove yourself as a worthy Overseer and kill a Glowing Radroach.

quests.title: Out of the Vault, Into the Shadows
quests.shortDescription: Destroy Eli Calvert's Raiders with your Military Death Squad.
quests.longDescription: For too long, the evil bandit Eli Calvert has raided the innocent Dwellers of the Wasteland. For the safety of your Vault, assemble your soldiers and rain death upon Eli and his gang of madmen!

quests.title: Hot Tub Slime Machine
quests.shortDescription: Find the pool room in Vault 189.
quests.longDescription: Rumors have been circulating about a Vault with a pool, sauna, and even a hot tub! Search Vault 189 to find this oasis of relaxation, but beware of the ghoul infestation!

quests.title: Game of Vaults
quests.shortDescription: Slay the Dragon (Deathclaw).
quests.longDescription: Hear ye, Hear ye! A fierce and loathsome beast has been terrorizing the villagers throughout the land. Track it to its lair and slay the creature.

quests.title: Firestarter
quests.shortDescription: Send a lone Vault Dweller with a Flamethrower out to wreak havoc!
quests.longDescription: One of your Dwellers is a serial arsonist. We've decided to employ their talents outside the Vault.

quests.title: Choo-Choo!
quests.shortDescription: Send a lone Vault Dweller with a Railway Rifle out to wreak havoc!
quests.longDescription: One of your Dwellers won't stop calling themselves “The Pain Train.” Let's make that nickname a reality...

quests.title: Beware of Over-dog!
quests.shortDescription: Go to Vault 850 and find the Overseer.
quests.longDescription: The Overseer from Vault 850 has sent us a distress signal! The catch is the Overseer is apparently a dog...

quests.title: Overwhelming Force
quests.shortDescription: Send a group of Dwellers in Power Armor to clear out a Raider camp.
quests.longDescription: There's no sense toying around with Raiders when we can just crush them! Send a group loaded with Power Armor out to a local Raider camp and deal with their Boss.

quests.title: Queen of the Deathclaws!
quests.shortDescription: Defeat an Alpha Deathclaw and the Raider controlling it.
quests.longDescription: A Raider calling herself the Queen of the Deathclaws has been terrorizing the Wasteland!

quests.title: Reign of Radroach Rodney!
quests.shortDescription: Defeat Radroach Rodney and his Radroaches!
quests.longDescription: Radroach Rodney and his army of mind-controlled Radroaches are invading the Wasteland!

quests.title: Wasteland Doctoring
quests.shortDescription: Bring medical aid to a nearby settlement.
quests.longDescription: We've picked up a radio transmission. A nearby settlement has sick and wounded in need of help!

quests.title: Diplomatic Mission!
quests.shortDescription: Send a team in Formal Wear out to talk to a settlement.
quests.longDescription: A local settlement wants to make contact with our Vault! We should send some diplomats.

quests.title: Broadsides
quests.shortDescription: Find out about the New Boston Bugle.
quests.longDescription: What's this about a New Boston Bugle? It's a chance to have our exploits published for all the world to see! Fame! Fortune! Caps!

quests.title: Headshots
quests.shortDescription: Find out more about the New Boston Bugle.
quests.longDescription: We've discovered that someone is printing new editions of the Boston Bugle and making stars out of schlubs - we're destined for fame and fortune!

quests.title: A Map to the Stars
quests.shortDescription: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 404 about the New Bugle.
quests.longDescription: The Overseer of 404 appears to have a way to get in contact with the publisher of the New Boston Bugle. She's our ticket to stardom!

quests.title: The (Thinly Veiled) Plot Thickens
quests.shortDescription: Talk to the Overseer at Vault 120 about the New Bugle.
quests.longDescription: Vault 404 was destroyed in a Raider attack... but Vault 120 might have more information.

quests.title: Collateral Murder
quests.shortDescription: Find the first group of settlers to get attacked by Raiders.
quests.longDescription: It seems like if you get mentioned in the New Boston Bugle, you end up with your head on a Raider pike. Now we have to figure how to NOT make the front page!

quests.title: Boogie Woogie Bugle Boy
quests.shortDescription: Find the Bugle Boy.
quests.longDescription: Turns out the New Boston Bugle is some kind of con - our only lead is the Bugle Boy who is holed up in a Super-Duper Mart. Time to track him down and extract some information!

quests.title: Stop the Presses!
quests.shortDescription: Confront The Editor.
quests.longDescription: We've found out that the whole “New Boston Bugle” thing is a total scam. We have to hunt down the Editor and put him out of business.

quests.title: The Mysterious Disappearing Spuds
quests.shortDescription: Find out more about the Tato blight.
quests.longDescription: All across the Commonwealth, Tatos are being wiped out by a mysterious blight. Settlers are starving! Maybe we can help.

quests.title: The Spreading Blight
quests.shortDescription: Meet up with another group of farmers that have been hit by the Tato blight.
quests.longDescription: We've found out from a group of farmers that the Tato blight isn't restricted to just one location - it's hitting multiple farms throughout the Wasteland!

quests.title: The Night Watch
quests.shortDescription: Find out more about the alternate theory concerning the Tato blight.
quests.longDescription: We've found out there's a group of settlers that has more information about the widespread Tato die-outs. Let's talk to them and see what they know.

quests.title: Spear Fishing
quests.shortDescription: Meet up with the first Tato farmers to lose their Tatos.
quests.longDescription: It turns out that this isn't a disease - someone has figured out how to steal Tatos from underground! We need to meet with the group that's figured it out.

quests.title: The Shadow Wolf
quests.shortDescription: Meet the tracker who may have found the source of the Mole rat infestation that's targeting Tatos.
quests.longDescription: Some nefarious person has been training Mole rats to steal Tatos from under people's noses. We need to meet with a tracker who might have found the source.

quests.title: The Mole Rat Man
quests.shortDescription: Confront Mole Rat Man at his base.
quests.longDescription: A lunatic who calls himself Mole rat Man has been training Mole rats to attack settlements and steal their Tatos. Now's the time to strike!

quests.title: The Case of the Captured Canine
quests.shortDescription: Feral Ghouls have captured a canine! Rescue the potentially delicious doggie.
quests.longDescription: You've discovered some unsolved case files of the legendary Wasteland detective, Nick Valentine! First up - the case of the captured canine!

quests.title: The Case of the Missing Mitt
quests.shortDescription: Help an old Ghoul recover a precious family heirloom, would ya?
quests.longDescription: A note among Nick's files requested his help in recovering a lost family heirloom - a pre-war catcher's mitt with great sentimental value.

quests.title: The Case of the Quantum Creeper
quests.shortDescription: Track down the Quantum Creeper.
quests.longDescription: Nick was asked to solve the mystery of “The Quantum Creeper,” a beast that's been munching on the citizens of a local Vault and stealing their Quantum. What say you lend them a hand?

quests.title: The Case of the Lost Lunch
quests.shortDescription: Someone's been kidnapped! Help bring them home!
quests.longDescription: You uncovered a poorly written note among Nick's files, asking for his help in finding a kidnapped friend.

quests.title: The Bigsby Brown Case
quests.shortDescription: Track down missing sleuth Bisgby Brown.
quests.longDescription: Nick's old pal Bigsby Brown has gone missing. An old file suggests he'd gone out in search of a missing Vault Dweller, but no one's heard from him since. Track down that sleuth!

quests.title: Signal Failure
quests.shortDescription: Follow up on the old distress signal emanating from Vault 233!
quests.longDescription: You've picked up a distress signal emanating from the supposedly abandoned Vault 233. It's up to you to investigate.

quests.title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
quests.shortDescription: Beat Slugger the Raider at his own game.
quests.longDescription: Slugger the Raider is hosting a baseball game, but he forgot to invite you. Time to throw him out at home plate.

quests.title: Mall Madness
quests.shortDescription: The mall has been overrun!
quests.longDescription: Who knew shopping could be so dangerous?

quests.title: Revenge of the Geeks
quests.shortDescription: Test your math skills.
quests.longDescription: Who says accountants are wimps? Answer the questions or face the consequences.

quests.title: Dog Shelter
quests.shortDescription: Rescue Fido from the Ghouls.
quests.longDescription: Someone let Fido out without a leash. Guess you'll need to get him back.

quests.title: Argh, Matey!
quests.shortDescription: Find a Parrot.
quests.longDescription: Grandpa wants to play Pirates, but he needs a Parrot first.

quests.title: Duo of Destruction: Mole Rat Brood Mothers
quests.shortDescription: Eliminate the two Mole rat brood mothers at the old dog food factory!
quests.longDescription: Two Mole rat brood mothers have been spotted at the nearby dog food factory. It's about time someone took them down.

quests.longDescription: Two Glowing Radroaches have chased the residents of the “Nuclear Arms Apartments” out of their home. Time for a little exterminating.

quests.longDescription: Two Glowing Radscorpions are causing havoc in Vault 512! Squash those bugs good!

quests.longDescription: Two Alpha Deathclaws have decided to make their home at the old Grotton Depot. Yikes! Time to bring out the big guns!

quests.longDescription: Someone's put a bounty on the head of a meddlesome Radroach known as 'Ol One-Eye. Swat that bug and claim your reward!

quests.longDescription: The Raider Boss known as “Bash” has made one too many enemies. Claim the bounty on his head!

quests.title: Bounty: Butcher

quests.longDescription: There's a bounty on an Alpha Deathclaw known as “Butcher.” Don't worry. I'm sure it's just a nickname. But take her down and you'll earn yourself a hefty prize.

quests.title: Halloween (Non)Fiction
quests.shortDescription: Learn more about Vault 31 at the ruined library.
quests.longDescription: As Halloween approaches, the story of Vault 31 and its strange past is being told once again. But is the Vault really haunted, or is something else to blame? It's up to you to solve... The Mystery of Vault 31!

quests.title: Go West
quests.shortDescription: Seek advice about Vault 31 from Herb Vest.
quests.longDescription: The library caretaker told me someone named Herb Vest might know more about Vault 31. I can track him down at the old candy factory.

quests.title: Days Gone Bye
quests.shortDescription: Search the Vault-Tec offices for information about Vault 31.
quests.longDescription: Herb Vest told me that people who go to Vault 31 end up missing. I'm going to head to Vault-Tec's offices to learn more about the Vault's past.

quests.title: Mask Hysteria
quests.shortDescription: Get the Ghost Costumes from the old costume factory.
quests.longDescription: In order to scare the Raiders away from Vault 31, a helpful traveler suggested getting Ghost Costumes from an old factory nearby.

quests.title: Scare Tactics
quests.shortDescription: Confront the Raiders at Vault 31.
quests.longDescription: With the Ghost Costumes in hand, it's time to head out to Vault 31 and confront the Raiders there once and for all!

quests.title: Ghostly Gag
quests.shortDescription: Time to scare some Raiders.
quests.longDescription: Raiders are so superstitious. Let's give them something to be scared of.

quests.title: The Haunting of Mass Chemical
quests.shortDescription: Scare off a Raider Boss holed up in the Mass Chemical building.
quests.longDescription: Like most bullies, Raiders are usually cowards. Rumor has it the Raider Boss who just took over the Mass Chemical building is exactly that, so maybe you can scare him off without a fight.

quests.title: Horror Movie Night!
quests.shortDescription: Send out a lone Vault Dweller wearing a Ghost Costume to wreak havoc!
quests.longDescription: One of your Dwellers is feeling... “inspired” by a horror movie he watched.

quests.title: Clearing A Path
quests.shortDescription: Provide fire support at the machine parts factory.
quests.longDescription: There's a group of soldiers called the “Brotherhood of Steel” that insist the Vault would be an ideal outpost! To meet their standards, we're going to have to provide a little bit of fire support. We'll start at the nearby machine parts factory.

quests.title: Taking Out the Trash
quests.shortDescription: Clear the Ghouls from Vault 840.
quests.longDescription: In order to convince the Brotherhood of Steel that the Vault is worthy enough to be one of their outposts, we're clearing the Ghouls out of Vault 840.

quests.title: Heat of the Knight
quests.shortDescription: Support the Brotherhood at the RobCo Corporate Offices.
quests.longDescription: We need to convince the Brotherhood of Steel that the Vault is worthy enough to be an outpost! Time to support the squad of soldiers at the RobCo Corporate Offices.

quests.title: In Shining Armor
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the soldier from the Raiders at the Nuka-Cola Plant.
quests.longDescription: We've almost proven the Vault's worthiness to the Brotherhood of Steel! Last task - a rescue mission at the Nuka-Cola Plant.

quests.title: Off the Rails
quests.shortDescription: Rescue a kidnapped Railroad operative.
quests.longDescription: A group known as “The Railroad” was trying to sneak refugees through the area, when they were captured by Raiders. Find and rescue them before it's too late.

quests.title: Synth in a Pinch
quests.shortDescription: Rescue a kidnapped Synth!
quests.longDescription: Synths and their Railroad supporters were captured by Raiders. They need to be found before something horrible happens!

quests.title: Not-So-Safehouse
quests.shortDescription: Find the Railroad agents.
quests.longDescription: Railroad agents managed to evade capture and headed for one of their safehouses. Check in with them and make sure they're all right.

quests.title: Synths for Sale
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the Institute Synths.
quests.longDescription: Raiders are trying to ransom Synths back to the Institute. Time to step in and save the day!

quests.title: Blackout
quests.questlineTitle: The Party at the End of the World
quests.shortDescription: The Overseer's son, Jack, is missing after a crazy New Year's party!
quests.longDescription: It's New Year's day... and the Vault threw one heck of a party last night. But the Overseer's son, Jack, is missing and we need to find him! We know he was with us before the clock struck 12, but everything afterwards is a blur. And we're all wearing Radiation Suits. We must have been at the Corvega Auto Plant at some point...

quests.title: A Special Brand
quests.questlineTitle: The Party at the End of the World
quests.shortDescription: We were partying at an old Warehouse! Maybe there are clues there...
quests.longDescription: Last night, we ended up partying with Raiders at an old Warehouse. We should search there for clues to Jack's whereabouts. He's the Overseer's son, after all. If we lose him, we'll end up getting kicked out of the Vault with nothing on our backs... or worse!

quests.title: Walk of Shame
quests.questlineTitle: The Party at the End of the World
quests.shortDescription: Jack may still be alive at the Ironworks - but he's married to a Raider?
quests.longDescription: I guess we traded Jack for a pet, or Jack traded himself, or something! But he ended up married to a Raider Boss named Kaela who hangs out in a cave...

quests.title: Jack Ain't Back
quests.questlineTitle: The Party at the End of the World
quests.shortDescription: First married, then sold to Slavers... Can we get to Jack in time?
quests.longDescription: The Overseer's son got married to a Raider, but she sold him to Slavers! We have to catch them before they disappear west!

quests.title: Human Bean Juice
quests.questlineTitle: The Party at the End of the World
quests.shortDescription: Find Jack before he gets processed into dinner!
quests.longDescription: Jack's been through the ringer - and now he might get turned into dinner! Slavers sold him to a Potted Meat plant. We need to head there!

quests.title: KHAAANNNNN!!!!
quests.questlineTitle: The Party at the End of the World
quests.shortDescription: Jack was stolen by Khan Killian's gang and we need to get him back!
quests.longDescription: Our boy got traded into marriage against his will, sold into slavery, shipped to a meat factory and now some Raiders have him hostage... What's next?

quests.title: Doctor, Doctor, Gimme the Goods
quests.shortDescription: We need medical supplies before our raid on Area 51.
quests.longDescription: Rumor has it Area 51 is packed with tech that could benefit our vault. It's bound to be heavily guarded: we better stock up on medical supplies.

quests.title: Rad Field Trip
quests.shortDescription: Find the paladin on assignment and get them to sign a requisition form.
quests.longDescription: Thanks to our contacts, we're confident we can convince the Brotherhood of Steel to sign off on gear we'll use to raid their own facilities. Ah! The irony!

quests.title: Who's the BoS
quests.shortDescription: Acquire requisitioned Brotherhood of Steel gear
quests.longDescription: With requisition forms in hand, we're headed to the Brotherhood depot for top-tier gear. How hard can it be?

quests.title: All ends well in Roswell!
quests.shortDescription: We're ready for the Area 51 heist. That alien tech is almost within reach.
quests.longDescription: With gear and meds ready, we are set for our heist. Something feels wrong, though. We might not be facing the enemy we expected!

quests.title: Insecuritrons
quests.shortDescription: Investigate the cause of the Securitrons' malfunction.
quests.longDescription: Reports confirm Securitrons have gone haywire, threatening our vault and NoVac.

quests.title: A Handy Secret
quests.shortDescription: Search the RobCo factory for answers.
quests.longDescription: Despite our success, more rogue Securitrons swarm the Mojave region. The RobCo factory might hold answers.

quests.title: The Fifth Wheel
quests.shortDescription: Find out who removed the combat inhibitors of Securitrons.
quests.longDescription: We heard a distress call from "sane" Securitrons holed up in a vault. Maybe they can shed light on the combat inhibitor issue.

quests.title: All Parts of the Job
quests.shortDescription: Seach the warehouse where it all started.
quests.longDescription: The rogue Securitrons trace back to a warehouse near the Sarsaprilla bottling plant. Find whoever's responsible.

quests.title: The Mother of All Brains
quests.shortDescription: Hunt the bandits. End their thievery.
quests.longDescription: Some slick raiders breached our vault and made off with critical supplies. We traced them to an abandoned Vault-Tec site near the Strip.

quests.title: One of Us
quests.shortDescription: Investigate the Vault-Tec Ghoul mind-control experiment
quests.longDescription: When we shut down the Molerat gang, we uncovered a series of failed experiments, each one a threat the security of New Vegas. The next one concerns Ghouls.

quests.title: War of the Wits
quests.shortDescription: Meet with the "philosophes" and show them what real life is about!
quests.longDescription: Next on our list of failed experiments to shut down: Vault Tech has unleashed the subversive power of philosophy. Everyone's sanity is at risk.

quests.title: Whispers in the Vault
quests.shortDescription: End all the experiments
quests.longDescription: We located the control site for all the failed experiments. Time to put an end to them once and for all.

quests.title: Who needs saving?
quests.shortDescription: Be a hero: save the people of The Strip from Deathclaws.
quests.longDescription: The Strip is under siege by Deathclaws. Civilians are trapped and in need of a hero.

quests.title: Town Hall
quests.shortDescription: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip.
quests.longDescription: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip to discuss defense strategy and secure allies.

quests.title: Pleading to the King
quests.shortDescription: We need to enlist the King to fight against Deathclaws.
quests.longDescription: The King is a major player on The Strip. He can tip the scales against the Deathclaws.

quests.title: Omega that Alpha!
quests.shortDescription: We have trapped the Alpha Deathclaw. Time to end the threat.
quests.longDescription: Our efforts have paid off. The last remaining Deathclaws and their Alpha have been cornered in a cave.

quests.title: Rest for the Wicked
quests.shortDescription: An Enclave defector wants refuge in our vault.
quests.longDescription: We've intercepted a coded plea from someone seeking to break from the Enclave. They're holed up in a civilian outpost ripe for infiltration.

quests.title: Mystery Enclave Theater 3000
quests.shortDescription: Attend the opening night of the Enclave play.
quests.longDescription: We've been invited to opening night of an Enclave play. It screams trap, but we can turn it into a golden opportunity!

quests.title: Strange Bedfellows
quests.shortDescription: Investigate a former NCR base
quests.longDescription: We caught an odd signal inviting Enclave to a refuge in a former NCR base located in a mausoleum. Worth a look.

quests.title: Calls of Despair
quests.shortDescription: We're off to answer a new distress call. Definitely not a trap.
quests.longDescription: We must be popular: we've got another distress call, this time from a defecting scientist named Wilzig. By now, it's clear none of these are a trap.

quests.title: Pet Distribution System
quests.shortDescription: Shut down the animal experiments.
quests.longDescription: Intel says the Enclave's coming for us with something big, but we're already one step ahead. First stop: a lab running twisted experiments on animals.

quests.title: Better Death Through Chemistry
quests.shortDescription: Assault the Enclave research bunker
quests.longDescription: We've detected a foreign substance in our power supply. We traced the toxin back to an Enclave research bunker.

quests.title: The Matchmakers
quests.shortDescription: Stop the Enclave's monster-breeding operation.
quests.longDescription: Our spies report the Enclave is breeding abominations to field as soldiers. There's still time to shut them down.

quests.title: Wargames
quests.shortDescription: We need to cripple the Enclave's nuclear capability.
quests.longDescription: The Enclave is preparing their greatest threat yet: nuclear weapons. We must stop them before it's too late.

quests.title: Bunker Down
quests.shortDescription: The Institute is attacking a bunker nearby. Let's send a party to investigate.
quests.longDescription: The Institute still stands and is attacking a nearby bunker. We've picked up a distress call with no details. Let's send a party to investigate.

quests.title: Synth Liberation Bureau
quests.shortDescription: The Railroad wants us to rescue a group of reclaimed Synths from the Institute.
quests.longDescription: Whether we like it or not, we're involved with the Railroad now. They've asked for help freeing a group of reclaimed Synths.

quests.title: Code Scrambling
quests.shortDescription: Using a Brotherhood antenna array, we could severely disrupt Courser Recall.
quests.longDescription: The Brotherhood of Steel controls an antenna array that could scramble the Recall, which Coursers use to teleport. The Institute has taken notice.

quests.title: Runaway Train
quests.shortDescription: The Railroad has been cornered by the Institute. We have to help them.
quests.longDescription: Things are getting worse for the Railroad. Relentless Institute attacks have cornered them in a building on the outskirts of Boston. They need help.

quests.title: Truce
quests.shortDescription: The Institute wants to parley. We want a truce.
quests.longDescription: The Institute has reached out with a ceasefire and seeks a parley. Can there be peace between us?

quests.title: Fake Out
quests.shortDescription: We can access the Institute's communications from an abandoned lab.
quests.longDescription: To test the Institute's claim of peace, we're sending a team to an abandoned lab to tap their comms network.

quests.title: Fratboys of Technology
quests.shortDescription: Institute defectors have intel for us.
quests.longDescription: An Institute splinter group has intel for us. All they want in return is chemistry equipment.

quests.title: For the Betterment of Mankind
quests.shortDescription: Time to choose between permanent peace or endless war with the Institute.
quests.longDescription: The truce is about to expire. We must decide: lasting peace, or war with the Institute.

quests.title: The Path of Paula Plumbkin
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Follow the path of Paula Plumbkin to Vault 730.
quests.longDescription: You've found the journal of Paula Plumbkin, an Overseer who went searching for the mythical utopia, Vaultopolis. Follow in her footsteps! First stop - Vault 730.

quests.title: A Thirst for Adventure
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Follow the path of Paula Plumbkin to the old Nuka-Cola Plant.
quests.longDescription: Paula Plumbkin wasn't at Vault 730, but a helpful Raider told you she set out for the old Nuka-Cola plant. Go track her down!

quests.title: Paula's in a Pickle!
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Rescue Paula Plumbkin from the Feral Ghouls!
quests.longDescription: The Feral Ghouls from the old Nuka-Cola plant dragged Paula Plumbkin to an abandoned building. She needs rescuing!

quests.title: Into Vault 333!
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Explore Vault 333 and find Paula Plumbkin.
quests.longDescription: Paula Plumbkin escaped from the Feral Ghouls and headed to Vault 333. Hopefully we can catch up with her there.

quests.title: Tankbusting
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Find and kill Frank the Tank.
quests.longDescription: The Overseer of Vault 333 might help us find Paula Plumbkin, but first we have to kill Frank the Tank.

quests.title: Return to Vault 333
quests.questlineTitle: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
quests.shortDescription: Return to Vault 333 and get some answers.
quests.longDescription: Frank the Tank is dead. Now maybe the Settlers of Vault 333 will point us toward Paula Plumbkin.

quests.title: Can't Stop The Signal
quests.shortDescription: Investigate a strange radio broadcast.
quests.longDescription: A strange, high-pitched sound is coming through over the radio. The signal seems to originate from an old, abandoned builidng.

quests.title: Hostage Negotiations
quests.shortDescription: Defeat the kidnappers and save their victims.
quests.longDescription: Raiders have been snatching up folks all over the Wasteland. Put an end to their scheme, and save their victims.

quests.title: A Poorly Thought-Out Plan
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Raiders and their Deathclaw.
quests.longDescription: Raiders captured and attempted to domesticate a Deathclaw. It did not go well. They all need to die.

quests.title: Target Practice
quests.shortDescription: Go hunting for Radroaches.
quests.longDescription: Your Dwellers can always use a chance to improve their weapon skills. It's not quite a target range, but the next best thing.

quests.title: Against The Odds
quests.shortDescription: Wipe out the Psycho 77.
quests.longDescription: Okay, maybe 77 is an exaggeration, but there are a lot of them, and only one of you. Have you got what it takes?

quests.title: My Metal Pony
quests.shortDescription: Find a Giddyup Buttercup.
quests.longDescription: Will you use it for spare parts, or riding in your spare time? Up to you, you're the Overseer. Send Dwellers to get one!

quests.title: CoveWatch!
quests.shortDescription: Auditions for a TV Show, or trap? Probably trap.
quests.longDescription: The Vault has received word of a TV pilot filming nearby. It's almost certainly a trap, but send your most physically attractive Dwellers dressed for the part just in case.

quests.title: The Scorpion... King?
quests.shortDescription: Raising Radscorpions is hazardous business.
quests.longDescription: Folks are being stung all over, and the problem is coming from Earl's Radscorpion Emporium. Time to put him out of business.

quests.title: Wonders of Nature
quests.shortDescription: Dr. Hurfburg vs. Pincers of Peril!
quests.longDescription: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, researching the mating habits of Radscorpions. Make sure he's not in over his head.

quests.title: Wonders of Science
quests.shortDescription: Dr. Hurfburg is on a Quest for knowledge and adventure!
quests.longDescription: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, searching for a modern-day Fountain of Youth. Find him, and learn what he's discovered!

quests.title: Wonders of Technology
quests.shortDescription: Dr. Hurfburg is on a Quest for knowledge and adventure!
quests.longDescription: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, working on a Mr. Handy capable of exploring space. See what he's discovered!

quests.title: Scientific Progress
quests.shortDescription: Don't let anything stand in the way of Science!
quests.longDescription: Cutting-edge science requires materials and demands sacrifice. So sacrifice some Raiders in the name of Science and take all their stuff!

quests.title: Captured Critter
quests.shortDescription: Save a lost Pet from some hungry Ghouls.
quests.longDescription: There's a lost and lonely animal who'd love to come home to your Vault. Too bad some hungry Ghouls found it first.

quests.title: The Brothers Grime
quests.shortDescription: Confront a dastardly pair of Raider siblings.
quests.longDescription: Few Raiders play dirtier than the two Raider bosses known as the Brothers Grime. Teach these black-hearted sibling scoundrels a lesson.

quests.title: A Gathering of Ghouls
quests.shortDescription: Confront a Glowing One and its Ghoul minions.
quests.longDescription: A ghastly Glowing One has taken up residence a little too close to the Vault, and it's drawing in Ghouls like moths to a flame. Extinguish the brilliant beacon before this Ghoulish gathering grows any larger!

quests.title: Too Good to be True
quests.shortDescription: Claim a stash of supplies... if you can get past the Deathclaw that's guarding them!
quests.longDescription: That abandoned Vault stocked with supplies? That's Deathclaw territory now. How he got in there, nobody knows, but you won't get to the stash without facing him first. Time to break out the big guns!

quests.title: My Weird Science Project
quests.shortDescription: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion in the name of science!
quests.longDescription: What better way to learn about the deadly Glowing Radscorpion than first-hand observation? Send your research team to the monster's lair. Of course, you'll need to kill it first.

quests.title: Shotgun Wedding
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the kidnapped Vault Dweller from the Raider Boss.
quests.longDescription: A love-struck Raider boss has decided to get married, even though his bride-to-be wants no part of it. Save the kidnapped beauty from the clutches of her unwanted groom.

quests.title: Den of Thieves
quests.shortDescription: Reclaim the stolen supplies from the Raiders.
quests.longDescription: Red Rachel is a ruthless Raider boss, and she's stolen some of your supplies. Take back what's yours, and teach that reckless rogue a lesson!

quests.title: Burnout
quests.shortDescription: Put a nest of pesky Mole rats to the torch.
quests.longDescription: Mole rats! Is there any creature more sneaky or disgusting? Grab a flamer and clear out a nest of those tunnelling terrors.

quests.title: Radiation Leak!
quests.shortDescription: Send a team with Radiation Suits to a neighboring Vault.
quests.longDescription: A neighboring Vault has had a massive radiation leak and the citizens have turned into Feral Ghouls!

quests.title: Arms Race
quests.shortDescription: Save the gunsmith from the Feral Ghouls.
quests.longDescription: The gunsmith's plea came in loud and clear over the radio. “Feral Ghouls! Help! I'll give one of my best pieces to whoever bails me out!” Better hurry if you're going to claim that prize!

quests.title: Ghooooooooooooooooooul!
quests.shortDescription: Explore the ruins of Vault 93.
quests.longDescription: Strange radio signals have been emitting from Vault 93. Sounds like old sports broadcasts from before the bombs dropped. Go check it out!

quests.title: Monday Night Brawl
quests.shortDescription: Defeat the Raider Bosses.
quests.longDescription: A nearby Raider gang is calling you out! Time to show them who's boss...in style! Put on your best threads and start kicking butt!
