quests.title: Man on First
quests.shortDescription: Find the Jersey of baseball legend Rackie Jobinson!
quests.longDescription: Somewhere out there in the Wasteland is the Jersey of legendary baseball player Rackie Jobinson. Play ball!

quests.title: Man on Second
quests.shortDescription: Look for Coach in Vault 428.
quests.longDescription: We found a note from someone named Coach, who claims he has Rackie Jobinson's Jersey! Maybe he's hiding out in the ruins of Vault 428...

quests.title: Man on Third
quests.shortDescription: Hunt Coach down in an office building.
quests.longDescription: Does Coach really have the Jersey? Evidence suggests he may be in an old office building, so it's worth a look.

quests.title: Time for a Grand Slam?
quests.shortDescription: Can Henrietta lead us to the Jersey?
quests.longDescription: A note from someone named Henrietta has led us to Vault 232. Hopefully she can lead us to Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!

quests.title: Worst. Coach. Ever.
quests.shortDescription: The search goes on!
quests.longDescription: Henrietta was Coach's old girlfriend. She doesn't know where he is, but gave us a sweet weapon to help take him down. The search goes on!

quests.title: Picked Off at Second!
quests.shortDescription: Keep the search alive!
quests.longDescription: We found a Rackie Jobinson baseball card with a taunting note from Coach. Looks like he really does have the Jersey. But we'll never give up!

quests.title: Seventh Inning Stretch
quests.shortDescription: Do the Raiders know where Coach is?
quests.longDescription: Some Raiders have taken over an old apartment complex. Maybe these jerks know the big jerk, Coach. Can't hurt to ask!

quests.title: Getcha' Peanuts Here!
quests.shortDescription: Explore the mattress factory to find Coach.
quests.longDescription: Okay, so the Raiders didn't lead us to Coach. It was worth a shot. Maybe he's taking a nap in the old mattress factory!

quests.title: Last Inning! Or not...
quests.shortDescription: Search farther out for Coach and the Jersey.
quests.longDescription: Still no sign of Coach, or Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Time to venture farther out. No risk, no reward!

quests.title: There's no Crying in Baseball!
quests.shortDescription: Did an Alpha Deathclaw take Coach out?
quests.longDescription: We have word that a fierce Alpha Deathclaw has taken up residence in an old office building. Maybe it killed Coach! Dare to dream, right?

quests.title: Runners in Scoring Position!
quests.shortDescription: Keep tracking Coach and the Jersey!
quests.longDescription: Coach survived the Alpha Deathclaw, but he won't survive me! The Sultan of Slime left another narcissistic note, so we know he's still out there. The search continues!

quests.title: Conference on the Mound
quests.shortDescription: Comb through Holy Heart Hospital.
quests.longDescription: Call it a gut feeling, but Coach may be taking a breather in the ruins of Holy Heart Hospital. If he's there, so is Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!

quests.title: Here's the Pitch...
quests.shortDescription: Track Coach down in the Lakeville Library.
quests.longDescription: Okay, so Holy Heart Hospital was a dead end. But at least we're still alive! Next stop, the ruins of Lakeville Library.

quests.title: Homerun!
quests.shortDescription: Chase after Coach in Vault 789.
quests.longDescription: Coach left a taunting message spray painted on the wall of the Lakeville Library! We're closing in! Time to search the ruins of Vault 789.

quests.title: Here's to You, Rackie Jobinson
quests.shortDescription: Bottom of the 9th! Head to the Dugout and get that Jersey!
quests.longDescription: This is it, the end of the game! It's a bench-clearing brawl with Coach in the Dugout. Time to retire this washout, and claim Rackie Jobinson's Jersey for our own!

quests.title: The Mystery of Vault 666
quests.shortDescription: Vault 666 isn't on any official Vault-Tec registry. Time to investigate.
quests.longDescription: While adventuring, a Dweller discovered a map to Vault 666. It's not on any official Vault-Tec registry. What secrets could it hold?

quests.title: Factory Floor of Fear
quests.shortDescription: Explore a dangerous industrial area.
quests.longDescription: While exploring, Dwellers found a note warning everyone to stay away from an old industrial complex. If folks have kept clear, it might still hold something useful.

quests.title: Vault 789
quests.shortDescription: Time to check out Vault 789!
quests.longDescription: While out exploring, one of your Dwellers found an old advertisement for Vault 789. Time to check it out!

quests.title: Bottlecap Blues
quests.shortDescription: Track down Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
quests.longDescription: Bottle & Cappy have been kidnapped from Nuka-World by Raiders! They were last spotted at an abandoned factory. Head out there and rescue them before it's too late!

quests.title: In Hot Pursuit
quests.shortDescription: Pursue Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
quests.longDescription: A helpful survivor who escaped from the Raiders suggested I search Vault 177 for Bottle & Cappy. If I hurry, I might be able to catch up with them.

quests.title: Playing Catch-Up
quests.shortDescription: Pursue Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
quests.longDescription: The Raider Boss at Vault 177 boasted that they took Bottle & Cappy to the Poseidon Energy offices. I hope she was telling the truth.

quests.title: Pet Peeve
quests.shortDescription: Pursue Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
quests.longDescription: I found out from the Ghouls living in the Poseidon Energy offices that Bottle & Cappy may have been taken to the RobCo Building. Looks like that's my next stop.

quests.title: A Refreshing Rescue
quests.shortDescription: Rescue Bottle & Cappy from the Nuka-Cola Factory.
quests.longDescription: A stranger at the RobCo Building told me the Raiders took Bottle & Cappy to the Nuka-Cola Factory. I have a feeling I'll finally catch up to them this time.

quests.title: Power to the People?
quests.shortDescription: Rescue Overseer Mogabe from Rubarb's Raiders.
quests.longDescription: A disgruntled Dweller named Rubarb has joined the Raiders and wants to liberate some local Vaults... with violence! Overseer Mogabe needs your help!

quests.title: No Rest for the Wicked
quests.shortDescription: Answer Overseer Zilewski's distress call.
quests.longDescription: Looks like Rubarb is just getting started. You've received a distress call from Overseer Zilewski's Vault. Better investigate!

quests.title: All Work and No Play
quests.shortDescription: Rescue Overseer Chang from Rubarb's Raiders.
quests.longDescription: Rubarb has found another Vault to liberate. Time to head out and rescue Overseer Chang from the Raiders!

quests.title: Working Overtime
quests.shortDescription: Investigate Vault 700 and see what Rubarb's Raiders are up to.
quests.longDescription: Rubarb and his Raiders were spotted recently in Vault 700. Better go check it out!

quests.title: Rubarb's Reckoning
quests.shortDescription: Confront Rubarb and his Raiders in Vault 711.
quests.longDescription: Rubarb and his Raiders just took over Vault 711, and he's still there. Take down his lieutenants, then confront Rubarb himself!

quests.longDescription: Reports are coming in from all over the Wasteland of a frightening creature known only as the Gobbler. We have to investigate!

quests.title: A Delicious Trail of Danger!
quests.shortDescription: Follow the Gobbler's trail to the Blamco factory.
quests.longDescription: We've followed the Gobbler's trail of snack cakes to the Blamco factory.

quests.title: The Last Gobble!
quests.shortDescription: Time to finally put an end to the Gobbler!
quests.longDescription: We've followed the Gobbler's trail of cranberry sauce to Vault 261. Now it's time to end this!

quests.title: Who's Carving the Turkey?

quests.title: Honeymoon Horror
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the newlyweds from the Radscorpions.
quests.longDescription: Some newlyweds from a nearby settlement went to a secluded cave to “celebrate” in private. They haven't returned, and neither has the original rescue party! Maybe those rumors of Radscorpions are true after all. Better gear up!

quests.title: Radroach Roundup
quests.shortDescription: Save scientists from the Radroaches they were studying.
quests.longDescription: A distress call has come in from a nearby science lab studying Radroaches. Thieves stole their Radiation Suits and released all the Radroaches to cover their escape. Now the scientists are in over their heads and asking for help!

quests.title: Undercover Operations
quests.shortDescription: Infiltrate a military base to stop the Pest attack!
quests.longDescription: An underground military base is under attack and calling in all their Wasteland patrols. Could it be the Pests again? We need to stop them! But we'll need Military Fatigues to pass as one of the patrols and get into the base...

quests.title: Dogs of War
quests.shortDescription: Talk to Three Dog about the Horsemen of the Apocalypse.
quests.longDescription: Famine and Pestilence are out there, whoever they are, with followers to spare. War and Death are the other infamous Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Are they terrorizing the Wasteland as well? If anyone knows, it's Three Dog at Galaxy News Radio. Let's go talk to him.

quests.title: Springing the Trap
quests.shortDescription: Get answers from the Pests lured into your trap.
quests.longDescription: At Three Dog's advice, we spread the word that a dozen suits of Power Armor were hidden in a particular cave. The Pests took the bait and are currently inside, searching for the suits. It's time to head in there and find out what we can about Pestilence and the Pests!

quests.title: Beat Reporting
quests.shortDescription: Visit the offices of the Weekly Exposition.
quests.longDescription: A reporter for the Weekly Exposition newspaper, undercover as a Pest, told us about Pestilence and asked us to relay a message to his editor. He also said there are reporters hidden among the Hungry and the Warshippers, so let's go to the Exposition's offices and find out what they know!

quests.title: Matters to Settle
quests.shortDescription: Save a settlement caught between the Pests and the Hungry.
quests.longDescription: Three Dog reports that the Pests and the Hungry are about to face off right where a settlement stands! We need to stop them and save as many Settlers as possible. Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.

quests.title: Parley Time
quests.shortDescription: Meet with War, who invited you to talk.
quests.longDescription: The Horseman, War, has invited us to discuss matters of common interest. His messenger told us the Warshippers would try to kill us, but it's worth the risk to find out what he wants! Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.

quests.title: Crime Scene Investigation
quests.shortDescription: Search for clues about Death in Vault 672.
quests.longDescription: Huzzah! We now have a truce with War until the other Horsemen are dealt with! To that end, War claims that the servants of Death attacked Vault 672. So we're off to investigate and look for any clues they may have left behind...

quests.title: Death Revealed?
quests.shortDescription: Learn the truth about Death from the Overseer of Vault 144!
quests.longDescription: In Vault 672, we met Dwellers from Vault 144 who are familiar with Death, the mysterious fourth Horseman. As promised, their Overseer contacted us and set up a meeting where she'll tell us what she can! But she doesn't want to reveal the location of her Vault, so we'll be joining her in an abandoned building...

quests.title: Give me Liberty and/or Death
quests.shortDescription: Discover the location of Vault 144, home of the Death cultists.
quests.longDescription: It was a trap! Whoever Death is, he's sleeping... and the Vault 144 Dwellers believe that killing people will wake the Horseman up! We killed their Overseer, but we still need to find their Vault. If we're lucky, the Vault-Tec Archives will have its location...

quests.title: Operation: Sandman
quests.shortDescription: Infiltrate Vault 144 to stop the Dwellers from waking Death.
quests.longDescription: Despite the best efforts of the Vault 144 Dwellers, we discovered the location of their home and that they only worship Death because “Death” was incorrectly capitalized in their Vault's instruction manual! We must now infiltrate Vault 144 and stop them from waking Death...

quests.title: Release the Raiders!
quests.shortDescription: Get the Warshippers to look for Death's cave.
quests.longDescription: Death wasn't in Vault 144. He's in a cave somewhere, and Vault 144 Dwellers are still out there trying to wake him up. It's time to meet back up with War to give him a status report! And while we're at it, we can keep the Warshippers out of trouble by asking them to find the cave...

quests.title: Set 'Em Up: Pestilence
quests.shortDescription: Lure Pestilence to the abandoned Vault 226.
quests.longDescription: The truce forgotten, War is now out for blood, ready to tear the Wasteland apart looking for Pestilence! The longer it takes, the more innocent Settlers will die, so let's dress as Warshippers and convince the Pests to bring Pestilence to War. Vault 226, abandoned and in the mountains, will make a great arena for their apocalyptic faceoff!

quests.title: Set 'Em Up: Famine
quests.shortDescription: Lure Famine to the abandoned Vault 226.
quests.longDescription: The Pests will bring Pestilence to Vault 226, so War is sure to follow. If we could get Famine there as well, the Horsemen and their cultists might all take care of each other! We need to dress as Pests and speak to the Hungry Horde's non-feral leaders.

quests.title: Run, Three Dog, Run!
quests.shortDescription: Save Three Dog from the Death cultists chasing him.
quests.longDescription: All this time, Three Dog has been saving lives, helping Settlers evade the Horsemen's followers, but it's put him on Vault 144's hit list! His last broadcast has him on the run from Death cultists. We need to get to him before they do, and one of his pursuers might know the location of Death's cave!

quests.title: Knock 'Em Down
quests.shortDescription: Kill Famine, Pestilence and War.
quests.longDescription: War vs. Pestilence vs. Famine. Warshippers vs. Pests vs. Hungry. Everyone's arrived at Vault 226, ready to fight, but we shouldn't leave anything to chance. Let's wade through the carnage and make sure none of the Horsemen survive!

quests.title: At Death's Door
quests.shortDescription: Kill Death, the final Horseman.
quests.longDescription: Three down, one to go, and thanks to Three Dog, we know where Death's cave is. But will he be awake? Only one way to find out!

quests.title: Just Deserts
quests.shortDescription: Discover the origin of the Horsemen.
quests.longDescription: The Vault received an anonymous message promising to reveal the secret origin of the Horsemen. The location it gives is far into the Wasteland, but it's worth the risk to find out what this person has to say.

quests.title: Party Favors
quests.shortDescription: Find party decorations in the Super Duper Mart.
quests.longDescription: The anniversary of our first entering the Vault is approaching and it is a good opportunity to improve Vault morale by throwing a celebration! We've got food, we've got music, but it seems when VaulTec stocked our initial supplies, they forgot to include party decorations! We are going to have to send a team to the nearby Super Duper Mart to find some...

quests.title: Mandatory Fun
quests.shortDescription: Search for the missing party supplies in the government building.
quests.longDescription: We didn't find any party supplies at the Super Duper Mart, but our team discovered that a large number of streamers and balloons had been purchased by a government employee shortly before the bombs fell. We have traced the employee to a nearby government building. We are going to send a team to the facility to find and retrieve the missing party supplies.

quests.title: The Truth Is In Here
quests.shortDescription: Investigate the government research facility.
quests.longDescription: While looking for decorations, our team discovered something at the old government building that was a surprise to us all. We have since sifted through the data in all of our logs and found reference to a government facility that may hold more revelatory information. This may lead us to some tech that could help us improve the Vault leaps and bounds beyond what was planned. We need to send out a team as soon as possible!

quests.title: Enclosed Encounters
quests.shortDescription: Go to the crash site field lab and find the alien tech.
quests.longDescription: We stumbled on something unbelievable at the government facility. When we took a further look into the research data, we found records of a field research lab at a so-called "crash site" where they were conducting experiments on "the object." Let's get to this crash site and see what we can scavenge!

quests.title: Factory Upgrade
quests.shortDescription: Search the RobCo factory for extraterrestrial technology.
quests.longDescription: We've been churning through the data that came back from that UFO lab we scouted a while back. Turns out, the old government turned over most of their specimens to RobCo. We found a holotape among the junk you brought back from the UFO Crash Site mentioning something about the next step in the development of advanced AI. Luckily, the nearest RobCo factory is pretty close to our vault. Let's send some dwellers there and see if we can find that research data. It could make a big difference for our vault!

quests.title: My Friends Are Electric
quests.shortDescription: Get into the secret RobCo R&D facility and track down their research data.
quests.longDescription: We cracked the executive's logs from the RobCo factory and discovered the location of a secret RobCo R&D facility. It occupies a series of secret levels below a retail store at the local mall. RobCo was using alien technology to advance their robotics research. They were trying to build something big. If we can figure out what they knew, we should be able to use it to make major improvements to the Vault!

quests.title: Robot Hood
quests.shortDescription: Track down a strange bandit and stop them from accosting traders.
quests.longDescription: We have recently made contact with some Traders who say they were waylayed on the road by a mysterious bandit. They claim the thief was shouting something about fighting human oppression, and made off with a significant portion of the Traders' goods. We need you to go out there and track this bandit down. See if they can be reasoned with, and deal with them otherwise. We need to keep the trade routes safe and clear!

quests.title: Pitt Stop
quests.shortDescription: Rescue abducted settlers from the slavers.
quests.longDescription: A band of well-armed raiders attacked a caravan a few days back and made off with a number of settlers, we're assuming to use as slaves. We've got their last known co-ordinates and direction of travel, but no one was able to track them. We should send some good people out to track down and free the abductees, and eliminate these slavers. They're the last thing we need lurking around in our back yard.

quests.title: First Down
quests.shortDescription: Help the lost settler.
quests.longDescription: A frantic voice comes in over the radio. There's a settler out in the Wasteland who's in serious trouble! The clock's ticking...

quests.title: Second-Stringers
quests.shortDescription: Locate the hostage.
quests.longDescription: A gang of Raiders has taken a settler hostage. Rescue the captive and solve the mystery of the Super Cup!

quests.title: Third and Goal
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the hostage and confront the Commish.
quests.longDescription: You've tracked the kidnapped settler to the lair of the Commish. Time to put an end to this football flunky's Super Cup contest!

quests.title: A Pale Imitation
quests.shortDescription: Investigate a mysterious, brand new Vault.
quests.longDescription: There's a new Vault in the Wasteland, and it's run by Raiders! Vault-Tec is long gone, so who could have possibly constructed Vault R41D? Time to investigate...

quests.title: Wrongo! I'm afraid you must... Lose Your Head!
quests.shortDescription: Wrongo! I'm afraid you must... Lose Your Head!
quests.longDescription: Wrongo! I'm afraid you must... Lose Your Head!

quests.title: Wedding Crashers
quests.shortDescription: Help an engaged Raider couple work through their problems.
quests.longDescription: The notorious Raider, Sally Switchblade, is getting married to the infamous Marcus Hammer. But they're both having second thoughts, because neither wants to live the Raider lifestyle anymore. If only they'd communicate! Bust in and solve their problems for them.

quests.title: Monster Under the Bed
quests.shortDescription: Track down and kill a teddy bear-stealing monster!
quests.longDescription: One of the Vault youngsters was playing outside when a terrifying monster stole their teddy bear. Now they refuse to sleep, claiming the monster comes back every night to hide under their bed! We've got to track the beast down to end the kid's fears - permanently.

quests.title: Time to Wake Up!
quests.shortDescription: Stop the incessant beeping of the world's loudest alarm clock.
quests.longDescription: Someone made the mistake of activating a Wakemaster prototype alarm clock in a building not far from the Vault. Now the alarm is blaring non-stop and it's keeping everyone up!

quests.title: Dog Gone
quests.shortDescription: Save a kidnapped pooch from a band of Raiders.
quests.longDescription: A hastily written and grammatically incorrect note was left outside the Vault door: “IF U EVAR WANT TOO SEE YOU'RE DOG AGAN, COME TWO ARE BIG BILDING AND BRING GUNZ, CAPS, AND SNAX.” It must've been written by some really stupid Raiders, because we don't even have a missing dog. But if those jerks really do have a kidnapped canine, it still needs rescuing!

quests.title: Raiding Party
quests.shortDescription: Infiltrate the Raiders' hideout and sow the seeds of distrust.
quests.longDescription: A group of Raiders is holding a rowdy shindig while their Boss is away. Now's our chance to infiltrate them while they're partying. If we can turn them against their Boss, the whole gang will be destroyed from within!

quests.title: The Spirit of Taking
quests.shortDescription: Confront a gang of Raiders that stole a gift from a Wasteland Settler.
quests.longDescription: So much for the spirit of giving! Some heartless Raiders have robbed a Wasteland Settler and stolen a gift meant for his friend.

quests.title: To Grandmother's House We Go
quests.shortDescription: Help some Wasteland Settlers who got lost while traveling for the Holidays!
quests.longDescription: An old woman living near your Vault was expecting Holiday visitors, but they haven't arrived and she fears the worst!

quests.title: The Door Buster
quests.shortDescription: Be the first to claim the Door Buster!
quests.longDescription: Across the Wasteland, rumors swirl of a treasure called the “Door Buster.” The race is on to claim this mysterious prize!

quests.title: Santa's Helpers
quests.shortDescription: Spread Christmas cheer!
quests.longDescription: Santa's gone missing, and we can only bring him back by spreading some Christmas cheer!

quests.title: Christmas at the Raider Camp
quests.shortDescription: Spread Christmas cheer!
quests.longDescription: Yes, even Raiders need a little Holiday spirit!

quests.title: Cheer for the Ghouls
quests.shortDescription: Spread Christmas cheer!
quests.longDescription: Everyone forgets those poor Ghouls need holiday cheer, too!

quests.title: Rescue Santa!
quests.shortDescription: Find and save Santa Claus.
quests.longDescription: While we were spreading Christmas cheer, someone managed to track down Santa Claus. He's in trouble. Let's go!

quests.title: Eviction Notice
quests.shortDescription: Get the Khans out of the Dino Dee-Lite motel in Novac.
quests.longDescription: The Dino Dee-Lite motel in Novac was once a bustling hub, now overrun with raiders who call themselves Khans. We're going to turn it back into a motel.

quests.title: Room Service
quests.shortDescription: Clear the motel of dangerous creatures before opening.
quests.longDescription: The motel is almost ready! But those Khans left a mess and it attracted a bunch of vermin. Let's get them out before we open the doors.

quests.title: Ghoul Supplies
quests.shortDescription: Find the Ghoul salesperson to help furnish our new motel.
quests.longDescription: We have a space for our new motel, but now we need stuff to put in it. Apparently, there's a Ghoul salesperson around who can help us out.

quests.title: Headhunting
quests.shortDescription: Rescue a manager from a group of raiders.
quests.longDescription: Apparently there's someone with some administrative skill who was kidnapped by raiders. Let's get him out of there, and maybe in return he'll help us run our motel!

quests.title: Death Meat
quests.shortDescription: Follow the dog back to Novac… what could be waiting for us there?
quests.longDescription: Our new dog is acting worried. What is it, boy? You want us to follow? Maybe it's delicious food, like Cram, or Brahmin steak, or… Deathclaw meat!

quests.title: Fetch Quest
quests.shortDescription: Talk to a doctor about a Deathclaw pesticide.
quests.longDescription: Something will have to be done about those Deathclaws! Apparently there's a doctor who can make a strong poison that will keep them away for good. Let's go talk to her!

quests.title: Deathicide
quests.shortDescription: Spray the Deathclaw nest with poison.
quests.longDescription: Now we have some Deathclaw poison. I guess we should spray the nest near the motel to get rid of the problem, rather than the motel itself.

quests.title: Ghoul Down, Boy
quests.shortDescription: Clear feral Ghouls out of the motel so it can run again.
quests.longDescription: Apparently our anti-Deathclaw spray is like honey to feral Ghouls. Clear them out so we can get running again!

quests.title: Freeside Spree
quests.shortDescription: Check Freeside for supplies.
quests.longDescription: We need some supplies. Why not see what the local commercial hub, Freeside, has to offer!

quests.title: Second Hand Supply
quests.shortDescription: Find the one who sold us the so-called “Miracle Serum”.
quests.longDescription: That “Miracle Serum” we were sold in Freeside got a bunch of us sick! Time to track down the one who sold it to us and get an explanation.

quests.title: Crime Lab
quests.shortDescription: Stop the production of “Miracle Serum” in Westside.
quests.longDescription: The Snake Oil Salesman sent us to a rickety building in the so-called Westside of New Vegas. They won't be making any more “Miracle Serum” when we're done with them.

quests.title: Casting the Die
quests.shortDescription: Confront the slavers at their base near New Vegas.
quests.longDescription: We've discovered the base of the raiders who have been enslaving hapless folks in Freeside, in a vault near New Vegas. But where are the slaves going?

quests.title: Party to the Max
quests.shortDescription: Deliver Mr. House's party invitation to Maximus.
quests.longDescription: We're throwing a party for Mr. House, and we want all the most interesting people there. The only invite left to deliver is to Maximus! Find him on the Strip!

quests.title: Shiny Security
quests.shortDescription: Organize security for Mr. House's party.
quests.longDescription: Securitrons are supposed to be excellent guards. Go see Victor at RobCo headquarters and discuss security for Mr. House's party.

quests.title: Party Poaching
quests.shortDescription: Find folks to staff Mr. House's party.
quests.longDescription: They say there's a big Ghoul party happening nearby. Could be a good place to scout staff for Mr. House's party.

quests.title: Squishing the Party
quests.shortDescription: Squish the Radroaches that have crashed Mr. House's party.
quests.longDescription: The time has come for Mr. House's party! But… what's that sound? Radroaches! Squish them all before the rest of the guests arrive!

quests.title: Golden Neighbors
quests.shortDescription: Explore a ruined Enclave base nearby.
quests.longDescription: We've discovered the remains of a secret Enclave base. What strange and horrifying stuff will we find?

quests.title: Ghost Training
quests.shortDescription: Investigate an Enclave training facility in an old vault.
quests.longDescription: The first Enclave location on our list is an old Vault-Tec vault. They're probably doing something really sinister, sullying our pristine walls and morals.

quests.title: Gold-R-Us
quests.shortDescription: Look for gold at an old megastore building.
quests.longDescription: Our metal detectors picked up a heavy signal of pure gold at a nearby megastore building. Could be worth checking out!

quests.title: The Fall of Autumn
quests.shortDescription: Confront the Enclave at their nearby base.
quests.longDescription: We've discovered an active Enclave base! Let's bring the fight to them, before they finish whatever horrible thing they're planning.

quests.title: Mini-Mall of America
quests.shortDescription: Find gold bullion vending machines at a former shopping mall.
quests.longDescription: Apparently there are vending machines that accept gold bullion? Let's see if we can pry them open.

quests.title: Data Brokers
quests.shortDescription: Visit an Enclave building in search of GOLDAS.
quests.longDescription: We found an Enclave citadel that may hold important databases for GOLDAS. Hopefully it's not just a wild Mole rat chase.

quests.title: Base to Base Icks
quests.shortDescription: Explore the secret entrance of a familiar Enclave base.
quests.longDescription: We found a secret entrance in the first abandoned Enclave base we explored. Let's see if there's also secret info!

quests.title: Bite My Shiny Metal Gold
quests.shortDescription: Shut down GOLDAS for good (and steal some gold).
quests.longDescription: We have finally located GOLDAS' main server! Let's shut down that weirdo AI once and for all. And take their gold.

quests.title: Hold on a Minuteman
quests.shortDescription: Rescue the Minutemen and defeat the feral Ghouls attacking their outpost.
quests.longDescription: We've received a distress call from some Minutemen. Apparently some Ghouls have attacked one of their outposts. Help them out, and maybe they'll join our fight against the Institute!

quests.title: Convenient Covenant
quests.shortDescription: Persuade the Covenant to help against the Institute.
quests.longDescription: The Covenant could be a helpful ally against the Institute. Use your natural charisma to get as many of them on board as you can.

quests.title: Core of Power
quests.shortDescription: Get some blueprints for the Brotherhood in exchange for Fusion Cores.
quests.longDescription: The Brotherhood needs us to retrieve some “secret blueprints” for them, from a RobCo research facility. If we do, they'll join our efforts, starting by give us some Fusion Cores!

quests.title: The Power of Friendship
quests.shortDescription: Attack the Institute base which will hopefully stop the Synth raids.
quests.longDescription: We've found where all the Synths have been coming from! An Institute base in an old Vault. Bring the fight to them, and hopefully stop the assault!

quests.title: A Steel Fist in a Velvet Glove
quests.shortDescription: Attend a war meeting with the Brotherhood of Steel.
quests.longDescription: An Elder from the Brotherhood of Steel has proposed a meeting to discuss battle plans against the Institute. Let's see what they've got to offer.

quests.title: The Power Room
quests.shortDescription: Steal Fusion Cores from the Brotherhood now that we're enemies.
quests.longDescription: The Brotherhood made the mistake of becoming our enemies, so let's raid their storage and steal their Fusion Cores!

quests.title: Abomination
quests.shortDescription: Break some “abominations” out of a Brotherhood prison.
quests.longDescription: We've found a Brotherhood of Steel prison for Synths and other “abominations”, where they do experiments on the inmates. Let's break them out!

quests.title: Steelhead Fishing
quests.shortDescription: Deal with Elder Maxson, who fell into our trap.
quests.longDescription: The Brotherhood did us dirty. Now it's time for some real payback. We've lured Elder Maxson and his entourage into a trap, ready for you to spring.
